website_content.summary: GPSC has released the Provisional Answer Key for the post of District Education Officer and District Primary Education Officer (PwD Special Recruitment). Candidates can submit objections online until September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Gujarat Public Service Commission (GPSC) has issued the **Provisional Answer Key 2026** for the preliminary written test held on September 17, 2026. This recruitment is specifically for the **Special Recruitment for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) - Second Attempt** drive.

## Key Post Details
* **Post Name:** District Education Officer / District Primary Education Officer and Equivalent
* **Service:** Gujarat Educational Service, Class-1 (Administrative Branch)
* **Advertisement No.:** 41/2026-27
* **Booklet Code:** BVZ

## Important Dates
* **Preliminary Test Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 22 September 2026
* **Objection Window Starts:** 23 September 2026, 11:00 AM
* **Objection Deadline:** 28 September 2026, 04:00 PM

## Objection Process
* **Fee:** Rs. 100 per objection (non-refundable).
* **Mode:** Online submission only.
* **Requirement:** Must provide valid supporting documents or authentic references.
* **Constraint:** Objections based on AI-generated responses (GPT etc.) without independent evidence will be rejected.

website_content.title: MH B.Sc Nursing CAP Round 2 Seat Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: The State CET Cell, Maharashtra, will release the MH B.Sc Nursing CAP Round 2 seat allotment results on September 24, 2026. Candidates can verify their allotment status and download the provisional selection list from the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The State Common Entrance Test (CET) Cell, Maharashtra, is facilitating the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) for B.Sc Nursing. The Round 2 seat allotment result is a critical step for candidates to secure their admission into nursing institutes.

## Important Dates
* **Final Merit List Released:** September 11, 2026
* **CAP Round 2 Seat Matrix Published:** September 21, 2026
* **Choice/Preference Filling Deadline:** September 23, 2026 (5:30 PM)
* **Seat Allotment Result Date:** September 24, 2026 (Expected)
* **Physical Reporting & Document Verification:** September 25 to September 30, 2026

## How to Download the Selection List PDF
1. Visit the official result portal.
2. Navigate to the notifications tab and click on **"CAP Round 2 Selection List for B.Sc Nursing 2026"**.
3. Once the PDF opens, use **Ctrl + F** to search for your **CET Application Number** or **Name**.
4. Download the provisional allotment letter and take a printout for physical reporting.

## Critical Instructions
* Only trust official websites (`medical2026.mahacet.org` and `mahacet.org`) for authentic updates.
* Ensure you have your **CET roll number** and login credentials ready.
* The provisional allotment letter is mandatory for college joining; multiple copies are recommended.

website_content.title: UPSSSC FSL Scientific Assistant & Laboratory Assistant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: UPSSSC invites applications for 208 posts of Scientific Assistant and Laboratory Assistant in the Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL), UP. Selection is based on UP PET 2025 shortlisting followed by a written OMR exam.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
UPSSSC is conducting recruitment for technical positions within the **Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL), Uttar Pradesh**. 

**Key Details:**
* **Organization:** UPSSSC
* **Posts:** Scientific Assistant & Laboratory Assistant
* **Total Vacancies:** 208
* **Advertisement No:** 15-Exam/2026
* **Exam Mode:** Offline (OMR-Based)

## Selection Process
1. **UP PET 2025 Shortlisting:** Candidates must first be shortlisted based on their Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2025 scores.
2. **Written Examination:** Shortlisted candidates will undergo an objective-type written test.

## Exam Pattern & Marking
* **Total Questions:** 100 MCQs
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Duration:** 120 Minutes
* **Negative Marking:** 0.25 marks deducted for every wrong answer.

## Detailed Syllabus
### Part I: Technical Subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Math, Forensic Science)
* **Physics:** Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Optics, Electricity, and Applied Physics in Forensics.
* **Chemistry:** Physical, Organic, Inorganic, Analytical, and Forensic Chemistry.
* **Biology:** Cell Biology, Genetics, Human Anatomy, Serology, and Forensic Biology.
* **Mathematics:** Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, and Statistics.
* **Forensic Science:** CSI, Physical/Biological Evidence, Questioned Documents, and Ballistics.

### Part II: Computer & IT
* Hardware/Software, Internet, MS-Office, e-Governance, AI, and Cyber Security.

### Part III: General Knowledge
* General information related to the state of **Uttar Pradesh**.

website_content.title: Indian Coast Guard Group C Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Indian Coast Guard (Region West) is inviting offline applications for 6 Group C vacancies including Store Keeper, Engine Driver, and MTS. The application deadline is November 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Indian Coast Guard (Headquarters, Coast Guard Region West) has released a notification for the recruitment of Group C Non-Gazetted posts. Please note that the **application mode is Offline** via ordinary post.

## Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Category |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Store Keeper Grade II | 1 | EWS |
| Engine Driver | 1 | SC |
| Lascar | 1 | EWS |
| Civilian Motor Transport Driver | 1 | OBC |
| MTS (Peon) | 1 | OBC |
| MTS (Chowkidar) | 1 | OBC |
| **Total** | **6** | |

## Eligibility & Experience
* **Store Keeper Grade II**: 12th Pass + 1 year experience in handling stores.
* **Engine Driver**: Matriculation + Certificate of Competency as Engine Driver.
* **Lascar**: Matriculation + 3 years experience in boat service.
* **Civilian Motor Transport Driver**: 10th Pass + Valid Heavy/Light Driving Licence + 2 years experience.
* **MTS (Peon/Chowkidar)**: Matriculation + 2 years relevant experience.

## Age Limit (As of notification)
* **Store Keeper**: 18 to 25 years
* **Engine Driver/Lascar**: 18 to 30 years
* **Others**: 18 to 27 years
* *Age relaxation provided for SC/OBC and Govt servants as per Central Govt rules.*

## Selection Process
1. **Application Scrutiny**
2. **Document & Biometric Verification**
3. **Written Examination**: 80 objective questions, 1 hour, no negative marking.
4. **Trade Test**: Only for applicable posts.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Published**: 19-25 September 2026
* **Application Deadline**: 3 November 2026

## How to Apply
1. Download the prescribed application form from the official website.
2. Fill the form in English or Hindi and affix a self-attested photo.
3. Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates and experience letters.
4. Enclose a self-addressed blank envelope with a **Rs. 50 postal stamp**.
5. Send the application via **Ordinary Post** to: *Headquarters Coast Guard Region (West), Alexander Graham Bell Road, PO Malabar Hill, Mumbai - 400006*.

website_content.summary: Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has declared the final result and selection list for the Assistant Professor (Commerce) Exam-2024 on September 21, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The **Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC)**, Indore, has officially released the selection and marks list for the post of **Assistant Professor (Commerce)** under the Higher Education Department of the MP Government.

## Key Selection Details
* **Post Name:** Assistant Professor, Commerce
* **Advertisement No.:** 25/2024 dated 30.12.2024
* **Total Posts (Main Part - 87%):** 106
* **Candidates Selected (Main List):** 105
* **Candidates in Supplementary List:** 32
* **Selection Basis:** Written Exam (800 marks) + Interview (100 marks) = Total 900 marks

## Important Dates
* **Advertisement Date:** 30 December 2024
* **Written Exam Date:** 01 June 2025
* **Written Result Date:** 12 November 2025
* **Interview Period:** 07 August 2026 to 14 August 2026
* **Final Result Date:** 21 September 2026

## Tie-Breaking Rules
In case of equal total marks, the following priority is used:
1. Higher sum of written + interview marks.
2. Higher marks in the written exam.
3. Older candidate by age.

## Important Note
The result for the remaining 13% provisional part is pending final judicial decisions regarding OBC reservation.

website_content.title: MH CET 3-Year & 5-Year LLB Counselling 2026 Institutional Round Schedule Released
website_content.summary: The State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra has released the Institutional-Level Round (Round IV) schedule for 3-Year and 5-Year LLB courses for the 2026-27 academic session. Eligible candidates can submit fresh college preferences through the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MH CET Law Counselling 2026: Institutional Round (Round IV)

The **State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra** has published the official schedule for the **Institutional-Level Round (Round IV)** for admissions to 3-Year LLB and 5-Year LLB (Integrated Law) programmes for the 2026-27 academic session. This round fills the remaining vacant seats following CAP Rounds 1, 2, and 3.

### Important Dates

| Event | 5-Year LLB | 3-Year LLB |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Display of Vacant Seats** | September 25, 2026 | September 25, 2026 |
| **New Registration & Form Editing** | Sep 26 to Sep 28, 2026 | Sep 27 to Sep 29, 2026 |
| **Submission of Fresh Choices** | Sep 26 to Sep 28, 2026 | Sep 27 to Sep 29, 2026 |
| **Generation & Publication of Merit List** | September 30, 2026 | September 30, 2026 |
| **Reporting to Allotted Institute** | Oct 01 to Oct 04, 2026 | Oct 01 to Oct 04, 2026 |
| **Cut-off Date for Admissions** | October 5, 2026 | October 5, 2026 |

### Eligibility & Key Guidelines
* Candidates who missed earlier rounds or wish to upgrade their allotted seat can participate in Round IV.
* **Mandatory Action:** Choices submitted in previous rounds will **not** carry forward; fresh options must be submitted.
* Confirm whether your preferred institute is actively participating in this round before submitting preferences.
* No admissions will be permitted past the cut-off date of **October 5, 2026**.

### Steps to Apply
1. Visit the respective CET portal (`llb3cap26.mahacet.org` or `llb5cap26.mahacet.org`).
2. Log in using your registration ID and Password.
3. Check the displayed vacant seat matrix for Round IV.
4. Fill/edit your application details and upload required documents.
5. Select and submit your fresh college choices.
6. Track the college merit list published on September 30, 2026, and report to the institute if selected.

website_content.title: TG SET Hall Ticket 2026 and Exam Schedule Released
website_content.summary: Osmania University, Hyderabad will release the hall ticket for the Telangana State Eligibility Test (TG SET) 2026 on 24 September 2026. The computer-based test is scheduled to be conducted on 28, 29, and 30 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TG SET 2026 Overview

Osmania University, Hyderabad is conducting the **Telangana State Eligibility Test (TG SET) 2026** in online Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode. Registered candidates will be able to download their hall tickets for Paper 1 and Paper 2 starting from **24 September 2026**.

* **Conducting Authority:** Osmania University, Hyderabad
* **Exam Name:** Telangana State Eligibility Test (TG SET) 2026
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Hall Ticket Release Date:** 24 September 2026
* **Exam Dates:** 28, 29, and 30 September 2026

## TG SET Exam Schedule 2026

The examination will be held across two shifts daily on 28, 29, and 30 September 2026:

* **28 September 2026 (Shift 1):** Geography, Life Sciences, Journalism and Mass Communication, Hindi, Sanskrit
* **28 September 2026 (Shift 2):** Education, Telugu, Urdu, Linguistics
* **29 September 2026 (Shift 1):** Commerce, Management, History, Philosophy, Sociology, Library and Information Science
* **29 September 2026 (Shift 2):** Mathematical Science, Physical Sciences, Psychology, Public Administration, Environmental Sciences
* **30 September 2026 (Shift 1):** Chemical Sciences, Economics, Earth Sciences, Political Science, Social Work
* **30 September 2026 (Shift 2):** Computer Science, English, Law

## How to Download TG SET Hall Ticket 2026

1. Visit the official TG SET portal.
2. Click on the TG SET Call Letter / Hall Ticket download link on the homepage.
3. Enter your **Application Number** and **Password**.
4. View your TG SET hall ticket on the screen and verify all details.
5. Download and print a clear copy to present at the examination center.

## Key Exam Day Instructions

* **Mandatory Documents:** Carry a printed copy of the hall ticket alongside a valid original photo ID proof.
* **Biometric Verification:** Biometric identification will be conducted at the center. Avoid applying mehendi, ink, or chemicals on your hands.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, and study material are strictly prohibited inside the hall.
* **Entry Gate Timing:** Late arrivals will not be permitted entry once the gates are closed.

website_content.title: IGNOU Faculty Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 43 Teaching Posts
website_content.summary: Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) is inviting online applications for 43 faculty positions including Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor. The deadline to apply online is October 20, 2026, with hard copies accepted till October 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## IGNOU Teaching Recruitment 2026 Overview

Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU), Academic Coordination Division (ACD), Maidan Garhi, New Delhi, has released Advertisement No. 01/2026/ACD inviting applications for 43 direct recruitment faculty posts across 14 Schools of Studies. Positions include Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor.

### Important Dates
* **Advertisement Date:** September 19, 2026
* **Online Application Start Date:** September 20, 2026
* **Online Application Last Date:** October 20, 2026 (or 30 days from publication in Employment News, whichever is later)
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline:** October 30, 2026

### Vacancy Details
* **Professor:** 21 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 16 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 6 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 43 Posts

#### Category Breakdown
* **Unreserved (UR):** 12
* **OBC (Non-Creamy Layer):** 15
* **SC:** 8
* **ST:** 5
* **PwBD:** 3

### Pay Scale
* **Professor:** Pay Level 14 (₹1,44,200 – ₹2,18,200)
* **Associate Professor:** Pay Level 13A (₹1,31,400 – ₹2,17,100)
* **Assistant Professor:** Pay Level 10 (₹57,700 – ₹1,82,400)

### Application Fee
* **UR / OBC / EWS:** ₹500
* **SC / ST / PwBD / Female Candidates:** Nil

### Eligibility Criteria
* **General:** Master's degree with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates) in the relevant subject.
* **Professor & Associate Professor:** Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied discipline along with required research publications and teaching/research experience as per UGC Regulations 2018 (or MCI/NCTE norms wherever applicable).
* **Age Limit:** Not prescribed in the official advertisement; determined based on standard UGC guidelines.

### Selection Process
1. **Screening & Shortlisting:** Screening Committee will evaluate candidates based on UGC scoring criteria/Appendix I criteria.
2. **Interview:** Up to 15 candidates per post will be called for the final interview by the Selection Committee.

### How to Apply
1. Fill the online application form on the official CU-IGNOU portal.
2. Upload all required educational certificates, experience proof, and research publications.
3. Pay the applicable application fee online.
4. Take a printout of the submitted application form.
5. Send the signed hard copy along with self-attested documents by registered/speed post to:  
   **The Director, Academic Coordination Division, IGNOU, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi-110068**  
   *(Ensure it reaches on or before October 30, 2026)*

website_content.markdown_content:
## MPPSC Assistant Professor (Hindi) Result 2026

The **Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore** has officially declared the written examination results for the Assistant Professor (Hindi) Exam 2025. This result contains the roll-number-wise list of candidates provisionally shortlisted for the interview stage.

### Key Details
* **Advertisement No.:** 10/2025/30.12.2025
* **Notice No.:** 9D85/17/2026/Anu-10
* **Exam Date:** August 2, 2026
* **Result Date:** September 22, 2026

### Important Dates for Shortlisted Candidates
* **Last Date for Document Submission:** 13 October 2026
* **Late Submission Window:** 14 October to 21 October 2026 (Late fee: ₹3,000)
* **Extreme Late Submission:** Up to 1 day before interview call letter (Late fee: ₹25,000)
* **Interview Date:** To be announced separately

### How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official website **mppsc.mp.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **Results** section.
3. Select the link for **"Written Exam Result - Assistant Professor (Hindi) Exam 2025"**.
4. Download the PDF and search for your roll number using **Ctrl + F**.

### Important Instructions
* The current shortlist is **provisional**.
* Candidates must ensure they meet all eligibility criteria mentioned in the original advertisement.
* Final selection is subject to the outcome of pending court matters/writ petitions.

website_content.markdown_content:
## AP AGRICET 2026 Rank Card Overview

The **Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU)** is set to announce the results of the Agriculture Common Entrance Test (AGRICET) 2026. The rank card is a critical document required for the subsequent counselling and seat allotment process.

### Key Highlights
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-based (online) test
* **Exam Date:** August 18, 2026
* **Result Format:** Rank Card (includes total marks, qualifying status, and statewide rank)
* **Expected Release Date:** September 24 to 28, 2026

### Important Dates
| Event | Date | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Computer-Based Exam | August 18, 2026 | Held |
| Result & Rank Card Release | Sept 24 - 28, 2026 | Expected |
| Web Counselling Notification | First week of October 2026 | Expected |

### How to Download Rank Card
1. Visit the official portal at **angrauagricet.aptonline.in**.
2. Click on the **AP AGRICET 2026 Rank Card/Result** link.
3. Enter your **Application Registration Number**, **Hall Ticket Number**, and **Date of Birth**.
4. Click **Submit** to view and download your rank card as a PDF.

### Candidate Instructions
* Ensure you download multiple printed copies of the rank card for physical verification.
* Verify all details (name, marks, and rank) immediately after downloading.
* Only trust official updates from `angrauagricet.aptonline.in` and `angrau.ac.in`.

The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially published the Choice-2 seat allotment list for the PGET (Post Graduate Entrance Test) Dental / MDS counselling 2026, Round 1 on **22 September 2026**.

### Overview of Choice-2 Allotment
Candidates who selected "Choice-2" during the first round are allotted a seat but remain eligible for an upgrade to a higher-preference seat in subsequent rounds while retaining their current seat as a backup.

### Important Dates
* **Round 1 Choice-2 Allotment List:** 22 September 2026
* **Round 2 Provisional Seat Allotment:** 23 September 2026
* **Round 2 Final Seat Allotment:** 24 September 2026

2. Navigate to the **PGET / NEET MDS 2026 Counselling** section.
3. Locate the link titled **"List of Choice-2 Seats Allotted in the First Round"**.
4. Open the PDF and use `Ctrl+F` to search for your course code, college, or category.

### Critical Instructions
* **Verification:** Always verify allotment status through the official KEA login rather than third-party sites.
* **Reporting:** Ensure you report to the allotted seat within the specified window to avoid penalties for blocking seats.
* **Documentation:** Keep a printed copy of your submitted options for every round.

website_content.markdown_content:
## KLEE 2026 Vacant Seat (Mop-up) Allotment Overview

The Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala, has released the **Vacant Seat Final Allotment Result** for admission to the 3-Year LLB and 5-Year Integrated LLB courses. This allotment is part of the Centralised Allotment Process (CAP) and is designated for candidates who registered fresh or revised their options during the mop-up round.

### Key Details
* **Conducting Body:** Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala
* **Exam Name:** Kerala Law Entrance Examination (KLEE) 2026
* **Courses Covered:** 3-Year LLB and Integrated 5-Year LLB

### Important Dates

* **Fresh Option Registration (5-Year LLB):** September 15, 2026
* **Option Registration Deadline:** September 18, 2026 (10:00 AM)
* **Final Allotment Result Released:** September 22, 2026

### Step-by-Step Guide to Check Result
1. Visit the official **CEE Kerala** website.
2. Select the **'Three Year LLB 2026'** or **'Integrated Five Year LLB 2026'** candidate portal.

website_content.title: Madras High Court e-Sewa Kendra Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: High Court of Madras invites online applications for 115 Data Entry Operator positions on a contract basis across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. The application deadline is September 29, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **High Court of Madras** is recruiting for **Data Entry Operators** to serve in e-Sewa Kendras. This is a contractual position with a consolidated monthly pay of **₹15,000**.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 23.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 29.09.2026
* **Written-cum-Skill Test:** 10.10.2026 / 11.10.2026 (Tentative)
* **Viva Voce:** 24.10.2026 / 25.10.2026 (Tentative)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age Limit:** Between 18 and 35 years (as of 01.09.2026). 
* **Educational Qualification:** Must possess any one of the following degrees:
    * B.Sc (Computer Science / IT)
    * BCA / MCA
    * B.E / B.Tech / M.E / M.Tech (Computer Science)
    * M.Sc (Computer Science / IT)

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 115 Data Entry Operators
* **Distribution:** Principal Seat of Madras High Court, 36 districts of Tamil Nadu, and Puducherry.
* **Crucial Note:** Candidates can apply for **only one district**. Multiple applications will lead to summary rejection.

## Selection Process
1. **Written Examination (25 Marks):** MCQs covering Windows/Linux, Networking, PDF handling, Video Conferencing, Hardware Troubleshooting, and Internet basics.
2. **Skill Test (25 Marks):** Practical testing on OCR, LibreOffice, LAN configuration, and Driver installations.
3. **Viva Voce (50 Marks):** Final assessment of mental alertness, skills, and attitude.

## Nature of Work
* Handling case status inquiries and facilitating e-filing of petitions.
* Assisting in Video Conference (VC) hearings.
* Managing data entry for e-services and assisting with Aadhaar-based digital signatures.
* Guiding the public on e-courts mobile apps and legal services.

website_content.title: Madras High Court DEO Recruitment 2026 - Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: Madras High Court is recruiting for Data Entry Operator (DEO) positions for 2026. The selection process consists of a Written Test, Skill Test, and Viva Voce.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Madras High Court DEO Recruitment 2026

The Madras High Court has outlined the recruitment process and detailed syllabus for the post of **Data Entry Operator (DEO) 2026**. Candidates are evaluated based on their technical proficiency in computer operations and hardware troubleshooting.

### Selection Process
The selection is conducted through three mandatory stages:
* **Written Test:** Objective-type test focusing on computer knowledge (**25 Marks**).
* **Skill Test:** Practical hands-on test including scanning, OCR, and network configuration (**25 Marks**).
* **Viva Voce:** Interview evaluating mental alertness, ethics, and subject knowledge (**50 Marks**).

**Total Marks:** 100

### Exam Pattern & Qualifying Marks
| Selection Stage | Maximum Marks | Minimum Qualifying Marks |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Written Test | 25 | 10 |
| Skill Test | 25 | 10 |
| Viva Voce | 50 | 20 |

### Detailed Written Syllabus
1. **Windows and Linux Basics:** OS concepts, file/folder management, user permissions, and basic commands.
2. **Networking:** LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, routers, firewalls, and troubleshooting.
3. **PDF & Document Processing:** Document creation, OCR, PDF conversion/merging, and Office/Excel basics.
4. **Video Conferencing:** Hardware configuration, WebEx, Microsoft Teams, and audio/video troubleshooting.
5. **Hardware Troubleshooting:** CPU, RAM, HDD/SSD, motherboard, printer/scanner installation, and maintenance.
6. **Internet Basics:** Web browsers, URLs, Cloud services, Cybersecurity, phishing, and malware protection.

### Skill Test Practical Components
* Scanning and converting documents using **OCR**.
* Proficiency in **LibreOffice**.
* Configuring a **Local Area Network (LAN)** and IP settings.
* Hardware driver installation and fault diagnosis.

website_content.title: AP PGCET 2026 Phase 1 Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: APSCHE will release the AP PGCET 2026 Phase 1 Seat Allotment results on September 23, 2026. Candidates must complete online self-reporting and physical college reporting by September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AP PGCET 2026 Phase 1 Seat Allotment Overview

The Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) is managing the admission process for Post Graduate courses via the AP PGCET 2026. The Phase 1 Seat Allotment determines the college and course allocated to eligible candidates based on their rank and preferences.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Result Declaration:** September 23, 2026 (Expected)
* **Download Provisional Allotment Order:** September 22 to 25, 2026
* **Online Self-Reporting & Physical Reporting:** September 22 to 25, 2026 (Deadline: 5:00 PM on Sept 25)

### 🛠️ How to Check Allotment Result
1. Visit the official CAP portal.
2. Click on the **AP PGCET 2026 Phase 1 Seat Allotment Result** link.
3. Log in using your **Hall Ticket Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. View the allotted college and course, then download the provisional allotment order and fee receipt.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Certificates:** BC Non-Creamy Layer certificates must be issued on or after April 1, 2026.
* **Quota Verification:** Local status (85% AU/SVU) requires 7-year continuous study certificates; non-locals (15%) need valid residence certificates.
* **Special Categories:** PH/CAP/NCC/Sports candidates must provide the original verification acknowledgment slip from the Sept 9 session.
* **Pending Results:** Candidates awaiting final degree marks must submit a certified web-marks statement and a 15-day provisional undertaking.
* **Fee Reimbursement:** Eligible candidates under Jagananna Vidya Deevena (White Rice Card/Income Certificate) are exempt from upfront tuition fees.
* **Biometrics:** Aadhaar-based biometric registration is mandatory at the department office after joining.

website_content.title: CSIR-NML Project Staff Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: CSIR-NML Jamshedpur is recruiting for 48 temporary project positions across 32 projects. Candidates must attend walk-in interviews from October 6 to 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
CSIR-National Metallurgical Laboratory (NML), Jamshedpur, has released an advertisement (No. T/PS/04/2026) for the engagement of project staff on a purely temporary and contract basis. This recruitment is for 32 time-bound projects across 8 groups (A–H).

## Vacancy Details
**Total Positions:** 48
**Posts Available:**
* Project Assistant-I (PA-I)
* Project Assistant-II (PA-II)
* Scientific Administrative Assistant (SAA)
* Project Associate-I (PAT-I)
* Project Associate-II (PAT-II)
* Project-JRF
* Project Scientist-I (PS-I)

## Eligibility & Emoluments
| Post | Qualification | Emoluments | Age Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PA-I** | 10th + ITI / Diploma | ₹18,000 + HRA | 35 Yrs |
| **PA-II** | Diploma / B.Sc. | ₹20,000 + HRA | 35 Yrs |
| **SAA** | B.Sc. IT / BCA | ₹24,000 + HRA | 50 Yrs |
| **Project-JRF** | B.Tech + NET/GATE | ₹37,000 + HRA | 28 Yrs |
| **PAT-I** | B.Tech / M.Sc. | ₹25,000 - ₹31,000 + HRA | 35 Yrs |
| **PAT-II** | M.Tech/M.Sc + 2y Exp | ₹28,000 - ₹35,000 + HRA | 35 Yrs |
| **PS-I** | Ph.D. + 2y Exp | ₹77,000 + HRA | 50 Yrs |

*Note: Age relaxations apply for SC/ST/PwBD/Women (5 years) and OBC (3 years).* 

## Walk-in Interview Schedule
Candidates must report at **CSIR-NML, Burmamines, Jamshedpur** between **9:00 AM and 11:00 AM** on the following dates:
* **Group A & B:** 06 October 2026
* **Group C & D:** 07 October 2026
* **Group E & F:** 08 October 2026
* **Group G & H:** 09 October 2026

## Selection Process
* **Mode:** Walk-in Interview / Test. 
* **Screening:** A written test may be conducted if the number of candidates is high.
* **Application:** No online or postal applications. Candidates must bring a filled application form and original documents in person.

## Mandatory Documents
* Filled Project Staff Application Form with photo.
* Educational certificates (10th, 12th, Degree, Ph.D.).
* NET/GATE certificates (if applicable).
* Experience certificates and category certificates.
* Aadhaar Card and PAN Card.

website_content.title: Ladakh Central Pool MBBS BDS Admission 2026 Guidelines
website_content.summary: The H&ME Department of UT Ladakh has revised admission guidelines for 9 Central Pool medical seats (7 MBBS, 2 BDS), shifting to a single NEET merit-based selection process.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Health & Medical Education (H&ME) Department, Union Territory of Ladakh, has issued revised guidelines for admission to MBBS and BDS seats under the Central Pool for the 2026-27 academic session. The new system eliminates the roster-based category system in favor of a pure meritocracy.

## Seat Matrix (2026-27)
* **Total Seats:** 9
* **MBBS Seats:** 7
* **BDS Seats:** 2

## Key Eligibility & Selection Criteria
* **Required Qualification:** Candidates must have a **valid NEET ranking** for the applicable year.
* **Selection Method:** Selection is based strictly on a **single merit list** derived from NEET rankings and the choices exercised by the candidates.
* **Waiting List:** A single UT Ladakh waiting list will be maintained and filled strictly in order of merit.

## Comparison: Old vs. New System
| Aspect | 2021 Guidelines (Old) | 2026 Amendment (New) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Selection Method** | Category-wise roster system | Single merit list (NEET) |
| **Categories** | District/Gender/Reserved | No separate categories |
| **Domicile** | Linked to Leh/Kargil districts | Not linked to domicile district |

## Application Process
1. Visit the official UT Ladakh Administration website.
2. Locate the Central Pool MBBS/BDS Seat admission notification issued by the H&ME Department.
3. Register/Login on the official Ladakh NIC portal.
4. Submit the application with NEET ranking and required documents within the **7-day application window**.

## Overview
The Selection Committee, **Directorate of Medical Education and Research (DME), Chennai**, is conducting the online counselling process for admission to **Master of Pharmacy (M.Pharm)** degree courses for the 2026-2027 academic session.

## Important Dates
* **Registration & Payment:** September 22, 2026, to September 23, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 24, 2026, to September 26, 2026
* **Final Result / Allotment:** September 28, 2026
* **Download Provisional Allotment Order:** September 29, 2026, to October 1, 2026

1. Visit the official portal **tnmedicalselection.net**.
2. Log in using your registered login ID/exam number and password.
3. Complete the online processing fee payment (if applicable).

7. Report to the allotted college with original documents by the deadline.

* **Choice Locking:** Once locked, choices cannot be edited. Unlocked choices will be auto-locked by the system.
* **Upgradation:** Candidates opting for upgradation in Round 2 must vacate their Round 1 seat.
* **Eligibility:** Candidates who failed to join a seat previously may be ineligible for subsequent rounds; check the official notice for verification.

website_content.markdown_content:
## TMB Recruitment 2026 Overview
Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited (TMB) has announced openings for experienced banking professionals to join as **Relationship Managers** and **Senior Relationship Managers** on a regular basis.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 23 September 2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 07 October 2026

### 💼 Post Details & Eligibility

#### 1. Relationship Manager (Manager/Assistant Manager)
* **Qualification:** Graduation or Postgraduate degree with minimum **60% marks**.
* **Experience:** 
    * **Manager Rank:** Minimum 3 years of relevant banking experience.
    * **Assistant Manager Rank:** Minimum 2 years of relevant banking experience.
    * **Specialization:** Sourcing/processing of MSME or retail loans.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum 35 years (as of 31 August 2026).

#### 2. Senior Relationship Manager (Senior Manager/AVP)
* **Qualification:** Graduate or Postgraduate degree from a recognized university.
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years in sourcing/processing loans or MSME loans, with at least **3 years specifically as a Relationship Manager**.
* **Age Limit:** 28 to 38 years (as of 31 August 2026).

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Relationship Manager:** Salary as per Manager or Assistant Manager cadre.
* **Senior Relationship Manager:** Remuneration as per regular Senior Manager or Assistant Vice President officers.

### 🛠 Selection Process
1. **Application Scrutiny:** Review of online submissions.
2. **Shortlisting:** Based on eligibility, qualification, and experience.
3. **Personal Interview:** Conducted directly or via video conferencing.
4. **Final Selection:** Decision by the bank.

### 📄 Documents Required for Upload
* Age proof (SSLC/HSC marksheet)
* Educational certificates (Degree/PG)
* Experience and Relieving letters
* Latest monthly salary slip
* Recent photograph (390 × 520 px, max 120 KB)
* Signature (240 × 240 px, max 60 KB)

website_content.markdown_content:
## Abhyudaya Bank Recruitment 2026 Overview

Abhyudaya Co-operative Bank Limited is seeking experienced professionals for various executive and managerial roles across multiple departments in **Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Pune**.

### Important Dates
* **Opening Date for Online Applications:** 25 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply Online:** 05 October 2026

### Vacancy Details & Eligibility

| Department | Designation | Qualification | Experience | Age Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Business Development** | AGM/Chief Manager/Manager | Bachelor's Degree | 5+ years (Preferably Co-op/Private Bank) | < 45 Years |
| **Recovery** | DGM/AGM | Bachelor's Degree (CAIIB/Law preferred) | 15+ years in Recovery/Legal | < 55 Years |
| **Legal** | Chief Manager/Manager | Bachelor's Degree + LLB/LLM | 5-7 years in Legal/Recovery | < 45 Years |
| **Vigilance** | AGM/Chief Manager | Bachelor's Degree | 5+ years in Vigilance | < 50 Years |
| **Inspection** | AGM/Chief Manager | Bachelor's Degree (CAIIB preferred) | 10-15 years (5 years in Inspection) | 40-50 Years |
| **HRM** | AGM/Chief Manager | Full-time MBA in HR | 10+ years in HR Operations | < 50 Years |
| **Premises & Estate** | AGM/Chief Manager | Bachelor's Degree (BE Civil preferred) | 10-15 years relevant experience | < 50 Years |
| **Credit Officer** | Chief Manager/Manager | Bachelor's Degree (CA/CFA/ICWA preferred) | 5-7 years in Credit Portfolio | < 50 Years |

### Selection Process
1. **Preliminary Screening:** Shortlisting based on qualifications and experience.
2. **Personal Interview:** Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.
3. **Final Selection:** Based on interview performance and previous track record.

### Key Responsibilities
* **Credit/Recovery:** Analyzing portfolios, managing NPAs, and initiating SARFAESI proceedings.
* **Legal/Vigilance:** Drafting agreements, handling DRT/NCLT cases, and ensuring RBI compliance.
* **HRM/Admin:** Managing payroll, disciplinary actions, and bank property maintenance.
* **Business Development:** Deposit mobilization and strategic tie-ups.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The **Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force (ITBP)** is seeking eligible candidates for the post of **Head Constable (Education and Stress Counsellor)**. This is a Group C, Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial position under the General Central Service.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 16
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 25,500 - 81,100 (Pay Level 4)
* **Job Location:** All India (may include foreign postings)
* **Application Mode:** Online

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 28 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 27 October 2026
* **Age Calculation Date:** 27 October 2026

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
Candidates must possess one of the following:
* A Degree from a recognized university with **Psychology** as a subject; OR
* A Degree from a recognized university along with **Bachelor of Education (B.Ed)** or **Bachelor of Teaching** (or equivalent).

### Age Limit
* **Minimum Age:** 20 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 25 Years
* *Note: Age relaxation is applicable for ST, OBC, and Ex-Servicemen as per government rules.*

## Application Fee
* **General / Other Candidates:** Rs. 100
* **Female / SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen:** No Fee (Nil)

## Selection Process
1. Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
2. Physical Standard Test (PST)
3. Written Examination
4. Verification of Original Documents
5. Detailed Medical Examination
6. Review Medical Examination (if applicable)

website_content.summary: State CET Cell Maharashtra will release the B.Pharma and Pharm.D CAP Round 1 Seat Matrix on September 22, 2026. Candidates can fill their option forms between September 23 and September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The State Common Entrance Test Cell (CET Cell), under the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) Maharashtra, is conducting the **Centralized Admission Process (CAP)** for B.Pharmacy and Pharm.D courses for the 2026 academic session.

## Key Highlights
* **Courses Covered:** B.Pharmacy and Pharm.D
* **Process:** CAP Round 1 Admissions
* **Primary Action:** Checking category-wise vacant seats via the Seat Matrix before filling option forms.

## Important Dates
| Activity | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Seat Matrix Release (Expected)** | September 22, 2026 |
| **Option Form Filling Window** | September 23 - 25, 2026 |
| **Provisional Seat Allotment** | September 27, 2026 |
| **Seat Confirmation & Fee Payment** | September 28 - 30, 2026 |
| **Physical Reporting at Institute** | September 28 - 30, 2026 |

## Steps to Check Seat Matrix
1. Visit the official portal **ph2026.mahacet.org**.
2. Locate the **CAP Round 1 Seat Matrix** link on the homepage.
3. Download the PDF to verify category-wise vacancies for your preferred institutes.
4. Use this data to strategically fill your option form during the window.

## Important Instructions
* Ensure you verify your **final merit rank** before selecting colleges.

website_content.title: GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Government Medical College, Narayanpet is inviting offline applications for 149 outsourcing positions across 35 different categories. The application deadline is September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Office of the Principal, Government Medical College, Narayanpet, has announced vacancies for various technical, administrative, and support staff roles on an **outsourcing basis**. The engagement is valid until March 31, 2027, or until regular posts are filled.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Issue Date:** 2026-08-12
* **Paper Notification Date:** 2026-09-15
* **Last Date for Application:** 2026-09-30

## Vacancy & Eligibility Highlights
There are **149 total vacancies** spread across 35 categories. Key roles include:
* **Nursing Officer:** B.Sc. Nursing
* **Data Entry Operator (46 posts):** Degree with PG Diploma in Computer Application
* **Lab Attendant (20 posts):** Intermediate Medical Lab Assistant Vocational Course
* **Office Subordinate (20 posts):** Passed VII to X class
* **Technicians (Anaesthesia, CT, ECG, Blood Bank):** Respective Diplomas/Degrees as per TGPMB registration
* **Administrative/Support:** Assistant Librarian, Driver, Electrician, Plumber, and more.

## Monthly Remuneration
* **Technical/Specialist Posts:** ₹22,750 - ₹25,140
* **Administrative/Support Staff:** ₹19,500
* **Supportive/General Staff:** ₹15,600

## Application Process
1. **Mode:** Offline submission.
2. **Form:** Download the prescribed application form from the official website.
3. **Fee:** ₹500 via Demand Draft (SBI) in favour of "Superintendent, Govt. General Hospital, Hospital Development Society, Narayanpet".
4. **Submission:** Submit the filled form along with Xerox copies of certificates and original documents for scrutiny by September 30, 2026.

website_content.title: CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The CRPF is inviting online applications for 521 vacancies of Head Constable (GD) and Constable (GD) under the Sports Quota. The application window closes on 11 November 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Directorate General, Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF), Ministry of Home Affairs, has released an advertisement for the recruitment of **Head Constable (GD) and Constable (GD)** under the Sports Quota for the year 2026. This is an All India service liability recruitment across 22 different sports disciplines.

## Important Dates
* **Online Application Start:** 12 October 2026 (9:00 AM)
* **Last Date to Apply & Pay Fee:** 11 November 2026 (23:59 hrs)
* **Correction Window:** 12 November to 14 November 2026
* **Eligible Achievement Window:** 30 September 2024 to 30 September 2026

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 521
* **Head Constable (HC/GD):** 182 Posts
* **Constable (CT/GD):** 339 Posts
* **Disciplines:** Includes Athletics, Shooting, Kabaddi, Wrestling, Football, Boxing, Judo, and 14 other disciplines.

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **HC/GD:** 10+2 or equivalent from a recognized Board/University.
* **CT/GD:** Matriculation (10th) or equivalent from a recognized Board.

### Sports Qualification
* **HC/GD:** International representation, National Games medal (up to 3rd), or AIU Inter-University gold/silver.
* **CT/GD:** State representation in National level games, SGFI school national medal (up to 3rd), or Khelo India medal.

## Age Limit (as of 01 August 2026)
* **General Age:** 18 to 23 Years
* **Relaxation:** UR (5 years), OBC (8 years), SC/ST (10 years). Additional relaxations apply for Ex-Servicemen.

## Pay Scale (7th CPC)
* **Head Constable (GD):** Level 4 (Rs. 25,500 – 81,100)
* **Constable (GD):** Level 3 (Rs. 21,700 – 69,100)

## Selection Process
1. **Documentation:** Verification of age, education, and sports certificates.
2. **Merit Marking:** Marks awarded based on the highest medal/position achieved in the eligible window.
3. **Physical Standard Test (PST):** Height and Chest measurements.
4. **Sports Trial Test:** Qualifying trial conducted by a Board of Officers.
5. **Medical Examination:** Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME).

website_content.title: CPCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) is inviting applications for Trade, Technician, and Graduate Apprentices. Eligible candidates must apply through NAPS/NATS portals by October 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CPCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview
Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) has released a notification (HRD:03:26) for the engagement of apprentices across various trades for the 2026-27 batch.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Release Date:** 22.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply Online:** 12.10.2026

## Post Details & Registration Portals
Candidates must register on the specific portal based on their trade:

**NAPS Portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in):**
* Trade Apprentice (ITI Passed)
* Laboratory Assistant (Chemical Plant)
* Guest House Service Asst.
* Secretarial Office Assistant – Oil & Gas
* Executive (HR) – Oil & Gas
* Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator

**NATS Portal (nats.education.gov.in):**
* Graduate Apprentice (Non-Engineering)
* Graduate Apprentice (Engineering)
* Technician Apprentice (Diploma in Engineering)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 26 years as of 01.10.2026 (Relaxation as per Govt norms).
* **Academic Qualification:** 
    * **ITI:** Fitter, Welder, Electrician, etc. (NCVT/SCVT).
    * **Graduate:** BE/B.Tech, B.Sc, BA, B.Com, BCA, BBA, MBA(HR).
    * **Diploma:** Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, etc.
    * **10th/12th:** For Guest House Asst and Data Entry Operator roles.
* **Marks:** Minimum 60% (55% for SC/ST/PwBD) in qualifying exams.
* **Passing Year:** Candidates who passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible.

## Stipend Details
* **Range:** Rs. 4,800 to Rs. 12,300 per month based on trade.
* **NATS Note:** 50% of the stipend for NATS apprentices is paid via Direct Beneficiary Transfer (DBT).

## Selection Process
* Selection will be based on a **merit list** prepared from the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination. No written test or interview is specified.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Uttarakhand Board of School Education (UBSE)** has officially released the admit cards for the **Uttarakhand Teacher Eligibility Test (UTET) 2026**. This test is essential for candidates seeking eligibility to teach in primary and upper primary schools across Uttarakhand.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 14 July 2026
* **Online Application Period:** 14 July to 3 August 2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 6 August 2026
* **Correction Window:** 8 to 11 August 2026

* **Admit Card Status:** Released

| **UTET-I** | Primary (Classes I–V) | 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM |
| **UTET-II** | Upper Primary (Classes VI–VIII) | 02:00 PM to 04:30 PM |

## Qualifying Marks
| Category | Qualifying Percentage | Marks (out of 150) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **General** | 60% | 90 |
| **OBC / SC / ST / PwD** | 50% | 75 |

## Exam Pattern
* **Mode:** Offline (OMR-based MCQs)
* **Negative Marking:** No negative marking
* **Total Questions/Marks:** 150

## Mandatory Documents for Exam Centre
* Printed copy of the **UTET Admit Card 2026**
* **Valid Photo ID Proof:** (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or Passport)
* Passport-size photograph (if specifically requested on the admit card)

website_content.title: UPPSC PCS Interview Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: UPPSC has released the interview schedule and admit card download details for the Combined State/Upper Subordinate Services (Mains) Exam-2025. Eligible candidates can download their interview letters starting September 22, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC)** has issued Notice No. 260/01/ई-3/2025-26 regarding the interview schedule for the **Combined State/Upper Subordinate Services (Mains) Exam-2025 (UPPSC PCS)**. Candidates who successfully cleared the Mains examination are now eligible to download their interview admit cards.

## Important Dates
* **Mains Result Declared:** 17 September 2026
* **Interview Letter Download Starts:** 22 September 2026
* **Interview Period:** 28 September 2026 to 24 October 2026

## Interview Details
* **Venue:** Saraswati Bhavan, UPPSC Campus, Prayagraj
* **Reporting Time (Session 1):** 08:00 AM
* **Reporting Time (Session 2):** 12:30 PM
* **Login Credentials:** OTR (One Time Registration) Number and Password/OTP

## Required Documents for Interview
Candidates must carry the following mandatory documents:
* **Printed Set:** Application Form, Verification Form, Affidavit, Marks Statement, and Preference Form.
* **Photographs:** 5 passport-size photographs (2 self-attested, 3 plain).
* **Educational Certificates:** Original certificates and mark sheets of all qualifications along with self-attested copies.
* **Category Certificates:** Valid Caste/EWS certificates in the prescribed format.
* **NOC:** Original No Objection Certificate for candidates currently employed with Central/State Government.
* **ID Proof:** A valid government-issued photo ID.

## How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official UPPSC portal.
2. Click on the link for **'Download Interview Letter for Combined State/Upper Subordinate Services Exam-2025'**.
3. Authenticate using your **OTR Number** and password/OTP.
4. Access the Applicant Dashboard and click **'Check Latest Status'**.
5. Fill out the online preference form, save, and submit.
6. Download and print all five mandatory documents.

website_content.summary: The Higher Education Department (HED), Odisha has opened Phase 2 admissions for undergraduate (+3) courses. Candidates must submit their CAF by September 20, 2026, for merit-based seat allotment.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SAMS Odisha +3 Degree Admission 2026

The Higher Education Department (HED), Odisha is facilitating admissions for various undergraduate (+3) courses including **BA, B.Sc (Hons), and B.Com (Hons)** through the Student Academic Management System (SAMS) portal. Admission is strictly merit-based, calculated from marks obtained in Class 12 or equivalent examinations.

### 📅 Important Dates (Phase 2)
* **CAF Availability:** September 10, 2026
* **Last Date for CAF Submission:** September 20, 2026
* **First Round Seat Allotment:** September 23, 2026 (Expected)
* **College Reporting & Admission:** September 24 to 26, 2026
* **Waiting List Registration:** September 28 to 29, 2026
* **Final Admission Data Updation:** October 3 to 7, 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility & Process
* **Qualification:** Must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination.
* **Mode:** Entirely online process through the SAMS portal.
* **Selection:** Based on merit scores.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Preferences:** Enter stream, Higher Education Institution (HEI), and honours preferences with extreme care; errors can negatively impact seat allotment.
* **Documentation:** All documents presented at the admission counter must be signed with the phrase "Submitted by me".
* **Contact Details:** Do not modify registered mobile numbers, email IDs, or bank accounts until the completion of the course.

website_content.markdown_content:
## WB JEPBN 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment

The **West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB)** has announced the Round 2 Seat Allotment results for the Joint Entrance Paper for Post Basic B.Sc Nursing (JEPBN) 2026. Candidates who have been allotted a seat must act quickly to secure their admission.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Result Declaration:** September 22, 2026
* **Seat Acceptance Fee & Reporting:** September 22 to September 24, 2026 (until 5 PM)
* **Online Seat Withdrawal Window:** September 22 to September 24, 2026
* **Round 3 Choice Filling:** September 25 to September 27, 2026

### 🛠️ Steps to Check Result
1. Visit the official website **wbjeeb.nic.in**.
2. Click on the **JEPBN Examination** link.
3. Select **'View Seat Allotment Result for Round 2 JEPBN Counselling 2026'**.
4. Log in using your **Application Number, Password, and Security PIN**.
5. View your allotted institute, course, quota, and General Merit Rank (GMR).

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Acceptance Fee:** Newly allotted candidates must pay a fee of **Rs. 5,000**.
* **Reporting:** Candidates must report to the allotted institute with the provisional seat allotment letter by **September 24, 2026, 5 PM**.
* **Cancellation:** Failure to pay the fee and complete document verification by the deadline will lead to the cancellation of the allotted seat.
* **Upgradation:** Candidates wishing to float or upgrade can participate in Round 3 choice filling starting September 25.

website_content.markdown_content:
## MP NEET UG Mop-Up Round (Round 3) Counselling 2026

The **Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Madhya Pradesh**, is conducting the Mop-Up Round (Round 3) for the allotment of vacant **MBBS and BDS seats** in medical and dental colleges across the state. This round provides a final opportunity for eligible NEET UG candidates to secure admission.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Registration:** September 28, 2026, to October 2, 2026
* **Publication of Revised State Merit List:** October 3, 2026
* **Choice Filling and Locking:** October 4 to October 7, 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility & Purpose
* **Purpose:** Filling of remaining vacant seats in MBBS and BDS courses.
* **Eligibility:** Candidates who have qualified for NEET UG and meet the state's eligibility criteria.

### 📝 Registration Process
1. Visit the official DME MP portal.
2. Complete the **Online Registration** between Sept 28 and Oct 2.
3. Monitor the portal for the **Revised State Merit List** on Oct 3.
4. Log in to **fill and lock college preferences** between Oct 4 and Oct 7.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Mode of Application:** Registration is strictly **Online only**.
* **Deadline:** Applications submitted after October 2, 2026, will not be accepted.
* **Choice Locking:** Candidates must lock their choices by October 7 to be considered for seat allotment; failure to do so will result in non-allotment.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
CBSE has officially published the **Sample Question Papers (SQP)** along with **Marking Schemes (MS)** for the 2026-27 academic session. These documents provide students with a clear understanding of the exam pattern and marking criteria.

## Key Details
* **Conducting Body:** Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
* **Class:** 12 (XII)
* **Academic Session:** 2026-27
* **Applicable For:** Board Exams 2027
* **Release Date:** 21 September 2026

## How to Download
1. Visit the official CBSE Academic website: **cbseacademic.nic.in**.
2. Navigate to the **'Curriculum'** section or locate **'Sample Question Papers'** on the homepage.
3. Select **'Class XII'** and choose the **2026-27** session.
4. Click the **'SQP'** link to download the question paper and the **'MS'** link for the marking scheme for your specific subject.

## Important Instructions
* **Official Source:** Only download materials from `cbseacademic.nic.in` to ensure authenticity.
* **Verification:** Confirm that the PDF is explicitly labeled for the **2026-27 session** to avoid using outdated formats.
* **Combined Study:** Always download the Marking Scheme (MS) alongside the Sample Paper (SQP) for accurate self-assessment.
* **Syllabus Check:** Cross-verify the sample papers with the latest CBSE-prescribed syllabus and textbooks.

website_content.markdown_content:
## BU Jhansi Odd Semester Result 2026

Bundelkhand University (BU) Jhansi has officially announced the results for students who appeared in the **odd semester examinations** for the 2025-26 academic session. Students can now access their provisional marksheets online using their roll number or registration ID.

### Key Result Details
* **Academic Session:** 2025-26
* **Semesters Covered:** 1st, 3rd, and 5th Semesters
* **Courses Included:** 
    * **UG Programmes:** BA, BSc, BCom, BSc Home Science, etc.
    * **PG Programmes:** MA (History, Education, English, Hindi, Home Science), MCom, and other courses
* **Mode of Result:** Online

### How to Check Your Result
**Method 1: Via Official Website**
1. Visit the main university portal.
2. Navigate to the **Examination** section and select **Results**.
3. Click on **View Results** and choose your specific course.
4. Enter your roll number and semester to view the result.

**Method 2: Via Result Portal**
1. Go directly to the official examination portal (`exam.bujhansi.ac.in`).
2. Click on the **View Result** option.
3. Select your course and semester from the dropdown menu.
4. Input your roll number and submit to download your provisional marksheet.

### Important Instructions
* Ensure you have your **roll number/registration number** ready.
* Note that the online result is **provisional**; students should contact their college for the final official document.
* Only use official university portals to avoid misinformation.

## Recruitment Overview
Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) have released an indicative notice for **CEN No. 07/2026** regarding the recruitment of undergraduate-level posts in Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC).

website_content.markdown_content:
## KVS Ambala Cantt Recruitment 2026

PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalayas No. 1, 2, 3, and 4, Ambala Cantt are conducting a walk-in interview to prepare a contractual panel for various teaching and support positions for the **Academic Session 2026-27**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Walk-in Interview Date:** 25 September 2026
* **Registration Time:** 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM
* **Interview Time:** 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM

### 🏫 Interview Venue
**PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 2, Ambala Cantt, Haryana - 133001**

### 📋 Available Posts
* **PGT:** Physics, Computer Science
* **TGT:** Mathematics, Sanskrit, Science
* **Special Educators & Counselors**
* **Instructors:** ATL Instructor, Vocational Teacher, Yoga Teacher, Self-Defence Instructor (Girls)
* **Sports Teacher/Coach**

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **PGT:** Master's degree in relevant subject (50% marks) + B.Ed.
* **TGT:** Relevant Bachelor's degree (50% marks) + B.Ed. + **CTET Paper II (Mandatory)**.
* **Special Educator:** Bachelor's degree + B.Ed. in Special Education + CTET + RCI Registration.
* **ATL/Vocational Instructor:** Bachelor's in Electronics/ECE (50% marks) + B.Ed.
* **Sports/Coach:** Bachelor's in Physical Education + State/National level representation.
* **Yoga Teacher:** Bachelor's degree + One-year Yoga training.
* **Counselor:** BA/B.Sc. in Psychology + Diploma in Counseling.

### 💰 Monthly Honorarium
* **ATL / Sports / Vocational Instructor:** Rs. 25,000 per month
* **Self-Defence Instructor:** Rs. 10,000 per month
* **Others:** As per KVS contractual engagement rules.

### 📝 How to Apply (Walk-in Process)
1. Download the application form from the official school website.
2. Fill the form completely (separate form for each post applied for).
3. Attend the walk-in interview at the venue on **25 September 2026**.
4. Ensure registration is completed between **9:00 AM and 11:00 AM**.

### 📂 Documents Required
* Completed application form
* Original educational certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies
* CTET/RCI certificates (where applicable)
* Experience and Professional/Sports certificates
* Recent passport-size photographs and valid ID proof

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has published the provisional answer key for the competitive examination conducted for the recruitment of **Police Constable, Karnataka State Reserve Police (KSRP) - Residual Parent Cadre (RPC)**.

## Key Examination Details
* **Exam Date:** 20 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 21 September 2026
* **Subject:** General Knowledge (RPC)
* **Question Paper Versions:** 8 Versions (A1, B1, C1, D1, A2, B2, C2, D2)
* **Total Questions:** 100

## Objection Window & Fee
Candidates who wish to challenge the provisional answer key must adhere to the following:
* **Objection Period:** 21 September 2026 to 23 September 2026 (up to 10:30 AM)
* **Objection Fee:** ₹25/- per objection (Non-refundable)
* **Submission Mode:** Online only via the KEA CET portal

## Steps to Raise Objections
1. Visit the official **KEA CET Online portal**.
2. Log in and select the option to raise objections for the **KSRP Police Constable (RPC)** answer key.
3. Enter the subject name, exam date, version code, and question number.
4. Upload supporting evidence/documents in **PDF format**.
5. Pay the required fee of ₹25 per objection and submit before the deadline.

website_content.summary: Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS) has released the Phase 1 college-wise seat allotment list for MDS admissions 2026-27. Candidates who participated in the first phase of counselling can now verify their allotted colleges.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS) has officially released the **College-wise Seat Allotment List** for Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) admissions for the academic year 2026-27 under the Competent Authority Quota. This list is applicable for candidates who exercised web options during the first phase of counselling.

## Important Dates
* **MDS Admission Notification:** August 19, 2026
* **Online Registration Deadline:** August 25, 2026
* **Final Merit List Released:** September 19, 2026
* **Phase 1 Web Options:** September 19 to September 21, 2026
* **Phase 1 Allotment List Release:** September 22, 2026

## Steps to Check Allotment List
1. Visit the official KNRUHS website.
2. Navigate to the **Notifications** section on the homepage.
3. Locate the link: *"MDS Admissions under Competent Authority Quota for AY 2026-27 - College Wise Allotment List - First Phase of Counselling."*
4. Download the PDF and use **Ctrl+F** to search for your **NEET-MDS 2026 roll number** or name.
5. Pay the university fee online to generate your provisional allotment order.

## Critical Instructions
* **Reporting:** Candidates must physically report to their allotted dental college within the deadline specified in the allotment order.
* **Cancellation:** Failure to pay the university fee or report on time will result in the automatic cancellation of the allotted seat.
* **Verification:** Any discrepancy in documents may lead to the cancellation of candidature.

website_content.title: HBSE Senior Secondary (Academic/Open School) October 2026 Hall Ticket
website_content.summary: The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) has released the admit cards for the Senior Secondary Academic and Open School examinations for October 2026. Candidates across various categories including CTP and OCTP can now download their hall tickets via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH), Bhiwani, conducts Senior Secondary Academic/Open School examinations every October for specific candidate categories. These hall tickets are mandatory for entry into the examination centers.

## Eligible Candidate Categories
* **CTP & OCTP**
* **Re-appear & Compartment**
* **Partial & Full Improvement**
* **Additional Subject Candidates**

## Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 22 September 2026

## How to Download the Hall Ticket

### For Private, Open School, and Individual Candidates
1. Visit the official BSEH website: **bseh.org.in**.
2. Navigate to the admit card link for the **October 2026 Senior Secondary Academic/Open exam**.
3. Provide required details (Previous roll number/registration number and parent's name).
4. Submit the form and download the admit card.
5. Take a **coloured printout on A4-size paper**.

### For Regular School Candidates
* Admit cards are downloaded in batches by school authorities via the BSEH school portal.
* Students must collect their signed and stamped admit cards from their respective school principals.

## Important Instructions
* **Reporting Time:** Arrive at the center well before the mentioned reporting time; late entry is prohibited.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, smartwatches, and other electronic devices are strictly banned.
* **Permitted Facilities:** Candidates with disability certificates should arrange for scribes or extra time with the board in advance.
* **Documentation:** Maintain both digital and physical copies of the hall ticket until results are declared.

website_content.title: CWSSU Meghalaya Recruitment 2026: 149 Faculty Positions
website_content.summary: Captain Williamson Sangma State University (CWSSU), Meghalaya invites applications for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor roles across 18 departments. Apply online by October 11, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CWSSU Meghalaya Recruitment 2026

Captain Williamson Sangma State University (CWSSU), Meghalaya is recruiting for academic positions in various departments across its **Tura and Shillong campuses**.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **149**
* **Professor:** 18 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 46 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 85 Posts

**Departments Covered (18):** Anthropology, Botany, Chemistry, Commerce, Economics, Education, English, Environmental Science, Geography, History, Khasi, Mathematics, Philosophy, Physics, Political Science, Social Work, Sociology, and Zoology.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Professor**
* Ph.D. in the concerned subject.
* Minimum 10 research publications in peer-reviewed/UGC journals & Research Score of 120.
* 10 years of teaching/research experience.

**2. Associate Professor**
* Ph.D. in the concerned subject & Master's degree with 55% marks.
* Minimum 7 publications in peer-reviewed/UGC journals & Research Score of 75.
* 8 years of experience in teaching or research.

**3. Assistant Professor**
* Master's degree with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC).
* Must have cleared **NET/CSIR-NET/SET-NE** in the concerned subject (Ph.D. holders as per UGC 2009/2016 regulations are exempt).

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 21 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 22 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 11 October 2026 (Midnight)

### 💰 Salary & Fees
* **Pay Scale:** ₹57,700 (Assistant Professor) to ₹1,44,200 (Professor).
* **Application Fee:** 
    * General: ₹1000
    * ST/SC/OBC: ₹500

### ⚙️ Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on academic scores and API/Research scores (as per UGC 2018).
2. **Personal Interview:** Final selection is based entirely on interview performance.

website_content.title: SSC CGL City Intimation Slip 2026
website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the City Intimation Slip for the Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Tier 1 Examination 2026. Candidates can now check their allotted exam city and date to plan travel and accommodation.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Staff Selection Commission (SSC)** has released the City Intimation Slip for candidates appearing in the **Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Tier 1 Examination 2026**. This slip allows candidates to identify their allotted exam city and date prior to the release of the actual admit card.

## Key Details
* **Exam Name:** SSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination 2026
* **Tier:** Tier 1
* **Total Vacancies:** 12,256 (Group B and Group C posts)
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Examination (CBT)
* **Exam Dates:** 30 September to 30 October 2026

## Important Dates
* **City Intimation Slip Release:** 21 September 2026
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 27 September 2026 (Expected)
* **Tier 1 Exam Window:** 30 September to 30 October 2026

## Exam Pattern (Tier 1)
The examination consists of 100 questions for a total of 200 marks, to be completed in 1 hour.

| Subject | Questions | Marks |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 | 50 |
| General Awareness | 25 | 50 |
| Quantitative Aptitude | 25 | 50 |
| English Comprehension | 25 | 50 |
| **Total** | **100** | **200** |

## How to Check City Intimation Slip
1. Visit the official SSC website.
2. Navigate to the **Candidate Login** section.
3. Select **"Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level Tier 1 Examination, 2026"**.
4. Enter your **Registration Number** and **Password**.
5. Solve the captcha and click **Login**.
6. View and download your city intimation slip.

## Mandatory Instructions for Candidates
* **Identity Proof:** Carry your **Aadhaar Card** for biometric verification along with another valid photo ID proof.
* **No Changes:** Please note that no requests for changes in exam date, city, shift, or centre will be entertained.
* **Admit Card:** The full centre address and reporting time will be available only on the formal Admit Card.

website_content.title: Koppal Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27
website_content.summary: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Koppal, is recruiting 48 Pourakarmikas (Municipal Sanitation Workers) for Nagarasabhe Koppal and Gangavati. Applications are to be submitted offline by October 22, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Recruitment for **Pourakarmika (Municipal Sanitation Worker)** on a direct-payment/honorarium ('Nera Paavati') basis for the Koppal district.

* **Total Vacancies:** 48 (Koppal: 17, Gangavati: 31)
* **Engagement Nature:** Temporary/Honorarium
* **Application Mode:** Offline Only
* **Job Location:** Nagarasabhe Koppal and Nagarasabhe Gangavati, Karnataka

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** No formal educational qualification required.
* **Language Proficiency:** Must be able to speak Kannada.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 50 years (as of 21.09.2026). No age relaxation available.
* **Nationality:** Indian Citizen.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 2026-09-21
* **Application Start Date:** 2026-09-22
* **Application Deadline:** 2026-10-22

## Application Fee
Fees must be paid via **Demand Draft (DD)** in favor of the respective Nagarasabhe (Koppal or Gangavati):
* **SC/ST/Category-1/Women:** ₹100
* **General/2A/2B/3A/3B:** ₹200

## Selection Process
Selection is based on a priority-and-scrutiny system (No exam/interview):
1. **Priority 1:** Candidates with 1+ year prior service as Pourakarmika/Loader/UGD Helper in local bodies.
2. **Priority 2:** Family members of Pourakarmikas deceased during COVID-19 or in service.
3. **Priority 3:** Candidates with 1+ year experience in allied roles (Waste segregation/Public toilet cleaning).
4. **Priority 4:** 10% reservation for legal heirs under the Manual Scavengers Act.

## How to Apply
1. Obtain the application form from the **Nagarasabhe Koppal** or **Nagarasabhe Gangavati** office.
2. Fill the form and attach self-attested copies of age proof, category certificates, and experience records.
3. Attach the applicable Demand Draft (DD).
4. Submit the physical application at the concerned office by **22.10.2026**.

website_content.title: ECHS Recruitment 2026: 96 Medical, Paramedical and Non-Medical Posts
website_content.summary: ECHS Secunderabad is inviting offline applications for 96 contractual vacancies across various medical and non-medical roles in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. The submission deadline is 4 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## ECHS Recruitment 2026 Overview
The **Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS)** is recruiting for **96 contractual positions** to serve in polyclinics across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. 

### 📌 Key Job Details
* **Organization:** Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS)
* **Recruiting Office:** Station HQ ECHS Cell, Secunderabad
* **Total Vacancies:** 96
* **Job Type:** Contractual
* **Application Mode:** **Offline (Post)**
* **Last Date to Apply:** 4 October 2026 (up to 6:00 PM)

### 💰 Vacancy and Salary Breakdown
| Post Name | Vacancies | Monthly Salary |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Medical Specialist | 4 | Rs. 1,30,000 |
| Medical Officer | 22 | Rs. 95,000 |
| Dental Officer | 10 | Rs. 95,000 |
| Officer-in-Charge | 3 | Rs. 95,000 |
| Pharmacist | 12 | Rs. 36,500 |
| Lab Technician | 7 | Rs. 36,500 |
| Nursing Assistant | 3 | Rs. 36,500 |
| Data Entry Operator/Clerk | 4 | Rs. 29,200 |
| Peon/Safaiwala/Chowkidar | 17 | Rs. 21,800 |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Medical Specialists:** MD/MS in General Medicine
* **Medical Officer:** MBBS
* **Dental Officer:** BDS
* **Paramedical Staff:** Relevant Diploma/Degree in Nursing, Pharmacy, or MLT
* **Clerical Staff:** Graduate or Class-I Clerical Trade qualification
* **Support Staff:** Literate or Class 8 pass

### 🛠 Selection Process
1. **Scrutiny:** Verification of applications and documents.
2. **Written Test:** For candidates meeting qualitative requirements.
3. **Interview:** For candidates who qualify in the written test.
4. **Final Selection:** Based on overall merit.

### 📝 How to Apply
Since this is an **offline recruitment**, follow these steps:
1. Visit the official ECHS website at **www.echs.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **Employment Opportunities** section and download the application form.
3. Fill in the details accurately and attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents (Educational certificates, experience, ID proofs).
4. Send the completed application via post to:
   **Officer-in-Charge, Station HQ ECHS Cell, HQ TASA, Near Rashtrapati Nilayam, Secunderabad - 500010, Telangana.**

website_content.markdown_content:
## NABFINS CSO Recruitment 2026 Overview

NABFINS Limited has invited applications for the position of **Customer Service Officer (CSO) - Field Work** across multiple states. The role is focused on customer sourcing, portfolio growth, verification, field operations, and collections.

### Important Dates
* **Application Deadline:** 30 September 2026

### Vacancy & Location Details
* **Post Name:** Customer Service Officer (CSO) - Field
* **Total Vacancies:** Not Specified
* **Job Locations:** Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra, West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh

### Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Completed PUC / 10+2 or equivalent.
* **Experience:** Freshers are eligible. Candidates with 1–3 years of experience in microfinance/field operations are preferred.
* **Language Proficiency:** Must have written, spoken, and reading command over English and the Local Language.
* **Driving Requirement:** Valid Driving Licence and Motorcycle are **mandatory**.

### Key Job Responsibilities
* Sourcing new clients and expanding branch portfolio.
* Conducting primary verification and Compulsory Group Training.
* Assisting in disbursement and data entry in CRIF/CMS.
* Demand generation, recovery follow-ups, and collection remittance.

### How to Apply
1. Prepare an updated resume with contact details and educational qualifications.
2. Compose an email with the subject line **Application for Customer Service Officer (CSO)**.
3. Send your resume to the designated recruitment email address before **30 September 2026**.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Jharkhand Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (JCECEB) has initiated the **Round 2 counselling process** for General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) admissions for the 2026 session. This phase includes online registration and the critical choice-filling process for qualified candidates.

## Important Dates
* **Vacant Seat Matrix Display:** September 21, 2026
* **Online Registration & Choice Filling:** September 21 – 23, 2026
* **Provisional Seat Allotment Result:** September 25, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Letter Download:** September 25 – 30, 2026
* **Document Verification & Physical Admission:** September 26 – 30, 2026

## Step-by-Step Choice Filling Process
1. **Visit Portal:** Go to the official JCECEB GNM portal.
2. **Login:** Use your Application Number/Roll Number and password.
3. **Fee Payment:** New candidates must pay the counselling fee (Rs. 400 or Rs. 250).
4. **Review Seats:** Check the institute-wise vacant seat matrix released on September 21.
5. **Preference Entry:** Select and arrange nursing institutes in order of priority.
6. **Lock Choices:** Review and click 'Save' to lock preferences before the deadline.

## Key Instructions
* **Deadline:** The window closes on **September 23, 2026**. Ensure choices are locked to avoid issues.
* **Auto-Lock:** The system will automatically lock the last saved version if not manually locked by the deadline.
* **Verification:** Candidates must report to the allotted college between September 26 and 30 to secure their seat.

website_content.summary: NIT Durgapur has released the provisionally eligible candidate lists for Office Attendant, Lab Attendant, and Junior Assistant posts. Eligible candidates are scheduled for tests on September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NIT Durgapur Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026

National Institute of Technology (NIT) Durgapur has issued general information notices and eligibility lists (Appendix-A) for candidates who applied for non-teaching positions under **Advertisement No. NITD/Estt./01/05/Non-Teaching/2025**.

### 📌 Key Exam Details
* **Posts Covered:** Office Attendant (Pay Level-1), Lab Attendant (Pay Level-1), and Junior Assistant.
* **Test Date:** 28/09/2026
* **Reporting Time:** 09:30 AM
* **Venue:** New Academic Buildings, NIT Durgapur, Mahatma Gandhi Avenue, Durgapur-713209, West Bengal.
* **Mode of Examination:** OMR Sheet
* **Test Type:** Domain Test / Skill Test / Written Test

### 🔍 How to Check Your Eligibility Status
1. Access the official PDF for your respective post.
2. Navigate to **Appendix-A** ("List of provisionally Eligible Candidates").
3. Search for your application number using the format `NITDGP/16-C/[number]` (Ctrl+F).
4. Verify your category and remarks.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Documents:** Bring a printed copy of the invitation email and one original Government ID proof.
* **Stationery:** Use only a **black ball point pen** for the OMR sheet.
* **Logistics:** Candidates must arrange their own travel, food, and lodging; no reimbursement will be provided by the institute.
* **Process:** The Domain/Skill test will be immediately followed by a Written Test for all provisionally eligible candidates.
