website_content.title: Assam Rifles Technical & Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026
website_content.summary: Assam Rifles has announced 354 vacancies across 18 technical and tradesman roles for male candidates. Apply online between 28 September and 28 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Office of the Directorate General Assam Rifles is conducting a Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally for 2026. This is an All-India recruitment for Group C posts, specifically targeting skilled technical personnel for 18 different trades.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 27 August 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 28 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 28 October 2026 (23:59 hrs)
* **Rally Date (Tentative):** From 23 November 2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 1 July 2026

## Vacancy Details
Total posts available: **354** (Tentative). Key trades include:
* Warrant Officer (Cipher)
* Rifleman (Electrical Fitter Signal, Lineman Field, Armourer, etc.)
* Havildar (Instrument Mechanic)
* Warrant Officer (Draughtsman, OT Technician, Physiotherapist)
* Rifleman (Mason)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Male candidates only.
* **Nationality:** Indian Citizen.
* **Education:** 
    * **Warrant Officer (Cipher):** 10+2 with Physics, Maths & English + NSQF Level 4 course OR Bachelor's in Electronics/ICT.
    * **Rifleman (Various):** 10th/Matric + ITI/Diploma in relevant trade (Electrical, Electronics, Welding, etc.).
    * **Specialized Roles:** Diploma in Physiotherapy or OT Technician with 1 year experience for specific Warrant Officer posts.
* **Age Limit:** Generally **18–25 years** (Trade-specific variations apply). Age relaxation for SC/ST (5 yrs), OBC (3 yrs), and Ex-Servicemen as per rules.

## Selection Process
1. **PST & PET:** Physical Standard Test (Height/Chest) and RFID-based Physical Efficiency Test (5km run for most; 1.6km for Ladakh).
2. **Document Verification (DV):** Checking original certificates and application forms.
3. **Computer Based Test (CBT):** 100-mark objective exam (Pass marks: 35% Gen/EWS, 33% SC/ST/OBC).
4. **Trade Skill Test:** Computer-based and practical skill tests (Qualifying only).
5. **Medical Examination:** DME and RME as per CAPF guidelines.

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹100

## BFUHS B.Sc Nursing Round 3 Counselling 2026

Baba Farid University of Health Sciences (BFUHS), Faridkot, is initiating the **Round 3 counselling process** for B.Sc Nursing. This stage allows candidates to view vacant seats across various colleges and submit their preferences for allotment.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **September 21, 2026**: Deadline for Round 1 and Round 2 admitted candidates to surrender seats at their respective colleges.
* **September 22, 2026**: Expected release date of the Round 3 Seat Matrix.
* **September 23, 2026**: Last date to submit college/category/quota choices online.

### 📝 Choice Filling Process
1. Log in to the official BFUHS admission portal using **PPMET 2026 credentials**.
2. Carefully review the released **Round 3 Seat Matrix PDF** to identify available colleges and quotas.
3. Arrange the preferred colleges, categories, and quotas in order of priority.
4. Submit the preferences before the deadline on September 23.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Seat Availability**: Candidates are encouraged to submit preferences even for colleges not explicitly listed in the tentative vacancy position, as new vacancies may arise from upgradations.
* **Category Verification**: A vacancy in one category does not imply availability in another; verify exact classifications before submitting.
* **Upgradation**: Candidates holding seats from previous rounds may participate in Round 3 if eligible for upgradation.
* **Post-Allotment**: Allotted candidates must be ready for document verification, medical formalities, and fee payment.

website_content.title: Indian Navy Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 (DEPO/DECPO)
website_content.summary: Indian Navy invites applications for Sports Quota Entry 02/2026 for Direct Entry Petty Officers and Chief Petty Officers. Interested sportspersons must apply offline by October 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Indian Navy (Sports Control Board) is recruiting outstanding sportspersons for the **02/2026 Batch** in the ranks of **Direct Entry Petty Officer (DEPO)** and **Direct Entry Chief Petty Officer (DECPO)**.

## Important Dates
* **Application Deadline (General):** 15.10.2026
* **Application Deadline (NE/J&K/Ladakh/Islands):** 22.10.2026

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 10+2 qualified in any stream or equivalent.
* **Age Limit:** 17½ to 25 years (Born between 01 September 2001 and 28 February 2009).
* **Sports Proficiency:**
    * **DEPO:** Medalists at Junior/Senior National level or International representation.
    * **DECPO:** Medalists in World/Asian Championships, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, or Olympic representation.

## Sports Disciplines
* **Male Candidates:** Athletics, Aquatics, Basketball, Boxing, Cricket, Equestrian, Football, Fencing, Golf, Handball, Hockey, Kabaddi, Kayaking & Canoeing, Rowing, Sailing, Shooting, Squash, Tennis, Volleyball, Weightlifting, and Wrestling.
* **Female Candidates:** Athletics, Aquatics, Kayaking & Canoeing, Rowing & Sailing.

## Physical Standards
* **Height (Male):** Minimum 157 cm
* **Height (Female):** Minimum 152 cm
* **Visual Standards:** 6/12 (without glasses) or 6/6 (with glasses).

## Selection Process
1. **Sports Trials:** Conducted at designated Naval Centres.
2. **Medical Examination:** At INS Hamla (Mumbai) or INS India (Delhi).
3. **Final Merit List:** Based on sports achievements and vacancies.

## Application Process (**OFFLINE ONLY**)
* **Mode:** Ordinary Post only (Speed Post/Courier will be rejected).
* **Procedure:** Download the application form from the official website, fill it on A4 size paper, and attach self-attested documents (10th/12th certificates, Sports certificates, Domicile).
* **Address:** The Secretary, Indian Navy Sports Control Board, Naval Headquarters, Ministry of Defence, Nausena Bhawan, Room No. W-016, Delhi Cantt, New Delhi - 110010.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Gujarat Subordinate Services Selection Board (GSSSB)** has officially published the final result for the post of **Tracer (Rekhankar), Class-3** under Advertisement Number **357/202526**. These positions are for various circle offices of the **Road and Building Department**, Government of Gujarat.

## Key Result Details
* **Notice Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Exam Mode:** MCQ-CBRT (Computer Based Recruitment Test)
* **Total Selected (Annexure A):** 52 Candidates
* **Waiting List (Annexure B):** 13 Candidates
* **Absent/Unsuccessful (Annexure C):** 26 Candidates

## How to Verify Your Status
1. Download the official result PDF from the GSSSB website.
2. Search for your **Roll Number** or **Confirmation Number** within the document.
3. **Annexure A:** Indicates you are in the select list. Note your 'Treated as' category and 'Allotted Office'.
4. **Annexure B:** Indicates you are on the waiting list.
5. **Annexure C:** Indicates you were either unsuccessful or absent during document scrutiny.

website_content.summary: Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat, invites applications for 6,843 Anganwadi Worker and Helper positions. Eligible local female candidates can apply online by October 14, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026

The **Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat** is recruiting for Anganwadi Workers and Helpers across various districts in Gujarat. These are honorary service positions aimed at supporting community child and women welfare.

### 📌 Recruitment Overview
* **Post Names:** Anganwadi Worker (AWW) & Anganwadi Helper (AWH)
* **Total Vacancies:** 6,843 (3,043 Workers + 3,800 Helpers)
* **Application Mode:** Online
* **Selection Process:** Merit-based selection

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 21 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 14 October 2026 (until 12:00 midnight)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:**
    * **Anganwadi Worker:** Class 12 pass OR Class 10 pass with a recognized 2-year diploma.
    * **Anganwadi Helper:** Class 10 pass.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 33 years (up to 43 years for serving Helpers applying for Worker posts).
* **Residence Requirement:** Must be an Indian woman citizen and a local resident of the revenue village/centre area for at least one year.

### 💰 Monthly Honorarium
* **Anganwadi Worker:** Rs. 10,000
* **Anganwadi Helper:** Rs. 5,500

### 📄 Required Documents
* Proof of age and identity proof
* Marksheets/Certificates for Class 10 & 12
* Local residence certificate issued by Mamlatdar (not older than 6 months)
* Caste/Reservation or Widow certificate (if applicable)
* Grade-to-percentage conversion certificate (if applicable)

website_content.markdown_content:

website_content.title: OPSC Assistant Professor Provisional Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC) has released provisional answer keys for Assistant Professors in Economics and Management. Candidates can submit objections online via the official portal until September 29, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## OPSC Assistant Professor Answer Key 2026

The Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC) has published the **Provisional Answer Keys** for the written examination of Assistant Professors in Government Engineering Colleges for the disciplines of **Economics and Management** (Advertisement No. 35 of 2023-24).

### Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Assistant Professor
* **Disciplines:** Economics & Management
* **Exam Date:** 29 August 2026
* **Answer Key Type:** Provisional
* **Objection Mode:** Online via official portal

### Important Dates for Objections
* **Economics Discipline:** Last date to raise objections is **28 September 2026**.
* **Management Discipline:** Last date to raise objections is **29 September 2026**.

### How to Raise Objections
1. Visit the official objection portal at **opscechayan.in**.
2. Select the specific objection module for either **Assistant Professor (Economics)** or **Assistant Professor (Management)**.
3. Use the **Set A question booklet number** for all references, regardless of the set you received during the exam.
4. Provide **sufficient justification or supporting evidence** for the challenged answer.
5. Ensure submission before the respective deadline; no other mode of submission (email/post) will be accepted.

### Important Instructions
* Only objections regarding the correctness of questions and provisional answers are accepted.
* If no objection is received for a particular question, the provisional answer will be treated as the final answer.
* Final Answer Keys will be determined by a Committee of Experts after reviewing valid objections.

website_content.summary: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have announced the tentative CBT-1 exam schedule for 11,127 Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) posts under CEN 01/2026. The exams are scheduled to take place from November 3 to November 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## RRB ALP CBT-1 Exam 2026 Overview
* **Post Name:** Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP)
* **Notification Number:** CEN 01/2026
* **Total Vacancies:** 11,127 (Provisional)
* **Conducting Body:** Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways
* **Exam Stage:** First Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1)

## Important Dates
* **Tentative CBT-1 Exam Dates:** 03/11/2026 to 05/11/2026
* **Exam City & Date Intimation:** To be released 10 days before the exam
* **E-Call Letter Download:** Starts 4 days before the exam
* **Online Application Window:** 15/05/2026 to 14/06/2026

## Mandatory Aadhaar Instructions
* **Biometric Authentication:** Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication is mandatory at the exam centre.
* **Verification:** Candidates must verify their identity through Aadhaar at the official portal to ensure smooth entry.
* **Aadhaar Status:** Ensure that the Aadhaar is **unlocked** in the UIDAI system before the exam day.
* **Details Update:** Ensure name, DOB, photograph, and father's name match the Class 10 certificate.

## Exam Day Guidelines
* **Documents Required:** Printed e-call letter, original Aadhaar card (or e-verified printout), and a recent colour passport-size photograph.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and bags are strictly banned inside the hall.
* **Caution:** Avoid applying henna on hands or feet as it may obstruct biometric capture.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Exam Overview
The **West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education (WBCHSE)** is conducting the Higher Secondary (Class 12) Semester 3 Examination 2027 for Science, Commerce, Arts, and Vocational streams.

## Key Exam Details
* **Academic Session:** 2026-27
* **Exam Dates:** September 21 to October 14, 2026 (Revised)
* **Mode of Exam:** Offline, Single Shift
* **Question Format:** Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)

## How to Download Admit Card
Admit cards are distributed via the school portal. The process is as follows:
1. The **Head of Institution** logs into the Council's school portal using institutional credentials.
2. Navigate to the **Admit Card / Hall Ticket** download section.
3. Download the admit cards for all eligible Semester 3 candidates.
4. Schools will print and distribute the admit cards to the respective students.

## Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Document:** Carry the admit card to the center on every exam day; entry is prohibited without it.
* **Reporting Time:** Reach the center well before the scheduled reporting time.
* **Stationery:** Use only **blue or black ball-point pens** for the OMR sheet.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, calculators, and electronic devices are strictly banned.
* **Verification:** Students must verify their name, roll number, and subject list immediately upon receiving the card.

website_content.summary: The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) will release admit cards for the D.El.Ed October 2026 examination starting September 21, 2026. Admit cards must be downloaded by institute heads for student-teachers.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH), Bhiwani** has announced the schedule and guidelines for the **D.El.Ed (Diploma in Elementary Education) October 2026 Examination**. 

## Key Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** September 21, 2026 (Expected)
* **Examination Start Date:** October 1, 2026
* **Examination End Date:** October 24, 2026
* **Daily Exam Timing:** 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM

## How to Download Admit Card
Unlike individual student logins, the admit cards for this cycle are managed via training institutes:
1. **Institute Login:** The Principal or Head of the D.El.Ed training institute must visit the official website.
2. **Authentication:** Log in using the institute's official User ID and Password.
3. **Bulk Download:** Download the admit cards for all eligible student-teachers from the login panel.
4. **Printing:** A **colour printout** on A4-size paper with the candidate's photograph is mandatory.

**Note:** Student-teachers must contact their respective institutes directly to collect their admit cards.

## Important Instructions
* **Mandatory Document:** Entry to the exam centre will only be permitted with a colour printout of the admit card and a valid photo ID.
* **ID Verification:** Candidates must ensure their **Aadhaar card** or photo ID details are updated and match institute records.
* **Eligibility:** Institute heads are responsible for ensuring only eligible student-teachers are issued roll numbers.

website_content.title: ITBP Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force (ITBP) is recruiting 21 Head Constables (Motor Mechanic). Applications are open from September 28 to October 27, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
* **Organization:** Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force (ITBP)
* **Post Name:** Head Constable (Motor Mechanic)
* **Total Vacancies:** 21
* **Employment Type:** Group C (Non-Gazetted/Non-Ministerial)
* **Job Location:** Anywhere in India or abroad

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 28 September 2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 27 October 2026

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:**
    * Candidates must have passed **10+2** from a recognized board.
    * **Additional Requirement:** Either a certificate in Motor Mechanic with 3 years of practical experience OR a 3-year diploma in Automobile Engineering.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (Age relaxation applicable for reserved categories as per rules).

## Salary & Fee Details
* **Pay Scale:** Level 4 (Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100)
* **Application Fee:** 
    * General/OBC/EWS: **Rs. 100**
    * SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen: **Exempted**

## Selection Process
Candidates will be selected based on the following stages:
* Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
* Physical Standard Test (PST)
* Document Verification
* Written Examination
* Practical Skill Test
* Detailed Medical Examination

## Application Process
1. Visit the official ITBP recruitment portal.
2. Register with a valid email and mobile number.
3. Fill in personal and educational details.
4. Upload required documents (Photo, Signature).
5. Pay the application fee (if applicable) and submit.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Karnataka PGCET 2026 Mock Allotment

The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has officially released the **indicative mock allotment result** for the Post Graduate Common Entrance Test (PGCET) 2026. This allows candidates to see their potential seat allotment and adjust their preferences before the final rounds.

### Key Information
* **Courses Covered:** MBA, MCA, M.E., M.Tech, and M.Arch.
* **Mock Allotment Date:** September 19, 2026.
* **Option Modification Window:** Open until **September 22, 2026 (11:00 AM)**.

### How to Check Your Allotment
1. Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
2. Select the **PGCET 2026 mock allotment** link on the homepage.
3. Log in using your **CET/Application Number** and date of birth or password.
4. View your allotted course, college, and category status.
5. Save or download a copy for your records.

### Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Indicative Status:** The mock allotment is for guidance only; candidates should **not** report to any college based on this result.
* **Option Entry:** Options submitted before Round 1 serve as the base list. While candidates can delete or reorder options in later rounds, a completely fresh set of options cannot be entered for every round.
* **Credentials:** Ensure your login details are kept secure as they are required for every stage of the counselling process.

website_content.title: Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The Office of the Director of Land Records & Surveys, Assam is inviting applications for 579 Land Record Assistant posts. The application window closes on October 21, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026

The **Office of the Director of Land Records & Surveys (DLRS), Assam** has announced a recruitment drive for the post of **Land Record Assistant (LRA)**. This recruitment is specifically for candidates who have completed the mandated RCCC Training.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Advertisement Date:** 19.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 21.09.2026 (11:00 AM)
* **Application Closing Date:** 21.10.2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Age Reckoning Date:** 01.01.2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must have passed the **Recorders Certificate Class Course (RCCC) Training** from the Assam Survey & Settlement Training Centre, Dakhingaon, Guwahati-40, and been declared proficient prior to 13.08.2026.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in computers with a typing speed of **30 WPM (English)** and **15 WPM (Assamese/Bengali)**.
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 40 years as of 01.01.2026 (Relaxation applicable as per Govt norms).

### 📊 Vacancy Details
**Total Posts: 579**
* **UR:** 316
* **OBC/MOBC:** 137
* **OBC (T):** 41
* **ST (P):** 20
* **ST (H):** 6
* **SC:** 5
* **Other categories (EWS/PwD):** As per detailed notification

### 📝 Selection Process
Selection is based on a total of 100 marks:
1. **Written Examination (80 Marks):** Objective MCQ pattern covering Mathematics (10), Conventional Survey (50), and Modern Survey (20). *Note: Negative marking of 0.25 applies.*
2. **Skill Test (20 Marks):** Computer proficiency and typing test.
3. **Document Verification:** Final stage for qualified candidates.

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Scale:** PB-2 (₹14,000 – ₹70,000) + Grade Pay ₹6,200
* **Allowances:** As per Government of Assam rules.

website_content.markdown_content:
## RRB Group D Result 2026 Overview

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) conducted the Computer Based Test (CBT) for **RRB Group D Level 1 (CEN 09/2025)** from 3 August 2026 to 25 August 2026. ### How to Check RRB Group D Result 2026

IIT Madras has announced the syllabus for the **Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027**. This examination serves as a gateway for postgraduate admissions and recruitment in various Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).

* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT)
* **Duration:** 3 Hours
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Total Questions:** 65
* **Question Types:** Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ), Multiple Select Questions (MSQ), and Numerical Answer Type (NAT) questions.

### Syllabus Highlights
* **Total Papers:** 30 test papers are available.
* **New Addition:** A new paper on **Robotics & Automation (RA)** has been introduced for this cycle.
* **Branch-Wise PDFs:** Every paper has a dedicated syllabus PDF available for download on the official portal.

### How to Access the Syllabus
1. Visit the official GATE 2027 portal.
2. Navigate to the **GATE Papers** menu.
3. Select **Test Papers & Syllabus**.
4. Locate your specific branch/paper code and download the corresponding PDF.

**Note:** Candidates are strongly advised to refer to the 2027 revised syllabus and avoid using older versions for their study plan.

website_content.summary: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) has opened online registration for the CS Executive Programme for the June 2027 exam session. Eligible candidates can register through the ICSI SMASH portal before the specified group deadlines.
website_content.markdown_content:
## ICSI CS Executive Registration June 2027 Overview

The **Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)** has officially released the registration window for the **CS Executive Programme (June 2027 Session)**. Candidates aiming to appear for both groups or a single group must submit their online applications on the SMASH portal prior to the deadline.

## Important Dates

* **Registration Opening Date:** Ongoing
* **Last Date to Register for Both Groups:** November 30, 2026
* **Last Date to Register for Single Group:** January 31, 2027
* **Exam Session:** June 2027

## Eligibility Criteria

* **CSEET Route:** Candidates who have qualified the Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test (CSEET).
* **Direct Entry Route:** Graduates and Postgraduates who meet ICSI direct admission standards.
* Other prescribed entry paths approved by ICSI.

## Steps to Apply Online

1. Visit the official ICSI portal or SMASH registration page.
2. Select your entry route (CSEET-qualified, Graduate/Postgraduate direct entry, or other category).
3. Enter your CSEET Registration Number and Roll Number (if applicable).
4. Complete the personal and educational details in the application form.
5. Upload scanned copies of mandatory documents (Photograph, Signature, Category Certificate, DOB Proof, Qualifying Marks Sheet).
6. Submit the online application fee and retain a copy of the payment receipt.

website_content.title: NCL Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) invites applications for 40 positions of Medical Specialists and GDMOs on a part-time contract basis. Interested candidates must submit their applications by 5th October 2026 via post or email.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Northern Coalfields Limited, a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, is seeking experienced medical professionals for engagement as **Consultants (Medical Specialist)** and **Consultants (GDMO)** at NCL hospitals and dispensaries in Singrauli.

## Vacancy Details
There are a total of **40 vacancies** distributed across various specialities:
* **GDMO:** 9
* **Medicine:** 4
* **Anaesthesia, Paediatrics, OBS/GYN, Psychiatry:** 3 each
* **Surgery, Pathology, Ophthalmology, Dermatology, ENT, Orthopaedics, Radiologist:** 2 each
* **Dental Surgeon:** 1

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **Medical Specialist:** MBBS degree from a recognized institute + a recognized postgraduate degree, DNB, or postgraduate diploma in the relevant speciality.
* **GDMO:** MBBS degree from a recognized institute approved by the Medical Council of India.

### Experience Requirements
* **Retired Medical Specialists:** Minimum 15 years of experience in the relevant speciality.
* **Non-Retired Medical Specialists:** Minimum 7 years of experience in the relevant speciality.
* **GDMO (Non-Retired):** Minimum 3 years of experience as GDMO.

### Age Limit
* Maximum age: **70 years** during the contract period.

## Honorarium & Work Schedule
| Post | Honorarium | Working Requirement |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Medical Specialist** | Rs. 8,000 per 4-hour session | Min. 3 days/week (4 hrs/day) |
| **GDMO** | Rs. 5,000 per 8-hour session | Min. 3 days/week (8 hrs/day) |

## Application Process
This is an **offline application process**. Candidates must submit the prescribed application form and letter of undertaking along with self-attested documents.

**Submission Methods:**
1. **By Post:** Send to General Manager (HR)/HOD (EE), Northern Coalfields Limited, Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh - 486889.
2. **By Email:** Send to [email protected] with the subject "Application for the post of Consultant (Medical Specialist)/Consultant (GDMO), NCL".

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 21 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 5 October 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)

website_content.summary: The West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB) has released the Round 1 seat allotment for the 2026 Decentralised Counselling (DCAP) Phase 2. Candidates for BTech, BPharm, and BArch programs can now check their results and complete admission formalities.
website_content.markdown_content:
## WBJEE DCAP 2026 Phase 2 Round 1 Seat Allotment

The West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB) has announced the **Round 1 seat allotment results for Phase 2** of the Decentralised Counselling (DCAP) 2026. This process is specifically designed to fill the remaining vacant seats in **BTech, BPharm, and BArch** programs.

### Key Highlights
* **Purpose:** Filling vacant seats after regular counselling.
* **Courses Covered:** BTech, BPharm, and BArch.
* **Action Required:** Candidates must log in to check allotment, pay the acceptance fee, and complete physical document verification.

### Important Dates (Phase 2)
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| Publication of Vacant Seat Matrix | September 17, 2026 |
| Registration & Choice Selection Window | September 17 to 19, 2026 |
| **Round 1 Seat Allotment Release** | **September 20, 2026 (2:00 PM)** |
| Round 1 Seat Acceptance Fee Payment | September 20 to 21, 2026 |
| Round 1 Document Verification & Admission | September 20 to 22, 2026 |
| Round 2 Seat Allotment | September 23, 2026 |
| Round 2 Seat Acceptance Fee Payment | September 23 to 24, 2026 |
| Round 2 Document Verification & Admission | September 24 to 25, 2026 |

### How to Check Allotment Result
1. Visit the official portal at **wbjeeb.co.in** or **wbjeeb.nic.in**.
2. Click on the **Phase 2 Round 1 Seat Allotment** link on the homepage.
3. Log in using your **WBJEE roll number/application number** and password.
4. View and download the seat allotment letter.

### Critical Instructions
* **Strict Deadlines:** Failure to pay fees or verify documents within the window will lead to cancellation of the seat.
* **Finality:** Once the acceptance fee for Round 1 is paid, the choice is final for that round.
* **Documentation:** Carry original documents and self-attested photocopies for physical reporting.

website_content.summary: The State CET Cell, Maharashtra, will release the Provisional Merit List for BAMS, BHMS, and BUMS admissions on September 21, 2026, based on NEET UG 2026 ranks.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The State Common Entrance Test (CET) Cell, Maharashtra, is facilitating the Centralised Admission Process (CAP) 2026 for undergraduate medical courses in AYUSH. The provisional merit list is a critical step for candidates seeking admission into BAMS, BHMS, and BUMS courses.

## Key Details
* **Conducting Body:** State CET Cell, Maharashtra
* **Applicable Courses:** BAMS, BHMS, BUMS
* **Merit Basis:** NEET UG 2026 Rank

## Important Dates
* **Provisional Merit List Release:** September 21, 2026 (Expected)
* **Online Choice Filling:** Starts September 23, 2026

## Steps to Check Merit List
1. Visit the official Maharashtra CET Cell counselling portal.
2. Navigate to the **NEET UG 2026 counselling** section on the homepage.
3. Click on the link titled **"BAMS/BHMS/BUMS Provisional Merit List 2026."**
4. Download the PDF and search for your name or roll number using Ctrl+F.

## Essential Instructions
* **Verification:** Candidates must immediately verify their name, category, and merit rank.
* **Corrections:** Any discrepancies must be reported via the official correction/objection procedure before the deadline.
* **Documentation:** Keep scanned copies of NEET scorecards, educational certificates, domicile proof, and category certificates ready for the counselling process.
* **Eligibility:** Only candidates appearing in the provisional list are eligible to proceed to the online choice-filling stage.

website_content.title: GATE 2027 Application and Exam Dates (IIT Madras)
website_content.summary: IIT Madras has announced the registration schedule for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027. Applications are open until October 5, 2026, with exams scheduled for February 2027.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GATE 2027 Overview
IIT Madras is the conducting body for the **Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027**. This national-level examination is essential for postgraduate admissions and various PSU recruitment processes.

## Key Dates to Remember
* **Registration Start Date:** September 2, 2026
* **Deadline (without late fee):** September 27, 2026
* **Deadline (with additional late fee of ₹500):** October 5, 2026
* **Application Correction Window:** October 14, 2026 – October 21, 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** January 2027
* **Exam Dates:** February 6, 7, 13, 14, 20, and 21, 2027
* **Result Declaration:** March 19, 2027

## Examination Pattern
* **Mode of Exam:** Online
* **Session Timings:**
    * **Forenoon:** 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM
    * **Afternoon:** 2:30 PM to 5:30 PM
* **Papers:** 30 test papers available. Candidates may apply for a maximum of two papers (subject to prescribed combinations).

## Important Instructions
* Use the **GOAPS (GATE Online Application Processing System)** for registration.
* Ensure all corrections are made during the window in October to avoid discrepancies.
* The admit card is mandatory for entry into the exam center.

## NTPC Assistant Officer Recruitment 2026

NTPC Limited has released an official notification (Advt No. 12/26) for the recruitment of **Assistant Officers (Corporate Communication)**. Eligible candidates are invited to apply online via the official careers portal.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 21 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 05 October 2026

| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * Bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least **60% marks**.
    * Two-year postgraduate degree or diploma in **Mass Communication, Journalism, Advertising, or Public Relations** with at least **60% marks**.

### ⚙️ Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting/Screening** of applications.
2. **Online Written Test** (Subject Knowledge + Executive Aptitude) - 85% weightage.
3. **Personal Interview** - 15% weightage.
4. **Medical Examination**.

### 📄 Required Documents for Upload
* Class 10th Certificate/Marksheet
* PAN and Aadhaar Card
* Graduation and PG Degree/Diplomas & Marksheets
* Category/EWS/Disability Certificates (if applicable)
* Marks conversion formula (if CGPA is used)

website_content.title: MEA Internship Programme 2026-27 (Term II) Registration
website_content.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) is inviting applications for the Internship Programme 2026-27 Term II (October to March). Interested candidates must register and apply online by 27 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), Government of India, has opened registrations for the **MEA Internship Programme 2026-27 (Term II)**. This program provides a unique opportunity for candidates to gain experience within the Ministry for the term spanning **October to March**.

## Key Highlights
* **Organisation:** Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), Government of India
* **Programme:** MEA Internship Programme 2026-27, Term II
* **Internship Term:** October to March
* **Application Mode:** Online only

## Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 27 September 2026
* **Shortlist & Interview Calls:** 7 October 2026
* **Interviews (Videoconference):** 17 October 2026
* **Final Selection Announcement:** 23 October 2026

## How to Apply
1. Visit the official MEA internship portal.
2. Review the internship policy and eligibility criteria (including age limit and covered states).
3. Click on the **Register** link to create an account and obtain access credentials.
4. Log in and complete the online application form.
5. Submit the application on or before **27 September 2026**.

## Important Instructions
* **Security Clearance:** Selection is strictly subject to necessary security clearances.
* **Intellectual Property:** All study outcomes during the internship remain the intellectual property of the MEA.

## Recruitment Overview
The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) have released an indicative notice for the recruitment of graduates for **Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC)** under CEN No. 06/2026. This is a significant opportunity for graduates to join the Ministry of Railways, Government of India.

## Important Dates
* **Indicative Notice Date:** 26 September 2026
* **Application Opening Date:** 08 October 2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 06 November 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Age Calculation Date:** 01 January 2027

## Vacancy & Salary Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 3,477 (Tentative)
* **Post Category:** Non-Technical Popular Categories (Graduate)
* **Pay Scale:** Level 5 and Level 6 under the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must hold a Graduation degree from a recognized university.
* **Age Limit:** Minimum and maximum age limits will be specified in the detailed notification.

## Application Fee
* **UR / OBC / EWS:** Rs. 500
* **SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwBD / Female / Transgender / Minorities / EBC:** Rs. 250

## Key Application Instructions
* **Mode:** Online only via the official portal.
* **Aadhaar Verification:** Candidates are strongly advised to verify primary details via Aadhaar to avoid scrutiny delays.
* **Documents Required:** Graduation certificates, Class 10 certificate, Aadhaar, photograph, and signature.

website_content.title: NIT Uttarakhand Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: NIT Uttarakhand is inviting online applications for 21 non-teaching positions including Superintendent, Technical Assistant, and Junior Assistant. The last date for online submission is 4 November 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
NIT Uttarakhand has announced vacancies for various non-teaching positions to be filled on a deputation, short-term contract, or contractual basis.

### Vacancy Details
* **Superintendent:** 1 Post
* **Technical Assistant:** 6 Posts
* **Technician (Selection Grade-II):** 7 Posts
* **Technician:** 4 Posts
* **Junior Assistant:** 3 Posts
* **Total:** 21 Vacancies

### Eligibility Criteria
* **Superintendent:** First Class Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline with computer knowledge.
* **Technical Assistant:** First Class B.E./B.Tech/MCA/Diploma in Engineering or Bachelor's/Master's in Science.
* **Technician (SG-II & Technician):** Class 12 (Science) with 60% or Class 10 with ITI certificate/Diploma in relevant field.
* **Junior Assistant:** Class 12 pass with a typing speed of 35 wpm and computer proficiency.

### Salary & Pay Scale
* **Superintendent/Technical Assistant:** Level 6 (₹35,400–1,12,400) or ₹57,000/month contractual.
* **Technician (SG-II):** Level 5 (₹29,200–92,300) or ₹47,000/month contractual.
* **Technician/Junior Assistant:** ₹35,000/month contractual.

### Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 21 September 2026
* **Online Application Deadline:** 4 November 2026
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline:** 11 November 2026 (5:30 PM)

### Application Fee
* **Superintendent & Technical Assistant:** ₹500
* **Technician & Junior Assistant:** ₹250
* **SC/ST/Women/Divyaang/Deputation:** Nil

### Selection Process
1. Screening/Shortlisting
2. Written Test
3. Trade Test (for relevant posts)
4. Document Verification

website_content.title: MPPSC Assistant Manager Result 2026 Out – Selection List & Marks Released
website_content.summary: Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has declared the final selection list for the Assistant Manager (Sahayak Prabandhak) Recruitment 2024. Candidates who attended the written exam and interview can now access the selection list and mark list.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MPPSC Assistant Manager Result 2026 Overview

The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore has officially announced the final selection list for the post of **Assistant Manager (Sahayak Prabandhak)** under the Public Health and Medical Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The selection list covers the main part (87%) of the total advertised posts under Advertisement No. 55/2024.

## Important Dates

* **Advertisement Date:** 31 December 2024
* **Written Exam Date:** 23 November 2025
* **Written Exam Result Date:** 12 January 2026
* **Interview Dates:** 8 July 2026 – 13 July 2026
* **Final Selection List Released:** 19 August 2026

## Vacancy & Result Details

* **Total Advertised Posts:** 68
* **Posts Covered in Main Part (87%):** 59
* **Remaining Posts (13% - Pravadhik Part):** Withheld as per judicial/administrative guidelines.
* **Evaluation Criteria:** Combined merit based on Written Exam (450 marks) and Interview (50 marks), totaling 500 marks.

## Key Guidelines & Notes

* **Unreserved Selections:** Reserved category candidates qualifying under general merit standards without relaxations have been selected against Unreserved (UR) seats.
* **Women Reservation:** In case of non-availability of eligible female candidates, posts are allocated to male candidates of the respective category as per state government rules.
* **Divyang Category Posts:** Out of 4 reserved Divyang posts, 3 remain vacant due to non-availability of eligible candidates. Corresponding unreserved posts have also been kept vacant as per applicable rules.
* **Legal Matters:** Selection remains subject to the final outcome of pending SLP and Writ Petitions in the Supreme Court and High Court.

website_content.summary: Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan has declared the KTET Result 2026 for the February session on September 19, 2026. Candidates of Categories 1, 2, 3, and 4 can now download their scorecards from the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KTET Result 2026 (February Session)

The **Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan** has officially released the results for the Kerala Teacher Eligibility Test (KTET) for the February 2026 session. Candidates who appeared for the exams held on August 8 and 9, 2026, can now access their qualifying status and marks.

### 📌 Result Overview
* **Conducting Body:** Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan
* **Exam Name:** Kerala Teacher Eligibility Test (KTET)
* **Session:** February 2026
* **Result Date:** September 19, 2026
* **Mode of Result:** Online
* **Login Requirements:** Register Number and Date of Birth

### 🎓 Categories Included
* **Category 1:** Lower Primary (LP)
* **Category 2:** Upper Primary (UP)
* **Category 3:** High School
* **Category 4:** Specialist

### 🛠️ Steps to Check KTET Result 2026
1. Visit the official website: **ktet.kerala.gov.in**
2. Navigate to the **Results** tab on the homepage.
3. Click on the link titled **"K-TET EXAMINATION RESULTS FEBRUARY 2026"**.
4. Select your specific **Category** from the dropdown menu.
5. Enter your **Register Number** and **Date of Birth** (dd/mm/yyyy).
6. Click **Submit** to view your result.
7. Download and print the scorecard for future reference.

### 📄 Details on Scorecard
* Candidate's Name
* Register Number
* Category (1, 2, 3, or 4)
* Date of Birth
* Qualifying Status
* Total Marks Obtained

website_content.title: HITES Recruitment 2026: Chief Manager & Operations Manager Vacancies
website_content.summary: HLL Infra Tech Services Ltd (HITES) invites online applications for 21 positions of Chief Manager, Senior Operations Manager, and Operations Manager. The deadline for submission is October 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## HITES Recruitment 2026 Overview
HLL Infra Tech Services Ltd (HITES), a subsidiary of HLL Lifecare Limited under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, is hiring for various management positions on a **Fixed Term Contract (FTC)** basis for an initial period of 3 years.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 10 October 2026 (up to 18:00 hours)
* **Cut-off Date (Age/Experience):** 01 September 2026

## Vacancy Breakdown
| Position | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- |
| Chief Manager (Civil) | 3 |
| Senior Operations Manager (MEP) | 5 |
| Operations Manager (Civil) | 5 |
| Operations Manager (BME) | 2 |
| Operations Manager (Quantity Surveyor) | 2 |
| Sr. Operations Manager (Structural) | 1 |
| Sr. Operations Manager (HVAC) | 1 |
| Sr. Operations Manager (Electrical) | 1 |
| Sr. Operations Manager (Plumbing) | 1 |
| **Total** | **21** |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Full-time Degree (B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech) or Diploma from a recognized university/institute in the relevant discipline (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Biomedical Engineering).
* **Experience:** Varies by role, ranging from **3 to 10 years** of post-qualification experience in project planning, design, or execution.
* **Age Limit:** 
    * Chief Manager: 47 Years
    * Sr. Operations Manager: 40–45 Years
    * Operations Manager: 40–45 Years
    * (Age relaxations apply for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per rules).

## Salary & Compensation
Pay scales are based on IDA (Pre-revised):
* **Chief Manager:** ₹29,100 – ₹54,500
* **Senior Operations Manager:** ₹24,900 – ₹50,500
* **Operations Manager:** ₹20,600 – ₹46,500
* Additional benefits include DA, Annual Increment, EPF, and Gratuity.

## Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on initial scrutiny of applications.
2. **Evaluation:** Shortlisted candidates will be called for an **Interview / Skill Assessment Test**.
3. **Verification:** Final appointment is subject to credential verification and medical fitness.

website_content.title: Karnataka NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment Schedule
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has announced the Round 2 counselling schedule for Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) admissions for 2026. Candidates can now access the official notice for seat allotment and option entry details.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** is conducting the state-level NEET MDS 2026 counselling for admissions to Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) programs in both government and private dental colleges across Karnataka.

## Key Details
* **Counselling Authority:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Course:** Master of Dental Surgery (MDS)
* **Current Stage:** Round 2 (Round 1 reporting concluded on September 18, 2026)
* **Seats Covered:** 50% government quota seats, 100% private dental college seats, NRI, and other state-notified quotas.

## Important Dates (Round 1 Reference)
* **Seat Matrix Release:** September 5, 2026
* **Option Entry Window:** September 5 to September 7, 2026
* **Provisional Result:** September 9, 2026
* **Final Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Reporting Deadline (Choice-1):** September 18, 2026

## How to Check Round 2 Updates
1. Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
2. Navigate to the **PG Dental / NEET MDS 2026** counselling section.
3. Log in using your **registration number/CET number** and password or QR code.
4. Review the Round 2 seat matrix and option entry dates.
5. Submit your college and specialisation preferences before the deadline.

## Critical Instructions
* **Eligibility:** Qualifying NEET MDS 2026 is mandatory, but admission is subject to rank, category, and document verification.
* **Preference List:** Candidates are advised to retain preferred options even if seats appear unavailable to account for consequential vacancies.
* **Parallel Counselling:** Those registered with MCC for All India Quota must track both KEA and MCC schedules separately.
* **Verification:** Always refer to the official KEA notification for final dates and fees.

website_content.title: Kurukshetra University (KUK) Exam Results May 2026
website_content.summary: Kurukshetra University has declared the results for various courses for the May 2026 examination session on September 18, 2026. Candidates can now download their detailed mark sheets via the official result portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Kurukshetra University (KUK) May 2026 Results

Kurukshetra University has officially announced the examination results for the **MAY 2026 session**. The results were published on September 18, 2026, and are available for download on the official university portal.

### Results Declared on 18 September 2026
Results have been released for the following courses and semesters:
* **Master of Computer Science (Software)** - II Semester
* **Adv. Dip. in Voc. (Textile & Fashion Designing)** - IV Semester
* **M.Sc. (Chemistry)** - IV Semester
* **M.Sc. (Chemistry)** - II Semester

### How to Check Your Result
Candidates can access their results using the following steps:
1. Visit the official **KUK Result Portal**.
2. Locate your specific **Course and Semester** from the provided list.
3. Click the **'Detail'** link to search for your individual result using your roll number.
4. Alternatively, click the **'CSV'** link to download the full result sheet for your course.

### Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Verification:** Carefully check your Roll Number, Name, Subject Codes, and Pass/Fail status.
* **Discrepancies:** If any error is found, submit a correction request via the KUK Discrepancy Performa.
* **Re-evaluation:** Students wishing to apply for re-evaluation must submit their application online within **15 days** of the result declaration.
* **Documentation:** It is recommended to save a PDF copy of the provisional result until the physical Detailed Marks Card (DMC) is issued.

website_content.title: All India Bar Examination XXII (AIBE 22) 2026 Application
website_content.summary: The Bar Council of India (BCI) invites law graduates to register for the AIBE 22 qualifying exam to obtain the Certificate of Practice (CoP). The application window closes on 27 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **All India Bar Examination XXII (AIBE 22)** is a mandatory qualifying test conducted by the **Bar Council of India (BCI)**. Successful candidates are granted the **Certificate of Practice (CoP)**, enabling them to practice law before courts, tribunals, and other judicial authorities across India.

## Important Dates
* **Official Notification:** 18 July 2026
* **Registration Start Date:** 19 August 2026
* **Last Date to Apply Online:** 27 October 2026
* **Last Date for Fee Payment:** 28 October 2026
* **Application Correction Deadline:** 30 October 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** 14 November 2026
* **Exam Date:** 29 November 2026

## Eligibility Criteria
* Candidates must be a **Law Graduate**.
* Candidates from AIBE XX or XXI who did not qualify may apply using their existing login credentials without fresh registration.

## Application Process
1. Visit the official portal at `allindiabarexamination.com`.
2. New users should click on **Registration**; existing users can use the **Login** portal.
3. Enter personal, educational, and enrolment details accurately.
4. Upload necessary documents and complete the online payment by 28 October 2026.
5. Submit the form and retain a printed copy for future reference.

website_content.title: KSLU Assistant Professor and Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) invites applications for 31 temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor and Guest Faculty positions. The deadline for application submission via hard copy or email is September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KSLU Recruitment 2026 Overview
Karnataka State Law University is seeking qualified candidates for temporary academic positions for the 2026–27 academic year.

### Vacancy Details
| Post | Subject | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor | Law | 21 |
| Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor | Management | 3 |
| Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor | Political Science | 1 |
| Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor | Sociology | 1 |
| Guest Faculty | Law | 5 |
| **Total** | | **31** |

### Eligibility Criteria
* **Temporary Assistant Professor:** Master's degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks and NET, SLET, SET, or Ph.D. qualification as per UGC Regulations 2018.
* **Guest Faculty (Law):** Master of Laws (LLM) with at least 55% marks. Preference given to candidates with NET, SLET, SET, or Ph.D.

### Remuneration
* **Assistant Professor:** ₹50,000 monthly consolidated pay.

* **Local Conveyance (Guest Faculty):** ₹150 per day.

### Selection Process
Selection will be based on an **interview**. Shortlisted candidates will be notified of the date. Original documents must be produced during verification.

### How to Apply
1. Download the notification and prescribed proforma from the official website.
2. Fill in the application form and affix a recent passport-size photograph.
3. Attach attested copies of mark sheets, degree certificates, and experience certificates.
4. Submit the application via **hard copy** to the Registrar, KSLU, Navanagar, Hubballi – 580025, or via the **official email address**.

website_content.summary: Baba Saheb Ambedkar Education University (BSAEU) is inviting applications for the B.Ed admission session 2026-28. The registration process is open from September 7 to September 21, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Baba Saheb Ambedkar Education University (BSAEU) has announced the admission process for the **Bachelor of Education (B.Ed)** course for the **2026-28 session**. Admission will be granted based on the merit of marks obtained in previous qualifying examinations; no separate entrance test will be conducted.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** September 7, 2026
* **Application End Date:** September 21, 2026
* **Merit List Publication:** September 25, 2026
* **Counselling and Seat Allocation:** September 29, 2026
* **Commencement of Classes:** November 3, 2026
* **Final Admission Deadline:** November 21, 2026

## Application Process
1. **Visit Official Portal:** Navigate to the BSAEU B.Ed online application link.
2. **Review Instructions:** Read eligibility, document requirements, and payment guidelines.
3. **Academic Details:** Enter qualifying examination marks and university information.
4. **Personal Information:** Fill in personal details ensuring they match official documents.
5. **Upload Documents:** Upload a photograph (max 110 KB) and signature (max 50 KB) in JPEG/JPG format.
6. **Submission:** Complete the CAPTCHA and submit the form.
7. **Payment:** Use the 'Pay Now' link to complete the application fee payment.
8. **Confirmation:** Save the Application ID, Password, and print the application receipt.

## Key Highlights
* **No Entrance Exam:** Selection is strictly merit-based (qualifying marks).
* **Documentation:** Ensure scanned images are within the prescribed size limits.
* **Verification:** Candidates are advised to verify college affiliation before paying any college-level fees.

## TN SSLC 10th Quarterly Exam 2026

The **Tamil Nadu Directorate of Government Examinations (DGE)** has announced the academic calendar and timetable for the Class 10 (SSLC) quarterly examinations for the year 2026. These exams are conducted at the school level based on the syllabus completed up to August.

### 📅 Exam Overview

* **Exam Timing:** 9:45 AM to 1:00 PM (Single Shift)

### 📖 Subject-wise Time Table
| Date | Subject |
| :--- | :--- |
| **September 17, 2026** | Tamil |
| **September 18, 2026** | English |
| **September 21, 2026** | Optional Language |
| **September 22, 2026** | Mathematics |
| **September 23, 2026** | Science |
| **September 25, 2026** | Social Science |

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Students
* **Reporting Time:** Students must reach the exam center well before the 9:45 AM start time.
* **Requirements:** Carry all necessary stationery and any school-issued admit cards or identification.
* **Guidelines:** Follow specific seating and conduct instructions provided by the respective school administration.

* Create a subject-wise study plan based on the released timetable.

* Prepare short notes for quick revision in the final days.

website_content.title: CUET PG Geography Syllabus 2027 - NTA
website_content.summary: NTA has released the detailed syllabus for the CUET PG Geography exam (Paper Code: HUQP08) for 2027 admissions. Candidates can now access the unit-wise breakdown to streamline their postgraduate entrance preparation.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CUET PG Geography 2027 Overview
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has prescribed the official syllabus for candidates appearing for the **Geography paper (Code: HUQP08)** under the Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduate programmes.

**Key Exam Details:**
* **Conducting Body:** National Testing Agency (NTA)
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT)
* **Subject:** Geography
* **Paper Code:** HUQP08

## Syllabus Structure
The syllabus is strategically divided into **eight core units**:
* Human Geography
* General Cartography
* Environmental Geography
* Geography of India
* Economic Geography
* Disaster Management
* Geography of Tourism
* Sustainability & Development

## Marking Scheme & Instructions
To ensure a high score, candidates must be mindful of the following marking pattern:
* **Correct Answer:** +4 Marks
* **Incorrect Answer:** -1 Mark (Negative Marking)
* **Unattempted Questions:** 0 Marks

**Preparation Tips:**
* Strictly follow the syllabus published on the official NTA website.
* Solve previous years' question papers to understand the difficulty level and pattern.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
Candidates must meet one of the following combinations:
* **Option 1:** Master’s degree in Economics, Commerce, Statistics, Business Studies, or Public Administration **AND** 1 year of experience in store handling/accounting.
* **Option 2:** Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in the above-mentioned fields **AND** 2 years of experience in store handling/accounting.

**Age Limit:** 18 to 30 years (as of 03 Nov 2026). Age relaxation applies for ST (5 years) and Govt servants as per rules.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Application Scrutiny**
2. **Document Verification**
3. **Written Examination** (80 Marks - Objective Type)
4. **Merit List Preparation**

**Exam Pattern:** Mathematics (15), Mental Ability (15), General Awareness (15), English (15), and Professional Knowledge (20).

### ✉️ How to Apply
This is an **OFFLINE** application process. Applications sent via courier or by hand will be rejected.
1. Download the prescribed application form.
2. Attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, educational certificates, experience certificates, and photos.
3. Include a **self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 50 postal stamp**.
4. Send to: *The Director General, For PD (Recruitment), Coast Guard Headquarters, Directorate of Recruitment, C-1, Phase II, Industrial Area, Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201309*.

## MCC NEET UG 2026 Counselling Overview

The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) is conducting the counselling process for admission to **MBBS, BDS, and BSc Nursing** programmes for the 2026 academic session. This includes the 15% All India Quota (AIQ), Deemed Universities, and Central Institutions.

### 📅 Important Dates: Round 3
* **Registration & Fee Payment:** September 22 to 27, 2026
* **Choice Filling:** September 23 to 28, 2026
* **Choice Locking:** September 27 (7 PM) to September 28 (12 Noon)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 30, 2026
* **Reporting at Institute:** October 1 to 9, 2026

### 📅 Important Dates: Online Stray Vacancy Round
* **Registration & Fee Payment:** October 12 to 14, 2026
* **Choice Filling:** October 12 to 15, 2026
* **Choice Locking:** October 14 (4 PM) to October 15 (10 AM)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** October 17, 2026
* **Reporting at Institute:** October 19 to 26, 2026

### 📝 How to Register

ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Ranchi, has released advertisement **06 of 2026** for various faculty and resident positions on a contractual basis. This is a prime opportunity for medical professionals to serve in a prestigious government institution.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Professor:** 10 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 19 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 16 Posts
* **Senior Resident:** 40 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 85

### 🏥 Departments Covered
Vacancies are available across multiple departments including **Anaesthesiology, Anatomy, Biochemistry, Community Medicine, Dermatology, ENT, Eye, Medicine, OBG, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, Radiology, and Surgery**, among others.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** Must possess MBBS and PG qualifications (MD/MS/DNB) as per **National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines dated 30 June 2025**.
* **Registration:** Valid registration with the NMC or State Medical Council is mandatory.
* **Age Limit:** 
    * Professors/Assoc/Asst Professors: Up to **69 years**.
    * Senior Residents (Non-clinical): Up to **50 years**.
    * Senior Residents (Clinical): Up to **45 years**.

### 💰 Salary Structure
| Post | Pay Level | Basic Remuneration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Professor | Level 13 | **₹1,23,100** |
| Associate Professor | Level 12 | **₹78,800** |
| Assistant Professor | Level 11 | **₹67,700** |
| Senior Resident | Level 11 | **₹67,700** |

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 21 September 2026
* **Tentative Interview Date:** 30 September 2026

### 📝 Application Process
1. Download the prescribed application form from the official website.
2. Attach self-attested copies of all educational and experience certificates.
3. Pay the application fee of **₹500** via Demand Draft (Nil for SC/ST/Female/PH/Ex-SM).
4. Submit the application via **Email, Speed Post, or by hand** to the Dean, ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Ranchi.

**Note:** Separate applications are required for each post applied for.

website_content.title: Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026: Jailor, Warder & Instructor Vacancies
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Prisons and Reforms Services Department is recruiting 869 personnel across General and Kalyana Karnataka cadres. Apply by October 15, 2026, via the KEA portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has invited online applications for various base-cadre posts within the **Karnataka Prisons and Reforms Services Department**. This recruitment is split into two cadres: General (Rest of State) and Kalyana Karnataka (Hyderabad-Karnataka Region).

## Vacancy Details
**Total Posts: 869**

### 1. General / Rest-of-State Cadre (576 Posts)
* **Warder (Vikshakaru):** 560 posts
* **Second Grade Teacher / Instructor Grade-II:** 16 posts

### 2. Kalyana Karnataka Cadre (293 Posts)
* **Jailor:** 5 posts
* **Warder (Vikshakaru):** 275 posts
* **Warder cum Nursing:** 5 posts
* **Second Grade Teacher / Instructor Grade-II:** 8 posts

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualifications
* **Jailor:** Bachelor's Degree (Preference for Sociology, Psychology, Criminology, or Correctional Administration).
* **Warder:** SSLC (10th) pass or equivalent.
* **Instructor Grade-II:** SSLC pass + Diploma/Certificate in relevant trade (Mechanical/Electrical/Tailoring, etc.).
* **Warder cum Nursing:** SSLC pass + First Aid Certificate.

### Age Limit (as of 15.10.2026)
* **General Merit:** Maximum 31 years
* **SC/ST/Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B:** Maximum 33 years
* **Minimum Age:** 20 years

## Selection Process
1. **Competitive Written Exam:** OMR-based test (100 marks) focusing on GK, Science, History, Constitution, and Mental Ability. (Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer).
2. **Physical Standard Test (PST) & Endurance Test:** Shortlisted candidates (1:5 ratio) must pass height, chest/weight requirements and endurance events (Race, Jump, Shot Put).
3. **Medical Examination:** Vision, hearing, and physical fitness check by a Medical Board.
4. **Document Verification.**

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 18.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 19.09.2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 15.10.2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 16.10.2026
* **Written Examination Date:** 21.11.2026

## Application Fee
* **General/Other Categories:** ₹750
* **SC/ST/Cat-1/Ex-Servicemen:** ₹500

website_content.title: SWAYAM July 2026 Semester (SWAYAM-17) Exam Date 2026
website_content.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the examination schedule for the SWAYAM July 2026 semester. Exams are scheduled to take place from December 8 to December 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SWAYAM-17 Examination Overview
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially announced the dates for the **SWAYAM July 2026 Semester** examinations. Candidates are advised to note the dates and prepare accordingly.

## 📅 Key Examination Dates
* **Exam Window:** December 8, 2026, to December 12, 2026
* **Buffer Dates:** December 13 and 14, 2026
* **Notice Date:** September 17, 2026

## 🕒 Exam Shift Timings
Exams will be conducted in two shifts, each lasting **3 hours**:
* **Morning Shift:** 9:30 AM – 12:30 PM
* **Evening Shift:** 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM

## ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Mode of Exam:** Depending on the course, exams may be held via **CBT (Computer Based Test)**, **Pen-and-Paper**, or a **Hybrid mode**.
* **Admit Cards:** Candidates must download and carry a printed copy of their admit card, which will contain the specific date, shift, and center.
* **No Retest Policy:** NTA will **not provide a retest** for candidates who miss their allotted date or shift.

## 🛠️ How to Check the Schedule
1. Visit the official NTA or SWAYAM portal.
2. Navigate to the **Public Notice** section.
3. Click on the notice dated September 17, 2026, regarding the July 2026 Semester (SWAYAM-17).

website_content.title: GMRC Civil Engineering Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation Limited (GMRC) is hiring for 48 Civil Engineering positions ranging from Junior Engineer to Chief General Manager. The last date for online application is October 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GMRC Civil Recruitment 2026 Overview

Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation Limited (GMRC) has announced vacancies for various **Civil Engineering** positions on a Contract, Deputation, and Post-Superannuation basis. This is a prime opportunity for experienced infrastructure professionals to contribute to Gujarat's urban transit network.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 48
* **Posts:** Chief GM, GM, AGM, JGM, Sr. DGM, DGM, Manager, Assistant Manager, Engineer (Sr/Jr), Draftsman, and Surveyor.
* **Application Mode:** Online
* **Job Location:** Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, or other GMRC projects in Gujarat.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 03 October 2026
* **Interview Date:** To be communicated via email

### 🎓 Eligibility & Experience
* **For Officers (CGM to Asst Manager):** B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering. Experience required in metro, railway, bridges, tunnels, or multi-storeyed buildings (ranges from 5 to 23 years depending on the post).
* **For Engineers (Sr/Jr Grade):** B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering with 2-3 years of post-qualification experience.
* **For Draftsman & Surveyor:** 3-year Diploma in Civil Engineering with at least 3 years of relevant experience in AutoCAD/Surveying for large infrastructure projects.

### 💰 Salary & Pay Scale
* **Chief General Manager/GM:** Rs. 1,20,000 – 2,80,000
* **Manager:** Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000
* **Engineer (Junior Grade):** Rs. 30,000 – 1,20,000
* **Draftsman/Surveyor:** Rs. 33,000 – 1,00,000
*(Note: Post-superannuation consolidated pay is available for senior roles).* 

### 🛠️ Selection Process
1. **Application Screening:** Shortlisting based on criteria.
2. **Document Verification:** Verification of original certificates.
3. **Personal Interview:** Assessment of skills, expertise, and aptitude.
4. **Medical Examination:** Final fitness check.

### 📝 How to Apply
* Visit the official GMRC careers portal.
* Register with basic details and obtain a login passcode via email.
* Fill in employment history and upload required documents (CV, Degree, Experience Certificates, and CTC breakup for private sector candidates).
* Submit the application before the deadline.

website_content.title: CUET PG 2027 Exam Dates and Registration Schedule
website_content.summary: NTA has announced the official exam schedule for CUET PG 2027, set to take place in March 2027. Registration for the postgraduate entrance test is expected to commence in December 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CUET PG 2027 Overview
The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** will conduct the Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduate (CUET PG) 2027 to facilitate admissions into various PG programs. 

* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT)
* **Exam Dates:** March 1 to 5, 8, 12 to 20, 24 and 25, 2027
* **Buffer Dates:** March 30 and 31, 2027
* **Shifts:** Three shifts per exam day

## Important Dates
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Registration Begins** | December 2026 |
| **Registration Deadline** | January 2027 |
| **Correction Window** | January 2027 |
| **Admit Card Release** | February 2027 |
| **Exam Dates** | March 1-25, 2027 |
| **Results & Counselling** | April 2027 |

## Registration Process
Candidates can apply online following these steps:
* Visit the official NTA CUET PG portal.
* Complete registration with academic and personal details.
* Select preferred programs and exam cities.
* Pay the required application fee online.
* Upload necessary documents, photographs, and signatures.
* Submit the form and print the confirmation page.

## Key Instructions
* **Admit Card:** Exact exam date, shift, and reporting time will be mentioned only on the admit card.
* **Buffer Dates:** March 30-31 are reserve dates for rescheduling and should not be treated as default exam dates.
* **Updates:** Regularly check the official portal for the detailed information bulletin.

website_content.title: NEET-SS Special Stray Vacancy Round 2026: Cut-off Lowered to 30 Percentile
website_content.summary: The Centre has proposed reducing the NEET-SS qualifying percentile to 30% to fill 1,857 vacant super-speciality seats. Candidates should monitor the MCC portal for the formal notification and schedule.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET-SS Special Stray Vacancy Round 2026

The Government of India has informed the Supreme Court regarding a proposed reduction in the qualifying percentile for the **National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test-Super Speciality (NEET-SS)** to ensure the utilization of vacant medical seats.

### Key Highlights
* **Revised Cut-off:** Qualifying percentile reduced from 50th to **30th percentile**.
* **Total Vacancies:** 1,857 super-speciality medical seats.
* **Impact:** Approximately 6,000 additional candidates are expected to become eligible.
* **Purpose:** To fill seats remaining vacant after the second round of counselling via a **Special Stray Vacancy Round**.

### Eligibility Criteria
* Candidates must have appeared for the NEET-SS exam.
* Must meet the revised **30th percentile** threshold.
* Only candidates who have **not yet joined** a seat in previous NEET-SS rounds are eligible.
* **Note for TN Candidates:** Tamil Nadu in-service candidates should follow separate state-level updates for 40 specific seats.

### How to Check Eligibility (Once Active)
1. Visit the official MCC counselling website.
2. Navigate to the notice for the **"Special Stray Vacancy Round"**.
3. Log in using your NEET-SS roll number and registration credentials.
4. Verify your percentile against the new 30% cut-off.

### Important Disclaimer
This update is based on a **proposal submitted by the Centre to the Supreme Court**. Candidates are strongly advised to wait for the formal MCC notification regarding final dates, fees, and application processes.

website_content.summary: The OJEE Committee has announced the tentative counselling and admission schedule for BAMS and BHMS courses for the 2026-27 session. Eligible NEET (UG) 2026 candidates can begin registration starting 17 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## OJEE BAMS/BHMS Counselling 2026-27

The **Odisha Joint Entrance Examination (OJEE) Committee** has released the official schedule for admissions into Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (**BAMS**) and Bachelor of Homoeopathic Medicine and Surgery (**BHMS**) for the academic session 2026-27.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Eligibility:** Candidates must have qualified **NEET (UG) 2026** with a valid rank.
* **Courses Offered:** BAMS and BHMS.
* **Registration Fee:** ₹1,000 (Non-refundable).
* **Part-Admission Fee:** ₹8,500.

### 📅 Important Dates (Round 1)
* **Registration & Choice Filling Starts:** 17 September 2026, 5:00 PM
* **Mock Seat Allotment:** 21 September 2026, 5:00 PM
* **Choice Locking Deadline:** 23 September 2026, 11:59 PM
* **Seat Allotment Result:** 25 September 2026, 5:00 PM
* **Reporting for Verification:** 28 - 29 September 2026

### 📝 Admission Process
1. **Registration:** Create a profile using the NEET (UG) 2026 application number on the official portal.
2. **Payment:** Pay the registration fee of ₹1,000 online.
3. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.
4. **Locking:** Ensure choices are locked before the deadline to avoid automatic system locking.
5. **Allotment:** Download the provisional allotment letter upon seat allocation.
6. **Reporting:** Complete fee payment (₹8,500) and report to the OJEE Cell, Gandamunda, Bhubaneswar for document verification.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Fresh Choices:** Choices filled in Round 1 are void for Round 2; candidates must fill fresh choices for subsequent rounds.
* **Disqualification:** Failure to pay fees or report for verification will lead to disqualification from the admission process.
* **Withdrawal:** No withdrawal is permitted after the Round 3 allotment.

website_content.title: MCC NEET UG 2026 Round 1 & 2 Resignation and Seat Withdrawal Notice
website_content.summary: The MCC has opened the resignation and seat withdrawal facility for candidates who joined Round 1 seats in NEET UG 2026. Eligible candidates must complete the process by September 15, 2026, to avoid forfeiture of their security deposit.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) and Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) have announced the window for **resignation and seat withdrawal** for candidates who joined a seat during Round 1 of the NEET UG 2026 Counselling.

## Eligibility
This facility is applicable to candidates who joined a Round 1 seat and:
* **Float Candidates:** Did not upgrade in Round 2.
* **Freeze Candidates:** Chose to retain their Round 1 seat.

## Critical Deadlines
* **Resignation Deadline:** Till 6:00 PM on **15 September 2026** (to ensure security deposit is not forfeited).
* **Withdrawal Window:** 17 September 2026.

## Process & Instructions
* **Float Candidates:** Must log into the official MCC candidate portal to generate the **Seat Withdrawal Slip** independently.
* **Freeze Candidates:** Cannot resign online; the process must be initiated through the **Nodal Officer** of the allotted institute.
* **Validation:** Any resignation without a portal-generated Withdrawal Slip will be treated as **'Null and Void'**.
* **Caution:** Informal communications (like emails to colleges) are not valid proof of resignation unless accompanied by the official portal document.

website_content.summary: The Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC) is recruiting 130 Managers (Engineering) for the Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board. Applications close on October 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TGPSC HMWSSB Manager Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of **Manager (Engineering)** positions at the Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 18 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 23 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 17 October 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Tentative Exam Date:** December 2026

### 📋 Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 130
* **Cadre:** Multi Zone II
* **Branch-wise Distribution:**
    * Civil Engineering: 80%
    * Electrical or Mechanical Engineering: 15%
    * CSE, IT, or ECE: 5%

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must possess a graduate degree in the prescribed engineering discipline as of 18 September 2026.
* **Age Limit (as of 01-07-2026):** 18 to 44 years.
    * *Relaxation:* SC/ST/BC/EWS (5 years), PwD (10 years), TS Govt Employees (up to 5 years).

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 54,220 to Rs. 1,33,630

### ✍️ Selection Process & Exam Pattern
Selection will be based on an objective examination conducted via **CBRT or OMR**.

| Paper | Subject | Questions | Marks | Duration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Paper I | General Studies & General Abilities | 150 | 150 | 150 Mins |
| Paper II | Concerned Engineering Subject | 150 | 300 | 150 Mins |
| **Total** | | **300** | **450** | **300 Mins** |

### 💸 Application Fees
* **OC & BC:** Rs. 1,000 (Processing) + Rs. 120 (Exam fee, if applicable)
* **SC/ST/PwD:** Rs. 500 (Processing) + Rs. 120 (Exam fee, if applicable)
* *Note: Unemployed applicants are exempt from the exam fee.*

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Gauhati High Court (High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh) has published the provisional answer key for the OMR-based written examination for **Judicial Assistant** posts at the Kohima Bench.

* **Number of Posts:** 6
* **Exam Date:** 12 September 2026

* **Notification No:** HC.XXXVII-01/2026/317/R.Cell

## Important Dates for Objections
* **Objection Window Opens:** 22 September 2026
* **Objection Window Closes:** 24 September 2026 (till 5:00 PM)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 28 September 2026 (within bank transaction hours)

## Process to Raise Objections
Candidates wishing to challenge the provisional answer key must follow these steps:
1. **Login:** Access your candidate account via the official portal.
2. **Selection:** Select the specific question(s) you wish to challenge.
3. **Payment:** Pay a **non-refundable fee of ₹50** per question.
4. **Evidence:** Upload valid documentary proof to support the objection.
5. **Submission:** Ensure submission is completed by 24 September, 5:00 PM.

## Crucial Instructions
* Only candidates who appeared for the exam on 12 Sept 2026 are eligible.
* Objections are accepted **Online Only**; email or postal submissions will be rejected.
* Payment must be completed by 28 September 2026 to finalize the objection.

The **Nagaland Public Service Commission (NPSC)** has officially released the corrected answer key for the Common Educational Services Examination (CESE) 2026. This update supersedes the previous answer key released on 12th August 2026 for specific disciplines.

### 📌 Key Notification Details
* **Issuing Authority:** NPSC, Kohima
* **Notification Number:** NPSC/CESE-12/AK/2021
* **Release Date:** 16th September 2026
* **Scope of Correction:** 8 (Eight) subjects/disciplines have been revised.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Original Answer Key Date:** 12th August 2026
* **Corrected Answer Key Date:** 16th September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download the Revised Answer Key
1. Visit the official NPSC portal: **npsc.nagaland.gov.in**
2. Go to the **Notice Board** or notifications section.
3. Look for the link titled **"Corrected Answer Key - CESE 2026"** or reference number **NPSC/CESE-12/AK/2021**.
4. Download the PDF and verify your responses against the updated keys for the 8 corrected subjects.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* Candidates who previously checked the August 12th key must **re-verify** their answers for the listed 8 subjects.
* The notification does not specify a window for further objections against this corrected key.
* Stay tuned to the official website for updates regarding the final result and interview schedules.
