website_content.title: Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Southern Railway (RRC Chennai) invites applications for 17 vacancies under the Scouts and Guides Quota for Level 1 and Level 2 posts. Eligible candidates must apply online by October 18, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚂 Southern Railway Recruitment 2026 (Scouts & Guides Quota)

The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Chennai, has released an employment notice (**RRC-01/S&G/2026-27**) for recruitment under the Scouts and Guides Quota. This is a specialized recruitment drive for active members of the scouting movement.

### 📋 Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 17
* **Level 2 Posts:** 3 Vacancies (Southern Railway & Integral Coach Factory)
* **Level 1 Posts:** 14 Vacancies (Distributed across Chennai, Tiruchchirappalli, Madurai, Palakkad, Thiruvananthapuram, and Salem divisions)

### 🎓 Educational Eligibility
**For Level 2:**
* Class 12th (minimum 50% marks) **OR**
* Matriculation + Course Completed Act Apprenticeship **OR**
* Matriculation + ITI (NCVT approved).

**For Level 1:**
* Class 10th pass **OR** ITI / NAC / Combined 10th + ITI/NAC.

### 🏕️ Mandatory Scouts & Guides Requirements
Candidates **must** satisfy the following to be eligible:
* Must be a **President’s Scout, Guide, Rover, Ranger**, or Himalayan Wood Badge holder.
* Active membership in a Scouts organization for the last **5 years**.
* Possession of a **Certificate of Activeness**.
* Participation in at least **two National Level** events and **two State Level** events.

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 19 September 2026 (9:00 AM)
* **Application Closing Date:** 18 October 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Age Limit Reference Date:** 01 January 2027

### ✍️ Selection Process
The recruitment is based on a total of **100 marks**:
1. **Written/Hybrid Examination (60 Marks):** 40 Objective questions (1 mark each) and 1 Essay (20 marks). *Note: 1/3 negative marking for objective questions.*
2. **Certificate Assessment (40 Marks):** Marks awarded for participation in National, State, and District rallies/courses.

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹500 (₹400 refundable upon appearing in exam)
* **SC/ST/Female/PwBD/EWS:** ₹250 (Fully refundable upon appearing in exam)

website_content.markdown_content:
## RSSB BCI & SCI Answer Key 2026

The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB), Jaipur, has officially released the **Provisional Answer Key, Master Question Papers, and Candidate Response Sheets** for the Basic Computer Instructor (BCI) and Senior Computer Instructor (SCI) recruitment (Advt No. 07/2026).

### 📅 Key Dates for Candidates
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 18 September 2026
* **Online Objection Window:** 19 September 2026 (00:01 AM) to 21 September 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Offline Objection Submission:** 22 September 2026 (10:00 AM) to 24 September 2026 (06:00 PM)

### 🛠 How to Download Answer Key & Response Sheet
1. Visit the official RSSB portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Answer Key'** or **'News & Events'** section.
3. Click on the link for **'Basic & Senior Computer Instructor Direct Recruitment 2026'**.
4. Select the appropriate post (BCI or SCI) and Paper (I or II).
5. Log in using your **SSO ID** to access your personal response sheet.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Objections
* **Online Mode:** Use the SSO login portal to submit justifications with supporting proof.
* **Offline Mode:** Submit objections in the prescribed format at the RSSB office in Jaipur.
* **Reference:** Always use the **Master Question Paper** for framing objections to avoid errors in question/option numbering.
* **Finality:** The final answer key and results will be prepared only after the expert panel reviews all valid objections.

website_content.title: MP Police Subedar (Ministerial) Stenographer and ASI Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: MPESB invites online applications for 655 vacancies of Subedar (Ministerial) Stenographer and Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) posts. The application window closes on 8 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MP Police Ministerial Recruitment 2026

The **Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB)** is recruiting for ministerial positions within the Madhya Pradesh Police Department. This is a prime opportunity for candidates with computer and stenography skills.

### 📌 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Subedar (Ministerial) Stenographer:** 135 Posts
* **Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial):** 520 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 655

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**1. Educational Qualification:**
* **All Posts:** Passed Higher Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board.
* **Technical Requirements:** Valid CPCT certificate with Hindi typing and an approved computer qualification (Degree/Diploma/Certificate).
* **Subedar (Steno) Specific:** Hindi shorthand speed of 100 words per minute.

**2. Age Limit (as of 08-10-2026):**
* **General/Other State Candidates:** Max 33 years
* **MP Female/SC/ST/OBC:** Max 38 years
* **Special Categories (Inter-caste/Vikram Award):** Up to 43 years

### 💰 Salary Scale
* **Subedar (Steno):** Rs. 36,200 to Rs. 1,14,800
* **ASI (Ministerial):** Rs. 19,500 to Rs. 62,000
*(Note: New recruits receive a percentage-based pay scale for the first 3 years as per MP Govt rules).*

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 24 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 8 October 2026
* **Correction Window Ends:** 13 October 2026
* **Written Exam Date:** From 3 November 2026

### ⚙️ Selection Process

## BSE Odisha OSSTET Admit Card 2026 Overview

The **Board of Secondary Education, Odisha (BSE Odisha)** has announced the schedule for the Odisha Secondary School Teacher Eligibility Test (OSSTET) 2026. Candidates who successfully registered can download their hall tickets online prior to the examination day.

### Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 1 August 2026
* **Online Application Window:** 3 August 2026 to 17 August 2026
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 20 September 2026
* **OSSTET Exam Date:** 30 September 2026 (Wednesday)

### Exam Highlights
* **Exam Name:** Odisha Secondary School Teacher Eligibility Test (OSSTET) 2026

* **Mode of Exam:** Offline (Pen-and-Paper)
* **Mode of Download:** Online via bseodisha.ac.in

### Steps to Download OSSTET Hall Ticket 2026
1. Visit the official portal of BSE Odisha.
2. Go to the **Latest Updates** or **Notifications** section on the homepage.
3. Click on the link for **OSSTET 2026 Admit Card / Hall Ticket Download**.
4. Enter your required credentials (Registration Number, Mobile Number, or Date of Birth).
5. Submit details to view your admit card on screen.
6. Download and print a clean copy for exam day.

### Documents to Carry to the Exam Centre
* Printed hard copy of the **OSSTET Admit Card 2026**
* Original valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, or Driving License)
* Passport-size photographs (if specified on the hall ticket)

### Key Instructions for Candidates
* Reach the allotted exam center at least **30–45 minutes** before reporting time.
* Verify details such as candidate name, photo, roll number, and exam center address upon downloading.
* Electronic gadgets, smartwatches, and mobile phones are strictly prohibited inside the hall.

website_content.title: MP Police ASI & Subedar (Stenographer) Recruitment 2026 Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: Detailed guide on the written and practical examination syllabus for the MP Police ASI and Subedar (Steno) recruitment 2026 conducted by the MP Police Recruitment Board.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Prepare for the **MP Police ASI & Subedar (Stenographer) 2026** exams with a clear understanding of the selection process and syllabus. The recruitment is handled by the Madhya Pradesh Police Recruitment Board.

## Selection Process
Candidates must qualify in each of the following stages to proceed:
* **Written Exam:** Objective test (Paper 1 & 2).
* **Practical Test:** Skill-based test in Hindi Shorthand and Typing.
* **Document Verification:** Final verification of educational and category credentials.

## Exam Pattern

### 1. Written Examination
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Minimum Qualifying Marks:** 30%
* **Language:** Hindi & English
* **Negative Marking:** None

### 2. Practical Examination (100 Marks)
* **Subedar (Steno):** Hindi shorthand dictation (100 wpm) and transcription typing.
* **ASI (Steno):** Hindi typing of long passages (approx. 600 words each).

## Detailed Syllabus

### Paper 1: General Ability
* **General Knowledge:** Current Affairs, Indian History & Culture, Geography, Economy, Govt Schemes, and Environment.
* **Reasoning:** Verbal & Non-verbal, Series, Analogies, and Coding-Decoding.
* **Science & Mathematics:** Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, and Data Interpretation.

### Paper 2: Language & Awareness
* **Hindi Language:** Grammar, Vocabulary, Reading Comprehension, Antonyms & Synonyms.
* **English Language:** Grammar, Vocabulary, Reading Comprehension, Sentence Formation.
* **General Knowledge:** Reiteration of key GK topics including Current Affairs and History.

## Preparation Tips
* Solve **previous year papers** to understand weightage.
* Practice **Hindi shorthand/typing daily** to improve speed and accuracy.
* Use a timer while solving Math and Reasoning questions.

website_content.title: WB NEET UG Counselling 2026 Revised Schedule
website_content.summary: WBMCC has announced the revised counselling schedule for MBBS and BDS admissions for the 2026 session. This process covers State, Private Management, and NRI quota seats across West Bengal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC)** is facilitating admissions for MBBS and BDS courses in both government and private medical/dental colleges. The process is based on the **NEET UG 2026** qualifying examination.

## Key Highlights
* **Courses:** MBBS and BDS
* **Quota Covered:** 85% State Quota, Private Management Quota, and NRI Quota
* **Mode of Counselling:** Online
* **Rounds:** Three main rounds followed by an Online Stray Vacancy Round

## Important Dates
* **Round 1 Registration:** Began August 13, 2026 (Closed Aug 23)
* **Round 1 Allotment Result:** August 31, 2026
* **Round 2 Allotment Result:** September 15, 2026
* **Physical Reporting (Round 2):** September 16 to September 18, 2026

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. Visit the official WBMCC portal.
2. Register using **NEET UG roll number**, application number, and date of birth.
3. Complete the online counselling fee payment.
4. Upload required documents and complete verification.
5. Fill and **lock your college/course choices** before the deadline.
6. Check seat allotment results and report physically to the allotted institute if selected.

## Important Instructions
* Ensure you click **'Lock Choices'** to avoid disqualification or automatic system processing.
* Keep original documents and demand drafts ready for physical reporting.
* Failure to report within the stipulated window may result in forfeiture of the seat.
* Regularly monitor the official notice board for Round 3 and Stray Vacancy updates.

website_content.summary: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) invites applications for 50 contractual positions across various specializations. The deadline for online submission is September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KVIC Recruitment 2026 Overview

The **Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)**, under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, is hiring for various contractual positions at its Central Office in **Mumbai**.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Young Professional:** 20 Posts
* **Advisor:** 15 Posts
* **Senior Consultant:** 15 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 50

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Young Professional**
* **Education:** Full-time Postgraduate degree in relevant fields (Accounts, HR, Textile, Law, Marketing, Civil Engg, Science, or Mass Comm).
* **Age Limit:** Below 27 years (as of 01-10-2026).

**2. Advisor**
* **Requirement:** Exclusively for retired/voluntarily retired Govt/PSU personnel.
* **Experience:** Minimum 15 years of relevant experience.
* **Age Limit:** 40 to 65 years.

**3. Senior Consultant**
* **Education:** Postgraduate or Management degree.
* **Experience:** At least 5 years of experience in the relevant field.
* **Age Limit:** Below 39 years.

### 💰 Remuneration
* **Young Professional:** ₹25,000 - ₹30,000 + Conveyance (₹2,500 - ₹3,000).
* **Senior Consultant:** ₹30,000 - ₹40,000 + Conveyance (₹2,500 - ₹3,000).
* **Advisor:** As per DoPT guidelines (Basic pension deducted from last basic pay).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** Active
* **Last Date to Apply:** 30 September 2026 (11:59 PM)

### 🛠 Selection Process
1. Screening of online applications
2. Shortlisting based on qualification/experience
3. Document Verification
4. Personal Interview

### 📝 Application Mode
* **Mode:** Online only via the official recruitment portal.
* **Required Documents:** Photo, Signature, DOB Proof, PG Degree, Experience Certificates, and a 200-word experience summary.

website_content.title: UPSSSC PET Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026
website_content.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the detailed syllabus and exam pattern for the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2026. Qualifying PET is mandatory for appearing in upcoming UP Group B and C recruitment exams.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UPSSSC PET Overview 2026

The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) conducts the **Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET)** as a mandatory eligibility/screening exam for recruitment to various Group B and Group C posts across Uttar Pradesh.

* **Exam Name:** UPSSSC PET 2026
* **Conducting Body:** Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission
* **Exam Mode:** Offline (OMR Based)
* **Question Type:** Objective Type MCQs
* **Total Questions:** 100
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Duration:** 2 Hours (120 Minutes)
* **Negative Marking:** ¼ (0.25) mark per wrong answer

---

## Subject-Wise Marks Distribution

* **Indian History:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Indian National Movement:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Geography:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Indian Economy:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Indian Constitution & Public Administration:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **General Science:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Elementary Arithmetic:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **General Hindi:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **General English:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Logic & Reasoning:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Current Affairs:** 10 Questions | 10 Marks
* **General Awareness:** 10 Questions | 10 Marks
* **Analysis of Hindi Unread Passages (2 Passages):** 10 Questions | 10 Marks
* **Graph Interpretation (2 Graphs):** 10 Questions | 10 Marks
* **Table Interpretation & Analysis (2 Tables):** 10 Questions | 10 Marks

---

## UPSSSC PET Selection Process 2026

1. **Stage 1 - PET (Preliminary Eligibility Test):** Common screening test to obtain a valid PET score.
2. **Stage 2 - Post-Specific Mains Exam:** Candidates with valid PET scores apply for specific recruitments (e.g., Lekhpal, Junior Assistant, Excise Constable).
3. **Document Verification / Skill Test / Physical Test:** As per specific post requirement.

* **Online Application Closing Date:** 30.09.2026 (Wednesday)
* **Interview Reporting Time:** 9:30 AM

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Medical (SR):** Postgraduate medical degree (**MD/MS/DNB**) in the relevant subject. Certain super-specialty posts require **DM/MCh/DNB** or an eligible MD/DNB in an allied broad specialty.
* **Non-Medical (Sr. Demonstrator):** Specifically for Anatomy and Pharmacology departments; requires **M.Sc./M.Biotech plus a Ph.D.** in the concerned or allied subject.

* **General Medicine:** 6 posts
* **Hospital Administration:** 6 posts

### 📝 Important Instructions
* **Cross-Department Eligibility:** Candidates from 'Column A' departments (e.g., General Surgery) may be considered for 'Column B' departments (e.g., Neurosurgery, Plastic Surgery) if no suitable candidates are found.
* **Certification:** OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must be issued **on or after 01.04.2026**.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
AIIMS New Delhi is conducting the **INI CET January 2027** session. This is a common postgraduate medical entrance exam for admission to premier institutes across India, including **AIIMS institutions, JIPMER Puducherry, PGIMER Chandigarh, NIMHANS Bengaluru, and SCTIMST Thiruvananthapuram**.

## Courses Offered
* MD
* MS
* MDS
* DM (6-year)
* MCh (6-year)
* Other notified postgraduate programmes

## Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** September 16, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** October 13, 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Image Correction Window:** October 17-19, 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** October 26, 2026
* **Exam Date:** November 1, 2026

## How to Apply
1. **One Time Registration (OTR):** Complete the OTR on the official portal (DigiLocker verification recommended).
2. **Application Form:** Log in to fill in personal, educational, and internship details.
3. **Document Upload:** Upload photograph, signature, and thumb impression as per prescribed formats.
4. **Payment:** Pay the category-wise fee via online modes (Credit/Debit card/Net Banking).
5. **Submission:** Review all details and download the confirmation page.

## Key Instructions
* **No Extensive Correction:** Be careful during submission; only a limited window is available from Oct 17-19.
* **Fee Policy:** Application fees are non-refundable. 
* **PwBD Exemption:** PwBD candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Indian Navy Agniveer MR Result 2026

The Indian Navy has announced the results for the **Agniveer Matric Recruit (MR)** Stage I Computer Based Test held on May 14th and 15th, 2026. Candidates can now access their qualifying status and merit list via the official portal.

### 📅 Key Dates
* **Exam Dates:** 14th & 15th May 2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** 17th September 2026
* **Merit List Release:** 17th September 2026

### 📊 Expected Cut-Off (Percentage)
| Category | Expected Cut-Off |
| :--- | :--- |
| General | 55-65% |
| OBC | 50-60% |
| SC | 45-55% |
| ST | 40-50% |

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official recruitment portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Agniveer MR Result 2026'** link.
3. Log in using your **Registered Email ID** and **Password**.
4. View your qualifying status and download the scorecard.
5. Print a copy for future verification.

### 🏃 Next Steps: Physical Fitness Test (PFT)
Candidates who have qualified Stage I must begin immediate preparation for the **Physical Fitness Test**. 
* **Call Letter:** Will be uploaded to the candidate login portal.
* **Notification:** Shortlisted candidates will be informed via registered email.

website_content.title: Karnataka PGCET M.Sc AHS & MPT Hall Ticket 2026
website_content.summary: KEA has released the hall tickets and exam time table for the Post Graduate Common Entrance Test (PGCET) for M.Sc Allied Health Sciences and Master of Physiotherapy. Registered candidates can now download their admit cards from the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially released the hall tickets and exam schedule for the **Post Graduate Common Entrance Test (PGCET)** for admission to Master of Science in Allied Health Sciences (M.Sc AHS) and Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) programmes.

## Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Exam Name:** Karnataka PGCET - M.Sc AHS and MPT
* **Status:** Hall Ticket & Time Table Released

## Important Dates
* **Hall Ticket Release Date:** 18 September 2026
* **Exam Date Release Date:** 18 September 2026

## How to Download Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official KEA portal.
2. Look for the **PGCET category (M.Sc AHS / MPT)** admit card link.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
4. Verify the details and download a clear printout for the exam day.

## Exam Day Instructions
* **Mandatory Documents:** Carry a printed hall ticket and a valid photo ID; entry will be denied without these.
* **Reporting:** Reach the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on the hall ticket.
* **Verification:** Carefully check the centre address and date; report any discrepancies to KEA immediately.
* **Safety:** Follow all center-specific guidelines and keep the hall ticket safe for future counseling stages.

website_content.title: GBPUAT Recruitment 2026: Associate and Assistant Professor Vacancies
website_content.summary: GBPUAT invites offline applications for 45 backlog vacancies of Associate and Assistant Professors across various academic disciplines. The application deadline is 21 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GBPUAT Recruitment 2026 Overview

Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology (GBPUAT) has announced recruitment for **Associate Professor** and **Assistant Professor** positions to fill backlog vacancies (SC, ST, and OBC).

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 45
* **Associate Professor:** 28 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 17 Posts
* **Colleges Involved:** Agriculture, Community Science, Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Basic Sciences and Humanities, Technology, and Fisheries.

### 💰 Salary & Pay Scale
* **Associate Professor:** Academic Level 13A (Entry Pay: **Rs. 1,31,400**)
* **Assistant Professor:** Academic Level 10 (Entry Pay: **Rs. 57,700**)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

#### Associate Professor
* **General/Tech/Fisheries:** Ph.D. in relevant discipline, Master's with 55%, 8 years teaching/research experience, and at least 7 publications.
* **Veterinary Sciences:** Registered with Veterinary Council, Ph.D. and Master's (55%), 8 years experience, and 7 publications.

#### Assistant Professor
* **General:** Master's degree (55%) + NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. exemption).
* **Veterinary:** B.V.Sc. & A.H., Registered with Council, Master's (55%) + NET/SLET/SET.
* **Technology:** BE/BTech and ME/MTech/MS with first class in at least one degree.

### 💸 Application Fee
* **OBC:** Rs. 1,500
* **SC/ST:** Rs. 750
* **Payment Mode:** Demand Draft (DD) in favor of *Comptroller, G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar*.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Download the official application form from the university website.
2. Fill in details and affix a self-attested passport-size photograph.
3. Attach self-attested copies of all certificates, experience letters, and the Demand Draft.
4. Send the completed application via **Speed Post or Registered Post**.
5. **Deadline:** 21 October 2026 (by 5:00 PM).

### ⚠️ Important Note
These are **backlog vacancies** reserved for SC, ST, and OBC candidates. Uttarakhand domicile is required for state-specific reservation benefits.

## IFCI Recruitment 2026 Overview
IFCI Limited, a Government of India Undertaking, is seeking experienced professionals for high-level contractual appointments for an initial period of three years.

## Vacancy Details
* **Associate Director:** 2 Posts

Candidates must possess degrees from recognized institutions (UGC, AICTE, ICAI, etc.) such as:
* **Finance/Management:** CA, CMA, CFA, MBA, PGDM, or B.Com.
* **Technical:** B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or Chemical Engineering.
* **HR:** Postgraduate degree/diploma in HRM, Personnel Management, or Industrial Relations.

### 2. Experience Requirements
* **Associate Director:** Minimum 15 years of experience in PSBs, financial sector, or consulting.

* **Associate Director:** Up to 62 years

## Selection Process
* **Shortlisting:** Based on the submitted online Resume/Biodata.
* **Interview:** Personal or online interview for shortlisted candidates.
* **Verification:** Document verification process.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 02 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 27 September 2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 31 July 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## MPPSC SFSE Main Exam 2026 Overview
The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has announced the hall tickets for the **Rajya Van Seva Mukhya Pariksha 2026**. Candidates who qualified for the preliminary stage can now access their admit cards via the official portal.

## Key Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Main Exam Date:** 27 September 2026
* **Preliminary Exam Date:** 26 April 2026

1. Visit the official portal: **mppsc.mponline.gov.in**

3. Enter the displayed captcha text.
4. Submit the details to view your hall ticket.
5. Download and take a clear printout for the exam day.

## Essential Documents to Carry
* **Printed Admit Card:** A clear hard copy of the MPPSC SFSE Main Exam Admit Card 2026.
* **Photo ID Proof:** Original government-issued ID (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, or Voter ID).

## Important Instructions
* **Verification:** Check your name, photograph, and exam centre details immediately upon downloading.
* **Reporting:** Arrive at the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on the card.
* **Discrepancies:** Report any errors on the admit card to MPPSC immediately.
* **Entry:** No candidate will be allowed entry without a valid admit card and original photo ID.

website_content.summary: The Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the HCS Mains Result 2026 for 102 vacancies. Shortlisted candidates are now eligible for the Personality Test and Document Verification stage.
website_content.markdown_content:
## HPSC HCS Mains Result 2026 Overview

The Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has officially declared the results for the **HCS (Executive Branch) & Other Allied Services Examination 2026** (Advt. No. 22/2026). Candidates who appeared for the Mains examination held between June 27 and June 29, 2026, can now access their qualifying status.

### Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC)
* **Total Vacancies:** 102 Posts
* **Result Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Next Stage:** Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

### Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 30 January 2026
* **Application Window:** 06 February to 26 February 2026
* **Preliminary Exam:** 26 April 2026
* **Mains Exam Date:** 27–29 June 2026
* **Mains Result Declaration:** 17 September 2026

### How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official HPSC portal.
2. Navigate to the **'What's New'** or **'Result'** section on the homepage.
3. Click on the link for **'HPSC HCS Mains Result 2026 (Advt. No. 22/2026)'**.
4. Download the PDF and use **Ctrl+F** to search for your roll number/application number.
5. Save a copy of the result for the upcoming document verification process.

### Result Details

website_content.title: UP Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 207 Posts in Gorakhpur
website_content.summary: Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur has invited online applications from eligible female candidates for 207 Anganwadi Sahayika posts. Eligible candidates can submit their forms online by 5 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Overview

The **Child Development Services and Nutrition Department, Uttar Pradesh** has issued a recruitment notification for **207 Anganwadi Sahayika** contractual posts under the Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur. This recruitment is exclusively for eligible **female candidates** residing in the specified Gram Sabha or urban ward.

### Key Recruitment Highlights

* **Recruiting Body:** Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur
* **Department:** Child Development Services and Nutrition Department, UP
* **Post Name:** Anganwadi Sahayika
* **Total Vacancies:** 207
* **Appointment Type:** Honorarium-based contractual appointment
* **Eligible Gender:** Female candidates only
* **Selection Method:** Merit-based (No written exam, No interview)

---

## Vacancy Details (Category-Wise Breakdown)

* **Unreserved (UR):** 97
* **OBC:** 52
* **SC/ST:** 58
* **Total Posts:** 207

*Major sectors include Gorakhpur City (116 posts), Bansgaon (12 posts), Gagaha (10 posts), Badhalganj (8 posts), and Khajni (8 posts).* 

---

## Eligibility Criteria

### 1. Educational Qualification
* Candidates must have passed **Intermediate (12th Class)** or an equivalent examination from a recognized board or institution.

### 2. Age Limit (As on 01 July 2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 18 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 35 Years
* Date of birth recorded in the **High School Certificate** will be considered valid proof.

### 3. Local Residence Requirement
* **Rural Vacancies:** The applicant must be a resident of the same **Gram Sabha**.
* **Urban Vacancies:** The applicant must be a resident of the same **Ward**.

### 4. Annual Family Income Ceiling
* **Rural Areas:** Maximum **Rs. 46,080** per year
* **Urban Areas:** Maximum **Rs. 56,460** per year
* Income certificate must be issued by a competent officer not below the rank of **Tehsildar**.

---

## Selection Process

* **Merit-Based Selection:** Prepared according to prescribed UP Government rules based on academic standards.
* **No Examination & No Interview:** Candidates will be selected directly on merit and document verification.
* **Document Verification:** Final selection depends on the verification of original certificates and proof of local residence/income.

---

## Required Scanned Documents

1. Recent Passport Size Photograph & Signature
2. High School (10th) Certificate (for DOB proof)
3. Intermediate (12th) Certificate & Marksheet
4. Higher Educational Certificates (if applicable)
5. Digitally Signed Residence Certificate (Online)
6. Digitally Signed Caste Certificate (if applicable)
7. Income Certificate (issued by Tehsildar)
8. Special Reservation Proof (Widow Certificate / Divorced Court Order, if applicable)

---

## How to Apply

1. Visit the official online recruitment portal.
2. Locate the **Gorakhpur Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026** section.
3. Verify your Gram Sabha / Ward vacancy details and eligibility.
4. Complete the online registration and carefully fill in personal, academic, residence, and income details.
5. Upload clean scanned self-attested copies of required certificates.
6. Submit the online application on or before **5 October 2026 (12:00 Midnight)**.
7. Print/Save a copy of the final submitted application form for reference. *(No hard copy needs to be sent by post)*

---

## Important Dates

* **Notification Date:** 14 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply Online:** 05 October 2026 (up to 12:00 Midnight)

website_content.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Board of School Education (JKBOSE) has officially released the date sheet for Class 10, 11, and 12 Annual Regular Examinations 2026 (Winter Zone). Exams for Kashmir Division, Jammu Winter Zone, and UT of Ladakh will commence from October 19, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## JKBOSE Board Exam Date Sheet 2026 Overview

The Jammu and Kashmir Board of School Education (JKBOSE) has released the official timetable for the **Class 10, 11, and 12 Annual Regular Examinations 2026 (October-November Session)**. This schedule applies to all students studying in the Kashmir Division, winter-zone areas of the Jammu Division, and the Union Territory of Ladakh. All written examinations will start at **11:00 AM**.

## Important Examination Dates

* **Class 10 Exam Period:** October 19, 2026 – November 18, 2026
* **Class 10 First Exam:** Mathematics (October 19, 2026)
* **Class 10 Last Exam:** Computer Science (November 18, 2026)
* **Class 12 Exam Period:** October 21, 2026 – November 21, 2026
* **Class 12 First Exam:** General English (October 21, 2026)
* **Class 12 Last Exam:** Computer Science / Information Practices (November 21, 2026)

## Key Exam Day Instructions

* **Reporting Time:** All examinations commence at **11:00 AM**. Students must reach their respective exam centres well before the scheduled time.
* **Admit Card & Stationery:** Carry the official admit card and authorized stationery to the examination hall once issued.
* **Practical Exams:** Dates for practical exams will be released separately by the board.
* **Updates & Revisions:** Any changes due to unavoidable circumstances will be published on the official JKBOSE portal.

## How to Download JKBOSE Date Sheet 2026 PDF

* Visit the official portal of JKBOSE.
* Navigate to the **Student Corner** or **Notifications** section on the homepage.
* Click on the relevant link for **Class 10**, **Class 11**, or **Class 12** Winter Zone Date Sheet 2026.
* View and download the timetable PDF file for future reference.

website_content.summary: The LBS Centre for Science & Technology has released the hall tickets for the KSET July 2026 exam. Candidates can now download their admit cards for the examination scheduled for September 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KSET July 2026 Hall Ticket Overview
The admit cards for the **Kerala State Eligibility Test (KSET) July 2026** cycle are now active. All candidates are required to carry a hard copy of their hall ticket to the exam venue to gain entry.

### 📅 Key Dates & Information
* **Exam Date:** 20 September 2026 (Sunday)
* **Last Date to Download Admit Card:** 20 September 2026
* **Conducting Body:** LBS Centre for Science & Technology, Govt. of Kerala
* **Exam Locations:** 14 Districts across Kerala

### ⏰ Exam Schedule & Shift Timings
| Paper | Subjects | Timing |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Paper I** | General Knowledge (Part A) & Teaching Aptitude (Part B) | 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon |
| **Paper II** | Subject-Specific | 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM |

### 🛠️ How to Download Your Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official LBS Centre for Science & Technology portal.
2. Navigate to the KSET July 2026 hall ticket link.
3. Enter your **Registration ID** or **Registered Mobile Number**.
4. Enter the **Site Access Key** (received via SMS).
5. Verify your details and print a **colour copy** of the admit card.

### 📋 Mandatory Checklist for Exam Day
**Items to Carry:**
* Colour printout of the KSET Hall Ticket
* Original valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, etc.)
* Passport-size photograph (matching registration)
* Transparent blue or black ballpoint pen

**Prohibited Items:**
* Electronic gadgets, communication devices, Bluetooth devices, and earphones.
* Study materials or stationery beyond what is permitted.

website_content.title: AIMA MAT CBT Admit Card September 2026
website_content.summary: The All India Management Association (AIMA) has released the admit cards for the MAT CBT September 2026 session. Registered candidates can now download their hall tickets via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIMA MAT CBT Admit Card 2026

**The All India Management Association (AIMA)** has officially released the Admit Cards for the **Management Aptitude Test (MAT)** September 2026 session for candidates opting for the Computer Based Test (CBT) mode.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **CBT Admit Card Release:** September 17, 2026
* **CBT Exam Date:** September 20, 2026
* **PBT Admit Card Release:** September 10, 2026
* **PBT Exam Date:** September 13, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download Your Admit Card
1. Visit the official MAT website.
2. Navigate to the **Candidate Login** section on the homepage.
3. Enter your **Registration Number** and **Password** to sign in.
4. Locate and click the **'MAT CBT Admit Card'** download link on your dashboard.
5. Review the details and download the PDF.
6. **Print two clear copies** on A4-size paper for the exam day.

### ⚠️ Essential Instructions
* **Mandatory Document:** Entry to the exam hall is strictly prohibited without a valid printed admit card.
* **Center Allotment:** Candidates cannot request a change in the test center once the admit card is issued.
* **Delivery:** Admit cards are NOT sent via post or email; they must be downloaded from the portal.
* **Reporting:** Reach the center well before the reporting time mentioned on your hall ticket.
* **Support:** For any discrepancies, email AIMA immediately at [email protected].

website_content.markdown_content:
## Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) Teaching Recruitment 2026

Jamia Millia Islamia has released an official notification for the recruitment of teaching faculty members in various Engineering and Science departments in New Delhi.

**Key Vacancy Details:**
* **Professor:** 10 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 12 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 22 Posts
* **Principal (University Polytechnic):** 01 Post
* **Head of Section (Civil Engineering):** 01 Post
* **Total Vacancies:** 46

**Eligibility Criteria:**
* **Professor/Associate Professor:** Ph.D. in the relevant field with a minimum of 8-10 years of teaching/research/industry experience and required research publications.
* **Assistant Professor (Engineering):** B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech in the relevant branch with first class in at least one degree.
* **Assistant Professor (Science/Humanities):** Master's degree (55%) with NET/SLET/SET qualification (Ph.D. holders may be exempt).
* **Principal/HoS:** Ph.D. with 12 to 20 years of extensive experience depending on the role.

**Important Dates:**
* **Online Application Start:** 16 September 2026
* **Online Application Deadline:** 6 October 2026
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline:** 16 October 2026

**Application Fee:**
* **UR/OBC:** ₹1,500
* **SC/ST:** ₹750
* **PwD:** Exempted

**Selection Process:**
* **Shortlisting:** Based on academic scores and qualifications.
* **Final Selection:** Based exclusively on the performance in the **Interview**.

**Crucial Instructions:**
* **Dual Submission:** Both online application and a physical hard copy of the application are **mandatory**.
* **Separate Applications:** A separate application and fee must be submitted for each post applied for.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Directorate of Medical Education, Government of West Bengal, has released the tentative schedule for **NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Counselling** for both State Quota and Private Management Quota seats.

## Key Counselling Dates
* **Online Registration & Fee Payment:** September 18, 2026, to September 20, 2026 (4 PM for reg / 12 midnight for fees).
* **Candidate Verification:** September 21 and September 22, 2026 (11 AM to 4 PM).
* **Online Seat Surrender:** September 23, 2026 (10 AM to 4 PM).
* **Seat Matrix Publication:** September 23, 2026 (After 4 PM).
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 23, 2026 (6 PM) to September 24, 2026 (12 Noon).
* **Allotment Result Publication:** September 26, 2026 (After 12 Noon).
* **Reporting & Admission:** September 28 to September 30, 2026 (11 AM to 4 PM).

## Important Instructions
* **In-Service Candidates:** Must complete verification at **Swasthya Bhawan**.
* **Document Requirement:** Reporting must be done with original documents, the requisite college fee, and a bond.
* **Upgraded Candidates:** Those upgraded in Round 2 must provide a server-generated relieving letter from their previous institute.
* **Timeline:** All deadlines are based on server time; candidates are advised not to wait until the last moment.

website_content.title: AP EAMCET (EAPCET) Phase 3 Seat Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: APSCHE has released the AP EAMCET Third and Final Phase seat allotment results on September 17, 2026. Candidates must complete self-reporting and college reporting by September 19, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AP EAMCET Phase 3 Seat Allotment 2026

The **Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)**, via the Department of Technical Education, has announced the release of the Third and Final Phase seat allotment results. This round determines the final college and branch allocations for eligible candidates.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Result Release Date:** September 17, 2026
* **Self-Reporting & College Reporting:** September 17 to September 19, 2026
* **Bi.P.C. Stream Web Options Extension:** Up to September 20, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check and Download Allotment Order
1. Navigate to the official counselling portal.
2. Select the link **'AP EAPCET/EAMCET Phase 3 / Final Phase Seat Allotment Result'**.
3. Enter your **Hall Ticket Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Submit the details to view your allotted college and branch.
5. Download and print at least two copies of the **provisional seat allotment order** for reporting.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Reporting:** Candidates must complete both online self-reporting and physical reporting at the allotted college between **September 17 and 19**.
* **Document Verification:** Carry all original certificates and photocopies for on-the-spot verification at the college.
* **Seat Cancellation:** Failure to complete reporting formalities within the deadline will result in the cancellation of the allotted seat.
* **Bi.P.C. Stream:** Note that the Bi.P.C. stream follows a separate timeline with options extended to September 20.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The High Court of Tripura, Agartala, has issued Notification No. F.4(22)-HC/2026/21715-16 regarding the **Written Screening Test** for recruitment to the posts of **Junior Administrative Assistant (JAA)**. This follows Advertisement No. HC-02/2026.

## Key Statistics
* **Candidates Declared Eligible:** 4,712
* **Candidates Declared Ineligible:** 133

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Call Letter Download Starts:** 01 October 2026
* **Written Screening Test Date:** 11 October 2026 (Sunday)
* **Reporting Time:** 10:00 A.M. onwards

## Exam Details
* **Exam City:** Agartala
* **Venue:** Will be mentioned on the individual call letter.

## Steps to Download Call Letter
1. Visit the official portal: **thc.nic.in**
2. Navigate to the **'Recruitment [Online Application]'** tab.
3. Log in using the credentials created during the original application process.
4. Download and print the call letter (available from **October 1, 2026**).

## Important Instructions
* Ensure you have your original login credentials ready.
* Only candidates on the **Eligible List** will be issued a call letter.
* Carefully verify your name and registration number in the annexed list.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Gorakhpur Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026

The Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur, has released the official notification for the recruitment of **Anganwadi Karyakatri (Anganwadi Workers)** on a contractual/honorarium basis.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 326 Posts
* **Post Name:** Anganwadi Karyakatri
* **Job Location:** Gorakhpur District (Urban & Rural CDP areas)
* **Selection Method:** Merit-based (No Written Exam, No Interview)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Only female candidates are eligible.
* **Educational Qualification:** Minimum **Intermediate (12th Standard)** or equivalent. Higher qualifications (up to Post Graduation) will be considered for merit ranking.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of July 1, 2026).
* **Residency:** Mandatory residency in the same Gram Sabha (rural) or Ward (urban) where the vacancy exists.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** September 15, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** October 5, 2026 (12:00 Midnight)
* **Age Reckoning Date:** July 1, 2026

### ⚙️ Selection Process
The selection is **fully online and merit-based**. Candidates will be ranked based on their highest educational qualification. No written examination or interview will be conducted.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official portal **upanganwadibharti.in**.
2. Select the relevant Child Development Project (CDP) area.
3. Fill in the application form with accurate details.
4. Upload self-attested digital copies of required documents.
5. Submit the form before the deadline.

website_content.title: CMWSSB Apprentice Recruitment 2026: 108 Vacancies for Graduate & Diploma Engineers
website_content.summary: CMWSSB is inviting applications for 108 Graduate and Technician Diploma Apprentice positions for Tamil Nadu residents. Apply online via the NATS portal by October 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CMWSSB Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB) has announced recruitment for Apprentices to provide practical training to engineering graduates and diploma holders.

### Vacancy Distribution
* **Graduate Apprentices:** 76 Posts
* **Technician Diploma Apprentices:** 32 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 108

### Eligibility Criteria
* **Domicile:** Candidates must belong to **Tamil Nadu**.
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * **Graduate Apprentice:** Full-time B.E. or B.Tech in a relevant engineering discipline.
    * **Technician Apprentice:** Full-time Diploma in a relevant engineering discipline.
* **Eligible Passing Years:** 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and May 2026.
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Candidates must be registered on the **NATS portal** with accurate qualification percentages.

### Stipend & Training
* **Graduate Apprentice:** Rs. 12,300 per month
* **Technician Diploma Apprentice:** Rs. 10,900 per month
* **Duration:** One year (as per Apprenticeship Amendment Act, 1973).

### Selection Process
1. **Merit-based Shortlisting:** Based on the percentage of marks obtained in the degree/diploma.
2. **Verification:** Certificate verification at CMWSSB, Chennai.
*Note: No written examination or interview will be conducted.*

### Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026

website_content.title: Kerala High Court Office Attendant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The High Court of Kerala has announced 17 anticipated vacancies for the post of Office Attendant. Eligible candidates can apply online from September 23 to October 26, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🏛️ Kerala High Court Office Attendant Recruitment 2026

The High Court of Kerala is inviting applications for the post of **Office Attendant**. This is a direct recruitment process based on a written test and interview.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Office Attendant
* **Total Vacancies:** 17 (Anticipated)
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 23,000 to Rs. 50,200
* **Application Mode:** Online

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * Must have passed **SSLC or equivalent**.
    * **Crucial:** Candidates who have acquired a **graduation degree are NOT eligible** for this post.
* **Age Limit:** 
    * General: Born between 02-01-1986 and 01-01-2008.
    * SC/ST: Born between 02-01-1981 and 01-01-2008.
    * OBC: Born between 02-01-1983 and 01-01-2008.
    * *Age relaxations apply for PwD and Ex-Servicemen.*

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Objective Written Test (100 Marks):**
    * General Knowledge & Current Affairs: 50 Marks
    * Numerical Ability: 20 Marks
    * Mental Ability: 15 Marks
    * General English: 15 Marks
    * *Duration: 75 Minutes | Negative Marking: 1/4 mark per wrong answer.*
2. **Interview:** 10 Marks (Minimum 35% required to qualify).
3. **Certificate Verification.**

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 23 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 26 October 2026
* **Last Date for Online Fee Payment:** 26 October 2026

### 💳 Application Fee
* **General & Others:** Rs. 500
* **SC/ST/Unemployed Differently Abled:** Exempted

website_content.title: Odisha NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Reporting for MBBS & BDS
website_content.summary: The OJEE Committee has commenced the Round 2 reporting process for candidates allotted MBBS and BDS seats under the state quota. Reporting is scheduled for September 17 and 18, 2026, at the OJEE Cell, Bhubaneswar.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Odisha NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Reporting Overview

The **Odisha Joint Entrance Examination (OJEE) Committee** has announced the reporting schedule for candidates who have been provisionally allotted seats in MBBS and BDS courses during Round 2 of the state quota counselling.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Provisional Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Allotment Letter Download:** September 11, 2026 (after 7:30 PM)
* **Reporting Dates:** September 17 and 18, 2026

### 🛠️ Step-by-Step Reporting Process
1. **Download Allotment Letter:** Get your provisional seat allotment letter from the official OJEE portal.
2. **Document Preparation:** Gather all original documents and prepare **three self-attested photocopy sets** of each.
3. **Fee Payment:** Pay the applicable admission fee as per OJEE instructions.
4. **Bond Signing:** Sign the required admission bond (Read terms carefully regarding rural posting/discontinuation).
5. **Physical Reporting:** Visit the **OJEE Cell, Gandamunda, Bhubaneswar**, on your scheduled date.
6. **Verification:** Complete the document verification process and finalize admission formalities.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Strict Timeline:** Report only on the specified dates; late entries may not be accommodated.
* **Document Requirement:** Both originals and self-attested copies are mandatory.
* **Seat Upgrade:** Candidates upgraded from Round 1 to Round 2 automatically forfeit their previous seat.
* **Stay Updated:** Regularly check the official website for any revised schedules.

website_content.summary: Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital (SGMH), Delhi, is inviting applications for 52 Senior Resident positions across various specialties via a walk-in interview on September 24, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SGMH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026

**Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital (SGMH)**, under the Government of NCT of Delhi, is recruiting **52 Senior Residents** for various medical departments on an ad-hoc basis.

### 📌 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Medicine:** 8
* **Radiology:** 8
* **Paediatrics:** 7
* **Surgery:** 6
* **Orthopaedics:** 5
* **Anaesthesia:** 5
* **Ophthalmology:** 4
* **Pathology:** 3
* **Other Specialties:** Psychiatry, OBGYN, Forensic Medicine, Dermatology, Microbiology.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** MBBS degree from a recognized university + Postgraduate Degree, Diploma, or DNB in the concerned specialty.
* **Registration:** Valid registration with the **Delhi Medical Council (DMC)** is mandatory. (Proof of application accepted).
* **Experience Clause:** Candidates must not have completed 3 years of Senior Residency elsewhere. However, for shortage specialties (Radiology, Anaesthesia, Forensic Medicine), Non-PG candidates with 2 years of experience may be considered.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **45 years** (as of 24 Sept 2026). Relaxations apply for OBC (3 yrs), SC/ST (5 yrs), and PwD (5 yrs).

### 💰 Salary & Appointment
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 (Level 11 under 7th CPC).
* **Appointment Type:** Ad-hoc.
* **Initial Period:** 89 days or until a regular candidate joins.

### 🗓️ Walk-in Interview Details
* **Date:** 24 September 2026
* **Registration Timing:** 9:00 AM to 12:00 Noon
* **Venue:** 4th Floor Conference Hall, Administrative Block, Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital, Mangolpuri, Delhi - 110083.

### 📄 Required Documents (Original + Self-Attested Copies)
* Completed application form with passport-size photo.
* MBBS and PG degree/diploma mark sheets and certificates.
* DMC registration certificate.
* Date of Birth certificate (Class 10th).
* Aadhaar Card and Category certificate (OBC/EWS certificates must be for the current financial year).
* NOC for candidates currently in government service.

website_content.title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2027 Notification
website_content.summary: UPSC has announced the Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2027 for approximately 480 Group 'A' and 'B' engineering posts. Applications are open from September 16 to October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UPSC ESE 2027 Recruitment Overview
**Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** is inviting applications for the Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2027. This prestigious exam recruits candidates for Group 'A' and Group 'B' services across various Central Government Ministries and Departments.

### 🛠️ Engineering Disciplines
* Civil Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Online Application Start:** 16.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 06.10.2026
* **Preliminary Examination (Stage-I):** 31.01.2027
* **Main Examination (Stage-II):** 18.06.2027

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** A degree in Engineering from a recognized University or specified professional membership examinations (e.g., Institution of Engineers India).
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 30 years as of 01.01.2027.
* **Age Relaxations:** 
    * SC/ST: Up to 5 years
    * OBC: Up to 3 years
    * PwBD: Up to 10 years

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Stage-I (Preliminary):** Objective type (General Studies & Engineering Aptitude + Discipline specific).
2. **Stage-II (Main):** Conventional type (Discipline specific).
3. **Stage-III (Interview):** Personality Test.

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹200
* **Female/SC/ST/PwBD:** Exempted

website_content.summary: Jiwaji University, Gwalior has released the 2026 results for various undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. Students of MBA, MCA, B.Com, and B.Sc (Honours) can now access their regular and ATKT results online.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Jiwaji University Result 2026 Declaration

Jiwaji University, Gwalior has officially declared the examination results on **15 September 2026** for multiple academic streams. The results cover both **Regular semester** and **ATKT (compartment)** candidates.

### 🎓 Courses with Released Results
* **MBA:** E-Commerce and Hospital Administration (4th Semester)
* **MCA:** 2nd and 4th Semesters
* **B.Com:** Second Semester Certificate Course (NEP)
* **B.Sc (Honours) Private:** 4th Year NEP results for Chemistry, Mathematics, Zoology, and Botany

### 📅 Key Information
* **Result Declaration Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Exam Cycles:** June 2026 (MBA/MCA) and March 2026 (B.Sc Hons)
* **Mode of Access:** Online via the official result portal

### 🛠️ Steps to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official result portal or the university website.
2. Select the link corresponding to your specific **Course Code** and **Exam Name**.
3. Enter your **Roll Number** or **Enrolment Number**.
4. Submit the details to view your provisional marksheet.
5. Download and print a copy for future admissions or revaluation applications.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* The online result is **provisional**; the printed marksheet from the university/college is the final document.
* Report any discrepancies in name, roll number, or subject codes to your college exam cell immediately.
* Students with **ATKT** should contact their respective colleges for the next reappear exam schedule.

website_content.title: TNPSC Group 1 Hall Ticket 2026
website_content.summary: The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission has released the admit cards for the Combined Civil Services Examination-I (CCSE-I). Candidates appearing for the Group 1 Preliminary Examination on September 27, 2026, can now download their hall tickets.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TNPSC Group 1 Preliminary Exam 2026

The **Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC)** has officially released the hall tickets for the **Combined Civil Services Examination-I (Group I Services)**. It is mandatory for all candidates to carry a printed copy of the admit card to the examination center.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Hall Ticket Release Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Prelims Exam Date:** 27 September 2026 (Sunday)
* **Exam Timing:** 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM
* **Duration:** 3 Hours (180 Minutes)

### 🛠️ How to Download Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official TNPSC portal at **tnpsc.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **'Hall Ticket Download'** section on the homepage.
3. Select the link for **Combined Civil Services Examination-I**.
4. Log in using your **OTR ID / Registration Number** and **Date of Birth**.
5. Verify your details and download the PDF.
6. Take a clear printout for the exam day.

### 📄 Required Documents for Exam Day
To avoid denial of entry, candidates must carry:
* **Printed Hall Ticket** (TNPSC Group 1 2026)
* **Passport-size Photograph**
* **Original Photo ID** (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN Card, Driving License, or Passport)
* **Black Ballpoint Pen**

### ⚠️ Key Exam Guidelines
* **Reporting Time:** Reach the center well before the time mentioned on the hall ticket.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones and electronic gadgets are strictly banned.
* **Verification:** Double-check your name, photo, and exam center address on the admit card.

website_content.summary: HCL is hiring 43 Executives on a Fixed Tenure basis across 11 specialized disciplines. Apply by October 5, 2026, for a high-paying PSU opportunity.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
**Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL)**, a Miniratna Category-I CPSE, is inviting applications for the engagement of Executives on a **Fixed Tenure basis** for various projects across India. 

## Key Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **43** across 11 Disciplines:
* **Electrical:** 8 Posts
* **Geology & Mechanical:** 6 Posts each
* **Civil & M&HS:** 4 Posts each
* **Industrial Safety, Mineral Processing, Finance, Survey:** 3 Posts each
* **Environment Management:** 2 Posts
* **Human Resources:** 1 Post

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Engineering/Technical:** Bachelor's degree in relevant field (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, etc.) as specified.
* **Medical (M&HS):** MBBS with 3 years experience.
* **Finance:** CA or ICWA Final examination passed.
* **HR:** MBA/PG Degree in Personnel Management/HR or MSW.
* **Specialized:** PG in Geology, Environment Science, or Mining/Civil with Surveyor Certificate.

## Pay Scale & Age Limit
Compensation depends on the Grade (FTE-I to FTE-VI):
* **Salary Range:** ₹75,400 to ₹1,69,600 consolidated pay.
* **Age Limit:** 35 to 52 years (Depending on Grade).
* **Age Relaxation:** OBC (3 yrs), SC (5 yrs), PwD (10-15 yrs), Ex-SM (5 yrs).

## Selection Process
* **Method:** 100% weightage on **Personal Interview (PI)**.
* **Shortlisting:** Ratio of 1:5 (or 1:10 for single posts) based on experience and additional qualifications.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start:** 21 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 5 October 2026 (11:00 PM)
* **Reckoning Date for Eligibility:** 1 September 2026

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹500
* **SC/PwBD:** Exempted

website_content.markdown_content:

The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** has officially released the schedule for the Joint CSIR-UGC NET December 2026. This exam is crucial for candidates aspiring to enter the fields of research and academia in **Science and Technology**.

* **Medium of Exam:** English & Hindi
* **Purpose:** Eligibility for **Junior Research Fellowship (JRF)** and **Lectureship/Assistant Professor** positions.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Dates:** 20 and 21 December 2026

### 📝 Application Process
Once the registration link is active, candidates should follow these steps:
* **Registration:** Visit the official portal and complete the 'New Registration'.
* **Form Filling:** Enter personal, educational, and subject preferences.
* **Document Upload:** Upload a valid photograph (10 KB–200 KB) and signature (4 KB–30 KB).
* **Fee Payment:** Complete the payment via Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
* **Submission:** Download and save the final application form for future reference.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* Ensure the use of a **valid mobile number and email ID**.
* Details must match official government documents exactly.
* Double-check the **selected subject and exam city** before final submission.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the **Round 2 Final Seat Allotment** for Karnataka NEET UG (UGNEET) 2026. This allotment applies to candidates seeking admission to **MBBS and BDS courses** under the Karnataka state quota.

## Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Course focus:** MBBS and BDS Admission
* **Allotment Stage:** Round 2 (Final)
* **Official Portal:** cetonline.karnataka.gov.in

## Important Dates
* **Round 2 Option Entry:** September 7 – September 9, 2026
* **Provisional Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Exit Window:** September 11 – September 14, 2026
* **Final Seat Allotment Result:** September 16, 2026

## How to Check Allotment Status
1. Visit the official KEA portal at **cetonline.karnataka.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **UGNEET 2026** or **Admission** section.
3. Click on the link for **Round 2 Final Seat Allotment Result**.
4. Log in using your **NEET application/roll number** and password/DOB.
5. Enter the CAPTCHA and view your allotted college and seat type.
6. Download and print the **Allotment Letter** for future reporting.

## Critical Instructions
* **Avoid Unofficial Links:** Use only the official KEA website to avoid fraud.
* **Credential Safety:** Keep your login details secure.
* **Careful Selection:** Carefully review your choice options before confirming to avoid affecting future rounds.
* **Documentation:** Save PDF copies of your allotment letter, fee receipts, and confirmation slips immediately.

website_content.summary: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) invites online applications for 15 Apprentice Trainee positions across India. Eligible candidates must apply by September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), an autonomous society under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, is recruiting **Apprentice Trainees** under the Apprenticeship Act-1961 for a period of one year.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 15
* **Locations:** HQ, Bengaluru, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Guwahati, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Noida, Mohali, Pune.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * B.E/B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, ECE, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or IT.
    * OR Bachelor's degree in Arts, Commerce, or Administration.
* **Passing Year:** Candidates must have completed their qualification in **June 2021 or thereafter**.
* **Age Limit (as of 14.09.2026):**
    * Minimum: 18 Years
    * Maximum (UR): 27 Years
    * Maximum (OBC): 30 Years
    * Maximum (SC/ST): 32 Years

## Stipend Structure
* **B.E/B.Tech Holders:** Rs. 15,000/- per month
* **Bachelor (Arts/Comm/Admin) Holders:** Rs. 12,300/- per month
* **Note:** Higher stipends up to **Rs. 20,000/-** may be offered based on interview performance.

## Selection Process
Selection will be carried out through **shortlisting based on interview performance**. There is no written examination.

## Application Steps
1. **Mandatory Registration:** Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) Portal first to obtain a Student Enrolment ID.
2. **Online Application:** Visit the STPI official website's Career Section and fill out the application form mentioning the NATS Enrolment ID.
3. **Deadline:** Ensure submission on or before September 30, 2026.

website_content.title: DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 (CBT 2027-28) Notification Out
website_content.summary: DAVCMC invites online applications for various Teaching (PRT, TGT, PGT) and Non-Teaching posts across India. Apply by October 8, 2026, for the centralized CBT selection process.
website_content.markdown_content:
## DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 Overview

DAV College Managing Committee (DAVCMC) has announced the recruitment process for the **CBT 2027-28** cycle. This recruitment covers a wide array of academic and administrative roles across DAV schools nationwide.

## Available Vacancies

### Teaching Posts
* **Nursery/Pre-Primary Teacher** (Female candidates only)
* **PRT (Primary Teacher):** English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Maths, Science, Social Science, Computer Science, Regional Languages, Music, Dance, Art, Library, and Physical Education.
* **TGT (Trained Graduate Teacher):** English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Maths, Science, Social Science, Computer Science, Regional Languages, Music, Dance, Art, Library, and Physical Education.
* **PGT (Post Graduate Teacher):** English, Hindi, Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography, History, Political Science, Economics, Commerce, Computer Science, Psychology, Home Science, Sociology, Physical Education, and Bengali.

### Ministerial / Non-Teaching Posts
* **Clerical:** LDC (Accounts/Administration) and UDC
* **Administrative:** Assistant and Front Office Assistant/Receptionist
* **Technical/Support:** Library Assistant, Lab Assistant (Bio/Chem/Phys/Comp), and Nurse

## Selection Process

1. **Computer Based Test (CBT):** A centralized online examination conducted across India.
2. **Demo-cum-Interview:** Post-CBT stage conducted individually by the respective DAV schools.

## Important Dates

| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Registration Starts** | 16 September 2026 |
| **Deadline to Submit Form** | 08 October 2026 |
| **Verification Window** | 25 Sept to 16 Oct 2026 |
| **CBT Examination** | December 2026 |

## Application Fee
* **All Categories:** Rs. 300/- (Payable online after verification approval).

## Key Application Steps
* **Online Registration:** Fill out the form at the official portal and submit as "Form Ready for Verification".
* **Document Verification:** Visit a designated DAV Verification Centre between Sept 25 and Oct 16.
* **Payment:** Pay the CBT fee within 7 days of being marked "Verified and Approved".
* **CBT:** Download the admit card in November and appear for the exam in December.

website_content.title: UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: UPSC has announced Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations (LDCE) for Section Officers (Grade-B) and Stenographers (Grade-B/I). Eligible in-service candidates must apply online by October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released notifications for two Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations (LDCE): the **Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') LDCE, 2026** and the **Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') LDCE for 2022, 2023 & 2024**. This is an internal recruitment process specifically for eligible serving government employees.

## Key Examination Details
* **Organization:** Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
* **Exam Type:** Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE)
* **Application Mode:** Online
* **Exam Dates:** December 12th and 13th, 2026

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 06.10.2026 (until 06:00 PM)
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline (Section Officers):** 23.10.2026
* **Examination Dates:** 12.12.2026 & 13.12.2026

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Restriction:** Only serving government employees who meet the conditions prescribed for their respective service/cadre are eligible.
* **Regulations:** Recruitment is conducted as per DoPT Rules published in the Gazette of India dated 16.09.2026.

## Section Officers' Grade-B Categories
Candidates can compete for various categories including:
* Central Secretariat Service
* Indian Foreign Service (General Cadre, Branch 'B')
* Railway Board Secretariat Service
* Intelligence Bureau
* Armed Forces Headquarters Civil Service
* Employees' State Insurance Corporation

## Examination Centres
The exam will be conducted at the following centers:
* Chennai
* Delhi
* Kolkata
* Mumbai
* Nagpur

## Selection Process & Exam Pattern
* **Pattern:** Includes both Objective Type Question Papers and Descriptive Papers.
* **Negative Marking:** Applicable for objective papers.
* **Key Papers:** Focus on Government of India Secretariat procedures, General Financial and Service Rules, and Noting/Drafting/Precis Writing.
* **Selection:** Based on written examination and verification of service records.

website_content.title: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Notification: Specialist Cadre Officer Posts
website_content.summary: State Bank of India (SBI) invites applications for Specialist Cadre Officer (SCO) roles across SBIL Kolkata and IT Risk divisions. Apply by October 6, 2026, for high-paying leadership and technical positions.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Overview
State Bank of India is hiring for **Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO)** on a contract basis for a period of 3 years (extendable up to 5 years). This recruitment covers two main advertisements: one for SBIL Kolkata and another for IT Risk roles.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Registration Starts:** 16.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply & Pay Fee:** 06.10.2026
* **Eligibility Cut-off Date:** 31.08.2026

### 💼 Vacancy Details
**1. SBIL Kolkata (Advt 20):**
* **Dean:** 1 Post (Age 40-55)
* **Faculty:** 1 Post (Age 35-55)
* **Marketing Executive:** 1 Post (Age 28-40)

**2. IT Risk (Advt 22):**
* **Deputy Vice President:** 2 Posts (Age 36-45)
* **Assistant Vice President:** 2 Posts (Age 32-42)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**SBIL Posts:**
* **Dean:** MBA/PhD/PGDM with 15 years of experience (min. 3 years in leadership roles).
* **Faculty:** Postgraduate with 6 years of teaching/corporate training experience.
* **Marketing Executive:** MBA in Marketing with 5 years of experience (min. 3 years in Executive Education).

**IT Risk Posts:**
* **Education:** BE/B.Tech (CS/IT/Cybersecurity) or MCA/M.Sc (IT).
* **Certification:** CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or CISA is required.
* **Experience:** 9-12 years in IT domain (with specific focus on IT risk/info security).

### 💰 Remuneration (Annual CTC)
* **Dean:** Up to ₹98 Lakhs
* **Faculty:** Up to ₹63 Lakhs
* **Deputy VP (IT Risk):** Up to ₹60 Lakhs
* **Assistant VP (IT Risk):** Up to ₹50 Lakhs
* **Marketing Executive:** ₹52 Lakhs

### 🛠 Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on bank-defined parameters.
2. **Interview:** (Demo session required for Dean/Faculty).
3. **CTC Negotiation:** Final stage for selected candidates based on merit.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **General/EWS/OBC:** ₹750
* **SC/ST/PwBD:** Nil

website_content.title: GMC Jalgaon Professor and Associate Professor Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Government Medical College, Jalgaon invites offline applications for 21 contractual positions of Professors and Associate Professors. The application window closes on 25 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Government Medical College, Jalgaon, under the Directorate of Medical Education and Research, Mumbai, is recruiting medical faculty on a **contractual basis** for a period of 364 days.

## Vacancy Details
* **Professor:** 11 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 10 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 21

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Nationality:** Must be an Indian citizen and a resident of **Maharashtra**.
* **Educational Qualification:** Appropriate MD, MS, DNB, or recognized medical qualification in the relevant subject.
* **Experience:**
    * **Professor:** Minimum 3 years experience as Associate Professor + NMC research publications + Basic Course in Medical Education Technology & Biomedical Research.
    * **Associate Professor:** Minimum 4 years experience as Assistant Professor + NMC research publications + Basic Course in Medical Education Technology & Biomedical Research.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **69 years** at the time of appointment.

## Remuneration (Monthly)
* **Professor:** ₹1,85,000
* **Associate Professor:** ₹1,70,000

## Selection Process
Selection is based on a **Merit Assessment (100 Marks)** followed by an interview:
* Qualification: 50 Marks
* Additional Qualification: 5 Marks
* Teaching Experience: 20 Marks
* Research Publications: 10 Marks
* Interview: 15 Marks
* *Minimum Qualifying Mark: 41%*

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 8 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 11 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25 September 2026 (by 5:00 PM)

## How to Apply
1. Download the prescribed application form from the official website.
2. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (SSC, Degree, Experience, Domicile, etc.).
3. Submit the application **personally or via registered post** to the Dean, Government Medical College, Jalgaon.

website_content.title: UPSC NDA & NA (II) Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: The Union Public Service Commission has released the provisional answer keys for the National Defence Academy & Naval Academy (II) 2026 exam. Candidates who appeared for the exam on September 13 can now verify their responses for Mathematics and GAT papers.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UPSC NDA & NA (II) 2026 Answer Key Overview

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially published the **provisional Answer Keys** for the NDA & NA (II) Examination 2026. This is a crucial step for candidates aspiring to join the Army, Navy, and Air Force wings.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 394 Posts
* **Exam Date:** 13 September 2026
* **Answer Key Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Papers Released:** Mathematics and General Ability Test (GAT)
* **Sets Available:** Set A, B, C, and D

## Step-by-Step Guide to Download
1. Visit the official UPSC portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Examinations'** tab and select **'Answer Keys'**.
3. Click on the link for **'National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026'**.
4. Choose the specific paper (Mathematics or GAT) and the corresponding booklet series.
5. Download the PDF and compare it with your OMR sheet.

website_content.markdown_content:
## RPSC SI Police Re-Examination 2026

The Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has officially released the admit cards for the **Sub Inspector (SI) Police / Platoon Commander Recruitment Re-Examination 2021**. Please note that this is a re-conducted exam for candidates who participated in the original 2021 process.

### 📅 Key Dates
* **Exam City Details Released:** 13 September 2026
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Re-Examination Date:** 20 September 2026

### 📝 How to Download Your Admit Card
1. Visit the official RPSC recruitment portal.
2. Navigate to the **'News & Events'** or **'Candidate Corner'** section.
3. Locate the link for the **SI / Platoon Commander Re-Exam 2021** admit card.
4. Log in using your **Registration Number** and **Date of Birth**.
5. Complete the captcha verification.
6. Download the PDF and take a clear **colour printout on A4 paper**.

### 📂 Mandatory Documents for Exam Day
* **Printed Admit Card** (Colour print recommended).
* **Original Photo ID Proof** (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, or Driving Licence).
* **Photocopy** of the same photo ID.
* **Passport-size photograph** (Matching the original application).
* **Blue/Black Ballpoint Pen** (OMR sheets will not accept gel pens or pencils).

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Reporting Time:** Arrive at the center at least **60 minutes prior** to the reporting time.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, and bags are strictly banned.
* **Verification:** Ensure your photograph on the admit card matches your current identity for invigilator verification.

website_content.title: JEE Main 2027 Session 1 Exam Dates Released
website_content.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially announced the exam dates for JEE Main 2027 Session 1. The examinations are scheduled to be held from January 22 to January 30, 2027.
website_content.markdown_content:
## JEE Main 2027 Overview
The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** has released the official Examination Calendar for the Joint Entrance Examination (Main) 2027. This examination is the primary gateway for admission to premier institutes including **NITs, IIITs, and CFTIs**, and serves as the qualifying exam for **JEE Advanced 2027**.

## Important Exam Dates (Session 1)
* **Exam Dates:** January 22, 23, 24, 28, 29, and 30, 2027
* **Buffer Date:** January 31, 2027
* **Session 2:** Scheduled for April 2027

## Key Examination Details
* **Mode of Exam:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Special Note:** The drawing section for B.Arch will be conducted **offline**.
* **Conducting Body:** National Testing Agency (NTA)

## Application Process
Once the registration window opens, candidates should follow these steps:
* Visit the official portal.
* Complete initial registration with basic personal details.
* Fill out the detailed application form.
* Upload required documents (Photo and Signature).
* Pay the application fee online.

## Essential Instructions
* **Verification:** Regularly check the official website for the detailed Information Bulletin regarding fees and registration dates.
* **Documentation:** Ensure Aadhaar card and other identity documents are updated before applying.
* **Session 2:** Candidates appearing in Session 1 do not need to fill a completely new form for Session 2.

website_content.title: Greater Chennai Corporation Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Chennai City Urban Health Mission is inviting offline applications for 512 estimated contractual Staff Nurse vacancies. Eligible candidates must apply by September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Greater Chennai Corporation, through the Chennai City Urban Health Mission, is recruiting **512 (estimated)** Staff Nurses. These positions are purely temporary/contractual and will be deployed across various institutions under the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Medical and Rural Health Services, and Medical Education & Research.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must possess a **GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery)** or **B.Sc. Nursing** degree from a recognized Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College.
* **Professional Registration:** A valid registration with the **Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council** is mandatory.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum age is **50 years**.

## Important Dates
* **Application Deadline:** 25th September 2026, by 5:00 PM.

## Application Process
This recruitment follows an **offline application process**:
1. Download the application form from the official GCC or NHM-TN website.
2. Complete the form and attach two recent passport-size color photographs.
3. Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents.
4. Submit the physical application to the **City Health Officer / Member Secretary, Chennai City Urban Health Mission, 3rd Floor, Amma Maaligai Ripon Buildings, Chennai - 600 003**.

## Mandatory Documents for Submission
* **Proof of Identity/Age:** Birth Certificate, SSLC, or HSC certificate.
* **Academic Proof:** Diploma/B.Sc. Degree certificate and all mark sheets.
* **Registration:** Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration certificate.
* **Language Proficiency:** Evidence of Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th marks).
* **Other Documents:** Community certificate, Proof of residency (Aadhar/Voter ID), and a Character and Conduct certificate issued within the last 3 months.
