website_content.title: IRCTC SCZ Hospitality and Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: IRCTC South Central Zone is recruiting 28 Hospitality and Tourism Monitors via walk-in interviews in Bhubaneswar and Hyderabad.
website_content.markdown_content:
## IRCTC SCZ Recruitment 2026

Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC), South Central Zone, is inviting applications for fixed-term contract positions for **Hospitality Monitors** and **Tourism Monitors**.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Hospitality Monitors:** 22 Posts (includes 4 OBC backlog vacancies)
* **Tourism Monitors:** 6 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 28

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

#### 1. Hospitality Monitors
* **Education:** B.Sc in Hospitality & Hotel Administration / BBA/MBA (Culinary Arts) / B.Sc Hotel Management & Catering Science / MBA (Tourism & Hotel Management).
* **Age Limit:** Up to 28 years (No experience), 28-30 years (1 yr exp), 30-35 years (2 yrs exp). UR limit is 35 years.

#### 2. Tourism Monitors
* **Education:** 3-Year Bachelor's degree in Tourism **OR** Bachelor's degree in any stream + 1-year diploma in Travel & Tourism.
* **Experience:** 1 to 2 years in Tour Operation/Travel Agency Firms.
* **Age Limit:** Up to 35 years (UR).

### 💰 Remuneration & Benefits
* **Hospitality Monitors:** CTC ₹30,000/month + Daily Allowance (up to ₹350) + Lodging charges + National Holiday Allowance.
* **Tourism Monitors:** CTC ₹30,000 to ₹35,000/month (based on qualification) + Daily Allowance + Lodging charges.
* **Medical Insurance:** Provided as per age and post.

### 🗓️ Walk-in Interview Schedule

| Post | Venue | Date | Time |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hospitality** | IHM, Bhubaneswar | 05.10.2026 | 10:30 - 17:30 |
| **Hospitality** | IHM, Hyderabad | 08.10.2026 | 10:30 - 17:30 |
| **Tourism** | IRCTC Regional Office, Bhubaneswar | 06.10.2026 | 10:30 - 17:30 |
| **Tourism** | IRCTC Ltd, Secunderabad | 09.10.2026 | 10:30 - 17:30 |

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Download the application form from the official website.
2. Fill in all details and attach self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates.
3. Carry the completed form, original documents, and two passport-size photographs to the designated venue on the scheduled date.

website_content.title: Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27 Notification
website_content.summary: The District Urban Development Cell, Gadag, is recruiting 154 Pourakarmikas (Municipal Sanitation Workers) on a direct-payment basis. Interested candidates must apply offline by September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27

The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Gadag, has released a notification for the recruitment of **Pourakarmika (Municipal Sanitation Workers)** for the Gadag-Betageri City Municipal Council. These are temporary positions based on a direct-payment/honorarium (**Nera Paavati**) system.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 29.08.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 29.08.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30.09.2026

## 📋 Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 154 Posts
* **Special Reservation:** 15 posts (10%) are reserved for legal heirs of persons deceased under the Manual Scavengers Act.

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** No formal educational qualification required.
* **Language:** Must be able to speak **Kannada**.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 50 years (as of notification date). No age relaxation available.
* **Nationality:** Must be an Indian Citizen.

## 💰 Application Fee
Fees must be paid via **Demand Draft (DD)** in favor of the Project Director, District Urban Development Cell, DC Office, Gadag.
* **SC/ST/Category-1/Women:** ₹100
* **General/2A/2B/3A/3B:** ₹200

## 🛠 Selection Process
Selection is based on **scrutiny and priority** (No exam or interview):
1. **Priority 1:** Candidates with 1+ year of prior service as Pourakarmika, Loader, or UGD Helper.
2. **Priority 2:** Family members of Pourakarmikas deceased during COVID-19 or in service.
3. **Priority 3:** Candidates with 1+ year experience in allied sanitation roles.
4. **Priority 4:** Eligible legal heirs under the Manual Scavengers Act.

## 📝 How to Apply
1. **Obtain Form:** Collect the application form from the District Urban Development Cell (DC Office, Room No. 123, Gadag) or the City Municipal Council, Gadag-Betageri.
2. **Documentation:** Attach self-attested copies of age proof, category certificates, and service experience proofs.
3. **Payment:** Attach the required Demand Draft (DD).
4. **Submission:** Submit the completed form **offline** at the concerned local body office by **September 30, 2026**.

website_content.title: Tripura NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Revised Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: TRMCC has released the Revised Provisional Allotment Result for Round 2 of Tripura NEET UG 2026 for MBBS and BDS courses. Candidates must rely solely on the revised list for reporting to institutes.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Tripura Medical Counselling Committee (TRMCC), under the Directorate of Medical Education, Government of Tripura, has officially announced the **Revised Provisional Allotment Result for Round 2** of the NEET UG 2026 counselling process. This result applies to candidates seeking admission into **MBBS and BDS** courses under the state quota.

## Key Highlights
* **Important Update:** A previous provisional result was withdrawn due to technical issues; candidates must use the **Revised** version.
* **Automatic Cancellation:** Candidates upgraded to a new seat in Round 2 will have their Round 1 seat cancelled automatically.
* **Result Format:** The result is published as a PDF containing the list of allotted candidates.

## How to Check Your Result
1. Navigate to the official TRMCC portal.
2. Access the **'UG Counselling'** section.
3. Click on the link for the **Revised Provisional Allotment Result of Round-2**.
4. Open the PDF and use `Ctrl+F` to search for your **Roll Number** or **Candidate ID**.
5. Verify the allotted college, course, quota, and category.

## Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Documentation:** Keep your NEET UG admit card, scorecard, and all original certificates ready. Incomplete sets may lead to rejection by the institute.
* **Reporting:** Report to the allotted institute within the specified deadline to avoid automatic cancellation of the seat.
* **Verification:** Do not act upon any results published prior to the Revised Provisional Allotment list.

website_content.title: RITES Limited Recruitment 2026: Engineering Professionals (Ports & Waterways)
website_content.summary: RITES Limited (Navratna CPSE) is inviting applications for Senior and Assistant Manager positions in Ports, Waterways, and Coastal Modelling. Apply by October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚢 RITES Limited Recruitment 2026

RITES Limited, a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, is recruiting **Engineering Professionals** on a regular basis for specialized roles in maritime and coastal infrastructure.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 08.10.2026
* **Written Test (Tentative):** 25.10.2026

###  vacancy Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Age Limit |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Sr. Manager (Ports & Waterways) | 1 | 38 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Ports & Waterways) | 2 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Coastal Modelling) | 2 | 32 Years |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**Educational Qualification:**
* **Bachelor's Degree** in Civil Engineering (Full-time).
* **Master's Degree** in Marine Engineering & Management / Ocean Structures / Structural Engineering or Coastal Engineering.
* **Minimum Marks:** 60% for UR/EWS and 50% for Reserved categories.

**Work Experience:**
* **Sr. Manager:** Minimum 8 years professional experience (including 5 years in design/analysis of marine structures).
* **Assistant Manager:** Minimum 2 years professional experience in marine structure design or numerical modelling of coastal processes.

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Sr. Manager:** ₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000
* **Assistant Manager:** ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000
* **Additional Benefits:** Medical facilities, Group Insurance, Maternity/Paternity leave, and Leave Encashment.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Written Test:** 125 objective questions (No negative marking).
2. **Document Scrutiny:** Verification of eligibility documents.
3. **Interview:** Final selection based on 60% Written Test + 40% Interview weightage.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹600 + taxes
* **EWS/SC/ST/PwBD:** ₹300 + taxes (Refundable upon participation)

website_content.title: AAI SSCO Consultant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Airports Authority of India (AAI) invites applications from retired Short Service Commission Officers (SSCOs) for 39 Consultant positions. The last date to apply via email is October 1, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Airports Authority of India (AAI), a Schedule ‘A’ Mini Ratna Category-1 PSE, is seeking retired Short Service Commission Officers (SSCOs) from the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, or Coast Guard to serve as **Consultants** on a contract basis to support Air Traffic Services (ATS) at Joint User Defence Airfields.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 1 October 2026
* **Interview Date:** To be intimated via email to shortlisted candidates

## Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **39**

| Location | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- |
| Pune Airport (SMC) | 11 |
| Goa (Dabolim) Airport (SMC + ATC) | 15 |
| Port Blair Airport (SMC) | 04 |
| Darbhanga Airport | 03 |
| Purnea Airport | 04 |
| Kanpur Airport | 02 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Eligible Candidates:** Retired SSCOs of Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, or Coast Guard.
* **Educational Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
* **Professional Qualification:** Basic ATC Course/ATM and AL (Basic) and GCA/ATSS Course.
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of cumulative ATC duties (at least 1 year at a Joint User Defence Airfield).
* **Age Limit:** Maximum 50 years as of 01.10.2026. (Gap since retirement must not exceed 6 years).

## Selection Process
* **No Written Exam.**
* Selection is based solely on **Application Verification** and a **Personal Interview**.
* Merit ranking of the interview determines final selection.

## How to Apply
1. Download the Application Form (Annexure-1) from the official notification.
2. Attach self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates.
3. Merge all documents into a **single PDF (Max 5 MB)**.
4. Email the PDF to **[email protected]** on or before October 1, 2026.

**Note:** Applications sent via any other mode will be rejected.

## RRB JE CBT 2 Result 2026 Overview

The **Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)** has officially released the result for the **CBT 2 stage** of the Junior Engineer recruitment process (CEN 05/2025). This result determines the candidates provisionally shortlisted for Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination.

**Key Recruitment Details:**
* **Posts Covered:** Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS), and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA).
* **Total Vacancies:** 2,585
* **Candidates Appeared:** 39,002
* **Selection Process:** CBT 1 $\rightarrow$ CBT 2 $\rightarrow$ Document Verification $\rightarrow$ Medical Examination.

## Important Dates
* **CBT-2 Exam Date:** 2 July 2026
* **Result Release Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Scorecard Availability:** 16 September 2026

## How to Check the Result
1. Visit the official RRB zone website (via rrb.indianrailways.gov.in).
2. Click on the link: **"CEN 05/2025 – Result of 2nd Stage CBT & Shortlisting for Document Verification."**
3. Download the PDF and use **Ctrl+F** to search for your roll number.
4. To view the detailed scorecard, log in using your **Registration Number** and **Date of Birth/Password**.

## Important Instructions for Shortlisted Candidates
* Verify your **normalised marks** and qualifying status in the individual scorecard.
* Keep all **original documents** and valid photocopies ready for the upcoming Document Verification (DV) process.
* Regularly monitor the official RRB website for the specific DV and Medical Examination schedule.

website_content.summary: The State Level Police Recruitment Board (SLPRB), Andhra Pradesh, has invited online applications for 2,050 vacancies across the Police, Fire Services, and Prisons departments.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The State Level Police Recruitment Board (SLPRB), Andhra Pradesh, has released six notifications to recruit **2,050 personnel** for various roles within the AP Police Department, State Disaster Response and Fire Services, and Prisons and Correctional Services.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Sub Inspectors (SI):** Including Civil, AR, SPF, Communications, and PTO (Total: 438 posts).
* **Police Constables (PC):** Including Civil, AR, Communications, Mechanics, and Drivers (Total: 1,556 posts).
* **Firemen & Warders:** State Disaster Response and Prisons Dept (Total: 309 posts).
* **Scientific Assistants:** Forensic Science Laboratory (Total: 43 posts).

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * **SI (Civil/AR/SPF):** Any Degree.
    * **SI (Comm/PTO):** Relevant Diploma/B.Tech.
    * **Scientific Assistant:** M.Sc in Physics/Chemistry/Biology.
    * **Constable/Fireman/Warder:** Intermediate or equivalent (SSC + ITI for specific technical roles).
* **Age Limit (as of 01.07.2026):** 
    * **SI:** 21–27 years.
    * **Constables:** 18–24/27 years.
    * **Scientific Assistant:** Up to 44 years.
    * *Age relaxations apply for EWS, BC, SC, ST, and Govt employees.*

## Selection Process
Depending on the post, selection involves:
1. **Preliminary Written Test** (Qualifying)
2. **Physical Measurements Test (PMT)**
3. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET)**
4. **Final Written Examination / Technical Paper**
5. **Trade/Driving Test** (Where applicable)
6. **Certificate Verification**

## Application Fee
* **SI & Scientific Assistant:** ₹600 (OC/BC) | ₹300 (SC/ST)
* **Constable, Fireman & Warder:** ₹300 (OC/BC) | ₹150 (SC/ST)

website_content.markdown_content:
## GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026

Grid Controller of India Limited (GRID-INDIA), a Miniratna-I CPSE under the Ministry of Power, is inviting applications for the position of **Executive Trainee** for bright and committed engineers.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **52**

* **Executive Trainee (Electrical):** 37 Posts
* **Executive Trainee (Computer Science):** 15 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Educational Qualification:**
* **Electrical:** Full Time Regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.)/IDD in Electrical/Power Systems/Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum **65% marks/CGPA**.
* **Computer Science:** Full Time Regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.)/IDD in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/IT with minimum **65% marks/CGPA**.
* *Final year students expecting results by 14.08.2027 are eligible if they meet the 65% criteria in pre-final semesters.*

**2. Mandatory Requirement:**
* Candidates must appear in and qualify the **GATE 2027** paper in the corresponding discipline. Only GATE 2027 scores are valid.

**3. Age Limit (as of 31.07.2027):**
* Maximum Age: **28 Years**
* Relaxation: OBC-NCL (3 years), SC/ST (5 years), PwBD (10 years).

### ⚙️ Selection Process
The final selection is based on a weighted score:
* **GATE 2027 Score:** 85% Weightage
* **Group Discussion (GD):** 3% Weightage
* **Personal Interview (PI):** 12% Weightage

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000/- IDA (E2 Level).
* **Additional Benefits:** Performance Related Pay (PRP), Company Leased Accommodation/HRA, Medical facilities, and other government-approved allowances.
* **Service Bond:** Rs. 5,00,000 for General/OBC/EWS and Rs. 2,50,000 for SC/ST/PwBD.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Advertisement Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Window:** To be notified after GATE 2027 results are declared.
* **Crucial Date for Age:** 31.07.2027

### 💳 Application Fee
* **UR/OBC-NCL/EWS:** Rs. 500
* **SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen:** Exempted

website_content.title: CTET Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026 - 22nd Edition
website_content.summary: The CBSE is conducting the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) 2026 on December 12 and 13. This is a mandatory qualifying exam for teaching positions in KVS, NVS, and EMRS schools.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CTET 2026 Overview
The **Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)** is a national-level entrance exam conducted by CBSE to determine the eligibility of candidates for teaching classes 1 to 8 in central government schools.

### 📅 Key Exam Details
* **Exam Dates:** December 12 and 13, 2026
* **Mode of Exam:** Offline (Pen and Paper / OMR based)
* **Certificate Validity:** Lifetime
* **Negative Marking:** None

### 📝 Exam Structure
Candidates can appear for one or both papers based on their teaching goals:
* **Paper 1:** For those aspiring to teach **Classes 1 to 5** (Primary Level)
* **Paper 2:** For those aspiring to teach **Classes 6 to 8** (Upper Primary Level)

### 📊 Marking Scheme & Qualifying Marks
Each paper consists of **150 MCQs** for **150 Marks** with a duration of **2 hours 30 minutes**.

| Category | Qualifying Marks | Percentage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| General / UR | 90/150 | 60% |
| SC / ST / OBC / PwD | 82-83/150 | 55% |

### 📚 Syllabus Highlights

#### Paper 1 (Primary Stage)
* **Child Development & Pedagogy (30 Marks)**
* **Language I & II (30 Marks each)**
* **Mathematics (30 Marks)**
* **Environmental Studies (30 Marks)**

#### Paper 2 (Upper Primary Stage)
* **Child Development & Pedagogy (30 Marks)**
* **Language I & II (30 Marks each)**
* **Subject Specialization (60 Marks):** Either *Mathematics & Science* OR *Social Studies/Social Science*.

### 💡 Preparation Strategy
* Focus heavily on **CDP** as it is common to both papers.
* Use **NCERT Textbooks** for EVS, Science, and Social Studies.
* Solve **Previous Year Question Papers** to understand the pattern.
* Attempt all questions since there is **no negative marking**.

website_content.summary: Panjab University, Chandigarh has announced the results for the May 2026 session for ADCA, BA, and B.Voc courses. Candidates can access their provisional scorecards on the official result portal using their roll numbers.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Panjab University Result 2026 Overview

Panjab University, Chandigarh has officially released the examination results for the **May 2026 session**. Students of the following programs can now check their performance online.

### 🎓 Courses Declared
* **Advanced Diploma in Computer Application (ADCA)** - 2nd Semester
* **Bachelor of Arts (BA) 3 Year Programme (Private/CDOE)** - 2nd Semester
* **B.Voc. (Hospital Administration & Management) FYUP** - 4th Semester

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official Panjab University result portal.
2. Select the specific **Course and Semester** link from the homepage.
3. Enter your **Roll Number** (and Date of Birth if prompted).
4. Click on **"Show Result"** to view your provisional scorecard.
5. Download or print the result for future reference.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions

website_content.title: HPPSC Assistant Professor (Sanskrit) Provisional Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: HPPSC has released the provisional answer key for the Assistant Professor (College Cadre) Sanskrit screening test held on September 14, 2026. Eligible candidates can challenge the answer key online from September 16 to September 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) has published the provisional answer key for **Paper-I (Screening Test)** for the recruitment of **Assistant Professor (College Cadre) Sanskrit** under the Department of Higher Education, Himachal Pradesh.

## Key Dates
* **Exam Date:** 14 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Objection Window Opens:** 16 September 2026
* **Objection Window Closes:** 20 September 2026

## Objection Details
* **Objection Fee:** ₹100 per question (Non-refundable)
* **Submission Mode:** Online only
* **Requirement:** Every objection must be accompanied by an authentic supporting document/reference in **PDF format**.

## Step-by-Step Process to Raise Objections
1. Log in to the official HPPSC applicant portal using registered credentials.
2. Access the provisional answer key section for **Assistant Professor (College Cadre) Sanskrit, Paper-I**.
3. Identify and select the question(s) you wish to challenge.
4. Upload the required supporting PDF document for each question.
5. Complete the payment of ₹100 per question via the online link.
6. Submit the final objection within the specified window (16–20 Sept 2026).

## Important Instructions
* No offline objections will be accepted.
* Objections without the fee payment or supporting PDF documents will be summarily rejected.

website_content.summary: AIIMS Gorakhpur is recruiting for 68 Group-A Faculty positions across 31 medical departments. Applications close on October 13, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Gorakhpur has released a detailed advertisement for the recruitment of **Faculty (Group-A)** posts. These positions are available via Direct Recruitment, Deputation, and Contractual basis.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **68 Posts** across 31 departments/specialties:
* **Professor:** 18 Posts
* **Additional Professor:** 8 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 24 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 18 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Essential Qualification:**
* **Basic:** MBBS or equivalent recognized by NMC.
* **Post Graduate:** MD/MS or NMC-recognized equivalent in the relevant subject.
* **Super-Specialty:** DM/MCh for relevant posts.

**Teaching Experience (Post-Qualification):**
* **Professor:** 14 Years (General) / 11-12 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Additional Professor:** 10 Years (General) / 7-8 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Associate Professor:** 6 Years (General) / 3-4 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Assistant Professor:** 3 Years (General) / No experience required for Super-Specialty

### 💰 Salary & Pay Scale (7th CPC)
* **Professor:** Level-14A (₹1,68,900 – ₹2,20,400)
* **Additional Professor:** Level-13A2+ (₹1,48,200 – ₹2,11,400)
* **Associate Professor:** Level-13A1+ (₹1,38,300 – ₹2,09,200)
* **Assistant Professor:** Level-12 (₹1,01,500 – ₹1,67,400)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 14.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 14.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 13.10.2026 (Online & Hard Copy)

### 📝 Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹2,000
* **SC/ST:** ₹500
* **PwBD/Retired Faculty:** Nil

### 🛠 How to Apply
1. **Online:** Submit the application via the official Google Form.
2. **Documents:** Upload PDF/Word copies of application, brief of candidate, and PPT.
3. **Hard Copy:** Send signed application and self-attested documents via Speed/Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Gorakhpur by **13.10.2026**.

website_content.summary: ACPUGMEC has announced the Round 2 seat allotment results for MBBS and BDS courses in Gujarat. Candidates can now check their allotted institutes and download allotment letters.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Gujarat NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Allotment Details

The Admission Committee for Professional Undergraduate Medical Educational Courses (**ACPUGMEC**) has officially released the **Round 2 seat allotment results** for candidates seeking admission into MBBS and BDS courses in Gujarat.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** ACPUGMEC
* **Courses Covered:** MBBS and BDS
* **Result Declaration Date:** September 14, 2026
* **Allotment Type:** Rank-wise and Institute-wise PDFs

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Choice Filling:** September 7 to September 11, 2026
* **Revised Provisional Merit List:** September 8, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 14, 2026

### 🔍 How to Check Your Result (Without Login)
1. Visit the official portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Medical & Dental'** tab under the 'Undergraduate Admission' section.
3. Click on the **'Round 2 Seat Allotment Result'** link.
4. Open the Rank-Wise or Institute-Wise PDF and search for your Name, NEET Roll Number, or Rank using **Ctrl+F**.

### 📥 How to Download Allotment Letter (Login Required)
To complete the admission process, candidates must download their individual allotment letter:
1. Go to the official website and select **'Candidate Login'** under the Medical & Dental tab.
2. Enter your **User ID, Password, and 4-digit PIN**.
3. Download and print the allotment letter (Mandatory for reporting).

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* Do not rely on SMS/Email; check the official portal for the most accurate status.
* Ensure you download the official PDF from the verified government website.
* If not allotted a seat in Round 2, keep an eye on subsequent or mop-up round announcements.

website_content.summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited invites online applications for 210 Technician (Vocational) and Trade Apprentice positions. Eligible Kerala domicile candidates can apply by October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), a premier Miniratna Schedule 'A' Government of India company, is offering **210 apprenticeship seats** for one year of training under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

## Vacancy Details
A total of 210 seats are available, split as follows:
* **ITI Trade Apprentices:** 205 seats across 16 trades (Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Machinist, etc.)
* **Technician (Vocational) Apprentices:** 5 seats in disciplines like Accounting, Nursing, and CRM.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Education (ITI):** 10th Standard pass and ITI (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in notified trades.
* **Education (Vocational):** Pass in Vocational Higher Secondary Education (VHSE) in the concerned discipline.
* **Age Limit:** Minimum **18 years** as of 08.10.2026.
* **Domicile:** Must be a **domicile of Kerala**.

## Selection Process
There is **no written examination**. Selection is based on:
1. **Merit Shortlisting:** Based on percentage of marks in the prescribed qualification.
2. **Certificate Verification:** Original document check for shortlisted candidates.
3. **Medical Fitness:** Final selection subject to medical clearance.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 08.10.2026
* **Age Reckoning Date:** 08.10.2026

## Key Highlights
* **Application Fee:** Nil (Free)
* **Stipend:** Rs. 11,000/- per month
* **Training Duration:** One Year

website_content.summary: IUST Kashmir invites online applications for 51 leftover seats in B.Sc Nursing programmes following the JKBOPEE Mop-Up round. Eligible J&K domiciles must apply by September 18, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## IUST B.Sc Nursing Admission 2026

The Islamic University of Science and Technology (IUST), Kashmir, has announced admission opportunities for **vacant (leftover) seats** in B.Sc Nursing programmes. This is a limited-window opportunity for eligible candidates after the 3rd/Mop-Up Round of JKBOPEE counseling.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16-09-2026 (11:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 18-09-2026 (04:00 PM)

### 🏥 Vacancy Distribution
| College | Open Merit | Self Finance | Total |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Syed Mantaqi Memorial College | 8 | 5 | **13** |
| Alamdar Memorial College | 29 | 9 | **38** |
| **Grand Total** | **37** | **14** | **51** |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Domicile:** Only candidates belonging to the **UT of Jammu and Kashmir** are eligible.
* **Requirement:** Candidates must meet the prescribed eligibility criteria as per official IUST guidelines.

### 📝 Application Process
1. **Registration:** Register as a new user on the official IUST portal.
2. **Form Filling:** Enter personal and academic details exactly as per the Matriculation Certificate.
3. **JKBOPEE Details:** Provide competitive exam details.
4. **Documentation:** Upload required documents (100–200 KB, .jpg/.pdf).
5. **Payment:** Pay the non-refundable fee of **Rs. 500** (plus Rs. 200 for extra programmes).
6. **Submission:** Preview and submit the form. No modifications are allowed after final submission.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* Hard copies of the application do **not** need to be submitted.
* Applications with missing documents or unpaid fees will be rejected immediately.
* Current students seeking college changes must report in person by **18-09-2026**.

website_content.title: TG TET Answer Key 2026 for In-Service Teachers Released
website_content.summary: The Department of School Education, Telangana has released the provisional answer keys and response sheets for TGTET-In-Service Teachers 2026. Candidates can now review their performance and challenge incorrect answers by September 17.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TG TET In-Service Teachers 2026 Answer Key

The **Department of School Education, Government of Telangana (SCERT & TGTET Cell)** has officially released the provisional answer key for the Teacher Eligibility Test for In-Service Teachers conducted via Computer-Based Test (CBT).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **CBT Exam Dates:** 7 September to 11 September 2026
* **Provisional Answer Key Release:** 15 September 2026
* **Objection Window:** 15 September to 17 September 2026
* **Expected Result Date:** 28 to 30 September 2026

### 📋 Key Examination Details
* **Exam Mode:** Online Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Total Marks:** 150 Marks (for Paper-I and Paper-II)
* **Papers Available:** Paper-I (Classes I-V) and Paper-II (Mathematics & Science / Social Studies)

### 🛠️ How to Download Answer Key & Response Sheet
1. Visit the official portal at **tgtet.aptonline.in**.
2. Click on the **"Answer Key"** or **"Initial Key Download"** link.
3. Select the relevant **Paper and Language Medium**.
4. Log in with registration details to download the PDF.
5. Cross-verify your Response ID with the Official Correct Option.

### 🚩 How to Raise an Objection
Candidates finding discrepancies in the provisional key can challenge them until **17 September 2026**:
* Log in to the objection portal using Application Number and Password/DOB.
* Select the specific **Question ID** you wish to challenge.
* Upload **valid documentary proof** or reference sources in PDF format.
* Pay the applicable objection fee via the online gateway.
* Submit the form and save the acknowledgment receipt.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Verification:** Ensure you match the Question ID for your specific shift and medium to avoid errors.
* **Proof Required:** Objections without supporting evidence will not be considered.
* **Finality:** The final result will be based on the **Final Answer Key** issued after the review of all objections.

website_content.summary: The KPPGCA is expected to release the KMAT 2026 admit cards on September 16, 2026. Candidates can download their hall tickets from the official website for the entrance exam scheduled for September 20.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KMAT 2026 Admit Card Update

The **KMAT 2026 Admit Card** is expected to be released on **September 16, 2026**, with the download link likely becoming active between **2 PM and 5 PM**. 

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release:** September 16, 2026 (Expected)
* **Mock/Practice Test:** September 17-18, 2026
* **KMAT 2026 Exam Date:** September 20, 2026

### 📥 How to Download the Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official website.
2. Navigate to the **KMAT 2026** section on the homepage.
3. Click on the **admit card download link**.
4. Enter your **Login ID and Password** used during registration.
5. Submit the details and download your hall ticket.
6. Save a digital copy and take a **printed copy** for the exam.

### ⚠️ Critical Exam Day Instructions
* **Mandatory Documents:** A printed copy of the admit card and an additional photo ID proof are required for entry.
* **Technical Requirements:** Since this is a **remote-proctored online exam**, ensure your computer/laptop, webcam, and internet connection are fully functional.
* **Preparation:** Use the mock tests on **September 17-18** to familiarize yourself with the proctoring format.
* **Environment:** You must sit in a quiet, well-lit, disturbance-free room alone, without any unauthorized electronic devices.

website_content.title: Kerala M.Pharm 2026 Second Phase Option Registration
website_content.summary: CEE Kerala has opened the second phase online option registration for M.Pharm admissions 2026-27. Eligible GPAT candidates must submit their college preferences by September 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
* **Course:** Post Graduate Course in Pharmacy (M.Pharm) 2026-27
* **Conducting Body:** Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala
* **Allotment Phase:** Second Phase Centralized Allotment
* **Qualifying Exam:** GPAT 2024 / 2025 / 2026
* **Registration Mode:** Online only via Candidate Portal

## Important Dates
* **Start of Option Registration:** 14.09.2026
* **End of Option Registration:** 17.09.2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
* **Provisional Allotment Date:** 18.09.2026
* **Final Allotment Date:** 19.09.2026
* **Fee Remittance & Joining:** 22.09.2026 to 24.09.2026 (up to 4:00 PM)

## Step-by-Step Registration Process
1. Visit the official CEE Kerala website.
2. Access the **'M.Pharm 2026 - Candidate Portal'**.
3. Log in using your **Application Number and Password**.
4. Navigate to the **'Option Registration'** menu.
5. Arrange Course-College combinations based on your priority.
6. Submit the options before the deadline (17 Sept, 5:00 PM).

## Key Instructions
* **Mandatory Action:** Online option registration is compulsory for second phase consideration, even if you already have a first-phase allotment.
* **Careful Selection:** Only select colleges/courses you genuinely intend to join; withdrawing later may result in loss of registration fees.
* **No Offline Submissions:** Options sent via post, fax, or email will be strictly ignored.

## 🌲 UKSSSC Scaler Recruitment 2026

The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) is recruiting for the post of **Scaler** under the Uttarakhand Van Vikas Nigam (Forest Development Corporation).

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Scaler (Group-C)
* **Total Vacancies:** 200
* **Pay Scale:** ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 (Level-2)
* **Nature of Post:** Non-gazetted, Temporary (covered under EPF)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 22 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 22 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 26 October to 27 October 2026
* **PST/PET Date:** Tentatively from 19 November 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must have passed **Intermediate (12th)** or equivalent with **Science or Mathematics** from a recognized board/school in India/Uttarakhand.
* **Preferential Qualification:** 2 years service in Territorial Army OR NCC 'B' or 'C' certificate.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 28 years (as of 01 July 2026). Age relaxations apply for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories.
* **Domicile:** Candidate must be registered with Uttarakhand Employment Exchange, hold a domicile certificate, or have completed schooling in Uttarakhand.

### 🏃 Physical Standards (PST/PET)
**Height Requirements:**
* **Male:** 163 cm (Relaxed to 152 cm for ST/Gorkha/Garhwali/Kumaoni etc.)
* **Female:** 150 cm (Relaxed to 145 cm for ST/Gorkha/Garhwali/Kumaoni etc.)

**Physical Efficiency Test (Qualifying):**
* **Race:** Male (25 km in 4 hrs) | Female (14 km in 4 hrs)
* **Shot Put:** Male (5.00m) | Female (3.50m)
* **Long Jump:** Male (4.00m) | Female (2.00m)
* **High Jump:** Male (1.10m) | Female (0.70m)

### ✍️ Selection Process
1. **Stage 1:** Qualifying PST and PET.
2. **Stage 2:** Written Competitive Exam (100 Marks, Objective Type, 2 hours).
   * *Negative Marking:* 1/4th mark deducted for each wrong answer.
   * *Min Qualifying Marks:* 45% for UR/EWS/OBC and 35% for SC/ST.
3. **Stage 3:** Document Verification.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **UR/OBC:** ₹300
* **SC/ST/EWS/Divyang (Uttarakhand):** ₹150
* **Orphans:** No Fee

website_content.title: HPPSC Scientific Officer (NDPS) Recruitment 2026 - Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: HPPSC is recruiting for the post of Scientific Officer (NDPS), Group-B under the Directorate of Forensic Services. Candidates must clear a descriptive Subject Aptitude Test (SAT) covering Forensic Science and Chemistry.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) is conducting the recruitment process for **Scientific Officer (NDPS), Group-B** for the Directorate of Forensic Services, Home Department, H.P. The primary selection stage is the **Subject Aptitude Test (SAT)**.

## Exam Pattern: Subject Aptitude Test (SAT)
* **Question Type:** Descriptive
* **Total Marks:** 120
* **Duration:** 3 Hours
* **Structure:** Divided into two parts (Part-I and Part-II), each carrying 60 marks.

## Detailed Syllabus

### Part-I: Forensic Science Fundamentals (60 Marks)
* **Forensic Basics:** History, scope, Locard's Principle, and AI/ML applications.
* **Crime Scene Management:** Evidence collection, 3D recording, blood stain analysis, and road accident reconstruction.
* **Dactylography:** Fingerprint classification, Henry system, and NAFIS.
* **Instrumental Methods:** Microscopy (SEM, TEM), Spectroscopy (AAS, ICP-MS), and Chromatography (HPLC, TLC).
* **Quality & Law:** ISO/IEC 17025:2017, BNS, BNSS, BSA 2023, and the NDPS Act.
* **Research:** Methodology, ethics, and plagiarism detection.

### Part-II: Chemistry & Pharmacology (60 Marks)
* **Chemistry Basics:** Organic, Inorganic, and Physical chemistry, Stereochemistry, and Proteins/Lipids.
* **NDPS Specialization:** Narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, and active constituents of Papaver somniferum and Cannabis sativa.
* **Forensic Chemistry:** Arson investigation, petroleum products, and alcohol analysis.
* **Analytical Chemistry:** Volumetric/gravimetric techniques and GLP.
* **Separation Techniques:** GC-MS, LC-MS, and drug extraction methods (Stas-Otto).
* **Forensic Pharmacology:** Pharmacokinetics, drug metabolism, and toxicological studies.

## Key Preparation Strategies
* **Segmented Study:** Treat Part-I (Forensics) and Part-II (Chemistry/Pharmacology) as separate study blocks.
* **Focus on Instruments:** Deep dive into the principles and applications of spectroscopy and chromatography.
* **Descriptive Practice:** Since the exam is descriptive, practice long-form answer writing within the 3-hour time limit.
* **Legal Review:** Thoroughly study the BNS, BNSS, BSA 2023, and NDPS Act.

website_content.title: Kerala LLB3 Counselling 2026 Vacant Seat / Mop-Up Round Registration
website_content.summary: CEE Kerala has opened the vacant seat/mop-up round for admission to the 3-year LLB (LLB3) programme. Eligible candidates must register fresh or revised options through the official portal to secure remaining seats.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
CEE Kerala is conducting the **Vacant Seat / Mop-up Round** for the 3-year LLB (LLB3) course for the 2026 academic session. This round is designed to fill seats remaining after the completion of regular counselling phases due to upgradations, category conversions, or non-reporting.

## Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala
* **Course:** 3-Year LLB (LLB3)
* **Process:** Centralised Allotment Process (CAP)
* **Mode:** Online Registration

## Important Dates (Reference)
* **KLEE 2026 Entrance Exam:** June 28, 2026
* **Phase 2 Final Allotment:** September 3, 2026
* **Vacant Seat Round:** Currently Active

## How to Apply for Mop-Up Round
1. Visit the official CEE Kerala website.
2. Click on the **'Integrated Three Year LLB 2026 - Candidate Portal'**.
3. Log in using your application number and password.
4. Navigate to the **'Option Registration'** section.
5. Review vacant seats (college and category-wise) and submit your priority list.
6. Pay the registration fee (if applicable) and print the confirmation page.

## Important Instructions
* Only candidates meeting the mop-up round eligibility criteria should register.
* Allotments in this round are generally treated as **final**.
* Ensure you report to the allotted college within the stipulated window to avoid forfeiture of the seat.

* **December 7, 2026:** Science
* **December 9, 2026:** Indian Languages / Additional English
* **December 11, 2026:** Health and Physical Education / Computer Science / Vocational Subject
* **December 14, 2026:** Social Science
* **December 16, 2026:** Mathematics / Special Mathematics

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Candidates

website_content.summary: KNRUHS Warangal has released the provisional results for the Final MBBS Part-II (2019 Regulation) backlog examinations held in July 2026. Successful candidates can verify their pass status by register number on the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS)**, Warangal, has officially published the provisional results for the **Final MBBS Part-II (2019 Regulation)** backlog examinations conducted in July 2026.

## Key Result Details
* **Conducting Authority:** KNRUHS, Warangal, Telangana
* **Examination Session:** July 2026
* **Candidate Category:** Backlog Candidates
* **Result Date:** September 15, 2026
* **Result Format:** Provisional list of successful candidates by Register Number

## Subjects Covered
The results are released subject-wise for the following areas:
* General Medicine
* General Surgery
* Obstetrics & Gynaecology
* Ophthalmology
* Otorhinolaryngology (ENT)
* Pediatrics

## How to Check Your Result
1. Access the official KNRUHS website.
2. Open the PDF notification titled **"Results of Final MBBS Part-II (2019 Regulation) Examinations - July 2026 (Backlog Candidates)".**
3. Search for your **Register Number** under the relevant subject headings.
4. If your register number is listed under a subject, you have passed that specific subject.

## Important Instructions
* **Provisional Status:** This is a provisional list of successful candidates.
* **Subject-wise Pass:** Results are declared per subject, not as a combined pass/fail status for the entire Part-II exam.
* **Mark Statements:** Physical mark statements are **not available for download**; candidates must collect them from their respective colleges.

website_content.summary: RITES Limited is inviting applications for 33 regular posts including DGM, Manager, and Assistant Manager across various engineering disciplines. The application window closes on October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview

RITES Limited is recruiting Engineering Professionals on a regular basis across two distinct clusters:

* **Cluster-I:** Manager & Assistant Manager (29 Posts)
* **Cluster-II:** Deputy General Manager (DGM) (4 Posts)

## Vacancy Details

| Cluster | Designation | Total Posts | Age Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cluster-II** | Deputy General Manager (DGM) | 04 | 41 Years |
| **Cluster-I** | Manager | 15 | 35 Years |
| **Cluster-I** | Assistant Manager | 14 | 32 Years |

## Eligibility Criteria

### Academic Qualifications
* **Essential:** Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or Geophysics (as per post).
* **Specialization:** Master's Degree in Structural Engineering or Geophysics required for specific DGM and Manager roles.
* **Marks:** Minimum 60% (First Class) for UR/EWS; 50% for reserved categories.

### Experience Requirements
* **DGM (Cluster-II):** Minimum 11 years post-qualification experience.
* **Manager (Cluster-I):** Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience.
* **Assistant Manager (Cluster-I):** Minimum 2 years post-qualification experience.

## Pay Scale

* **DGM:** ₹70,000 – ₹2,00,000
* **Manager:** ₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000
* **Assistant Manager:** ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000

## Important Dates

* **Application Start Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 08 October 2026
* **Written Test (Cluster-I only):** 25 October 2026

## Selection Process

* **Cluster-I:** Written Test (125 objective questions) followed by an Interview.
* **Cluster-II:** Selection based on Interview (No written test).

website_content.title: Exim Bank Business Development Officer (BDO) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank) is inviting applications for 12 contractual Business Development Officer positions across 11 cities. Eligible candidates must apply via email by October 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Exim Bank is recruiting **Business Development Officers (BDO)** on a contractual basis to strengthen its business development functions in various regional locations.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 12
* **Post Type:** Contractual (Initially 3 years, extendable by 2 years)
* **Distribution:** 
    * Mumbai: 2 Posts
    * Other Cities (Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Chennai, Hyderabad, Indore, Kolkata, Lucknow, New Delhi, Pune): 1 Post each

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * Postgraduation in **Marketing or Finance** (preferably MBA).
    * Minimum 2-year full-time course from a recognized University.
    * Minimum **55% aggregate marks** or equivalent CGPA in both Graduation and Post-Graduation.
* **Work Experience:** Minimum **2 years of post-qualification experience** in Banks, Financial Institutions, or Upper Layer NBFCs (specializing in Corporate Loans Syndication or Corporate Credit).
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **35 years** as of August 31, 2026.

## Salary & Compensation
* **Annual Compensation:** Rs. 14.68 Lakh per annum.
* **Structure:** 80% Fixed and 20% Variable component.
* **Increments:** Annual increments available for candidates with two years of experience.

## Selection Process
1. **Application Screening:** Verification of qualification, experience, and age.
2. **Shortlisting:** Candidates will be shortlisted for interviews in a **1:10 ratio** based on post-graduation percentage scores.
3. **Personal Interview:** Final selection based on interviews conducted in Mumbai or New Delhi.

## Important Dates
* **Application Deadline:** October 15, 2026
* **Crucial Date for Age:** August 31, 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## TRTI CET 2026 Overview
The Tribal Research and Training Institute (TRTI), Maharashtra is conducting the Common Entrance Test (CET) for admission into various prestigious coaching schemes. This exam is a gateway for candidates to access specialized training under **TRTI, BARTI, ARTI, SARTHI, and AMRUT**.

* **Hall Ticket Status:** Released
* **Mode of Download:** Online
* **Required Credentials:** Registered Email ID and Date of Birth

## Important Dates
* **Online Registration Started:** 9 August 2026
* **Registration Deadline:** 4 September 2026
* **Exam Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Exam End Date:** 30 September 2026

## How to Download Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official TRTI CET hall ticket portal.
2. Navigate to the **Hall Ticket / Login** section.
3. Enter your **registered email ID** and **date of birth**.
4. Click on **Submit/Login** to view your admit card.
5. Download the PDF and take a clear printout for the exam center.

* **Reporting Time:** Check your individual hall ticket for the exact date, reporting time, and center address.
* **Verification:** Report any errors in personal details to the official helpdesk immediately.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The District Collector's Office, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri, through the **Telangana Employment Assistants Mission (TEAM)**, is hiring for various paramedical, technical, and support roles on an outsourcing basis.

## Key Vacancies & Remuneration
A total of **70 posts** are available across 24 categories:

* **High Pay (Rs. 22,750/-):** Speech Therapist, Psychiatric Social Worker, Lab Technician, ECG Technician, Dental Technician, Child Psychologist, Audiometry Technician, Radiographic Technician, O.T Technician, Blood Bank Technician.
* **Mid Pay (Rs. 19,500/-):** Tailor, Record Clerk, Plumber, Museum Assistant, Driver, Data Entry Operator, Carpenter, Barber, Theatre Assistant.
* **Support Pay (Rs. 15,600/-):** Audio Visual Technician, Ward Boy, Office Subordinate, Lab Attendant, Dhobi/Packer.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Domicile:** Only candidates domiciled in **Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district** are eligible. (Spouse domicile is accepted for non-residents married to locals).

* **Education:** Varies by post (from 10th Pass for Office Subordinates to PhD for Child Psychologists). Detailed qualifications are listed in the official notification.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 23.09.2026 (up to 5:00 PM)

## Application Process
* **Mode:** **Offline (Physical Submission Only)**
* **Application Fee:** Rs. 50/- (Cash only, non-refundable)
* **Submission Location:** Office of TEAM, District Collector's Office, Room No. F8, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District.
* **Documents Required:** Self-attested copies of qualification certificates, experience certificates, income certificate, Aadhar card, and 10th class certificate.

website_content.title: Karnataka PGCET 2026 Counselling Round 1 Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has concluded the Round 1 option entry for PGCET 2026. Candidates for MBA, MCA, M.E./M.Tech, and M.Arch are now awaiting the seat allotment results.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** is conducting the counselling process for the Post Graduate Common Entrance Test (PGCET) 2026 to allocate seats in professional post-graduate courses.

## Courses Covered
* **MBA**
* **MCA**
* **M.E./M.Tech**
* **M.Arch**

## Important Dates (Round 1)
* **Result Declaration:** 19 August 2026
* **Draft Seat Matrix Published:** 8 September 2026
* **Claim Slip Download:** 10 September to 15 September 2026
* **Option Entry Window:** 11 September to 15 September 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** Awaited

## How to Check Seat Allotment Result
1. Visit the official portal: **cetonline.karnataka.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **PGCET 2026 counselling** section.
3. Click on the seat allotment result link for Round 1.
4. Log in using your **CET number** and the credentials provided on your claim slip.
5. View the allotted college, course, and category.
6. Download and print the allotment result for future reference.

## Essential Instructions for Candidates
* **Roster Based:** Allotment depends on the roster, your entered options, and seat availability; rank alone does not guarantee a seat.
* **Mock Results:** Mock allotments are indicative and not a final promise as demand shifts after options are edited.
* **Option Strategy:** Candidates are advised not to shorten their option lists; a wider, correctly ordered list improves chances.
* **Reporting:** Candidates must report to the allotted institute within the specified deadline to prevent cancellation of the seat.
* **Official Sources:** Only trust dates published on the official KEA portal.

website_content.title: NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Counselling Registration
website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has initiated Round 2 registration for NEET MDS 2026 admissions. This round includes AIQ, Deemed, Central Universities, and AFMS dental seats.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Overview
The **Medical Counselling Committee (MCC)** has officially opened the registration window for **NEET MDS 2026 Round 2**. This phase is critical for candidates seeking admission into Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) programs across India.

### 🎓 Seats Covered
* **50% All India Quota (AIQ)** seats
* **100% Deemed Universities** seats
* **100% Central Universities** seats
* **AFMS Dental Institutions** seats

### 📅 Important Dates
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Online Registration** | Sept 15 to Sept 19, 2026 (3:00 PM) |
| **Choice Filling Window** | Starts Sept 16, 2026 |
| **Choice Locking Window** | Sept 19 (4:00 PM) to Sept 20 (10:00 AM) |
| **Seat Allotment Result** | September 23, 2026 |
| **Reporting at Institute** | Sept 24 to Sept 30, 2026 |

### 📝 Application Process
1. **Registration:** Visit the official MCC portal and fill in personal, academic, and NEET MDS details.
2. **Payment:** Pay the required registration fee and security deposit.
3. **Choice Filling:** Arrange preferred colleges and courses in priority order.
4. **Choice Locking:** Ensure choices are locked by **10:00 AM on September 20, 2026**.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Deadlines:** Complete payment before 3:00 PM on Sept 19 to avoid technical glitches.
* **Upgradation:** Candidates holding a Round 1 seat must report to their current institute before opting for an upgrade.
* **Finality:** Once locked, choices cannot be edited. Double-check your preference list carefully.

website_content.title: Nirmal District Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The WCD&SC Department, Nirmal District, is inviting online applications for 89 Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) posts. Eligible women candidates must apply by September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Nirmal District Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) Recruitment 2026

The Women, Child, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare Department, Nirmal District, Government of Telangana, has released a notification for the recruitment of **Anganwadi Teachers (AWT)** across four ICDS projects: Bhainsa, Khanapur, Mudhole, and Nirmal.

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 11 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30 September 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
* **Age Reckoning Date:** 1 July 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Only Women applicants are eligible.
* **Education:** Must have passed **Intermediate (12th Class)**.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of July 1, 2026).
* **Locality Rules:** 
    * Applicant must be a **local resident** of the concerned Anganwadi Center's area (Ward for Urban, Gram Panchayat for Rural).
    * Specific SC/ST sub-plan area restrictions apply as per the official vacancy list.

### 📊 Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 89 (AWT only)
* **ICDS Projects:** Bhainsa, Khanapur, Mudhole, Nirmal
* **Selection Basis:** Merit-based selection (No written exam).

### 🏆 Selection Process
Selection is based on total marks awarded by the District-level Selection Committee:
* **Intermediate Marks (Merit):** 70 Marks
* **Interview:** 10 Marks
* **Special Category Bonus:** 
    * Orphans: 10 Marks
    * Widows: 5 Marks
    * PwD: 5 Marks

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official department website.
2. Identify the AWC ID/Name relevant to your local Gram Panchayat/Ward.
3. Ensure you match the reserved category for that specific center.
4. Submit the online application form before the deadline.

website_content.markdown_content:

website_content.title: Kerala LLB 5-Year Integrated Law Counselling Vacant Seat Round 2026
website_content.summary: CEE Kerala has opened the Mop-Up round for admission to Integrated Five-Year LLB (LLB5) programmes. Eligible candidates can now register fresh or revised options to secure remaining seats across state law colleges.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala, is conducting the **Vacant Seat (Mop-Up) Round** for admission to the Integrated Five-Year LLB (LLB5) programme. This round is designed to fill seats remaining after the regular Phase 1 and Phase 2 allotment rounds due to non-reporting or category conversions.

## Key Highlights
* **Exam Name:** Kerala Law Entrance Examination (KLEE) 2026
* **Course:** Integrated Five-Year LLB (LLB5)
* **Stage:** Vacant Seat / Mop-Up Round
* **Authority:** CEE, Kerala

## Important Dates
* **KLEE 2026 Exam:** June 28, 2026
* **Final Rank List:** July 29, 2026
* **Phase 1 Allotment:** August 17, 2026
* **Phase 2 Allotment:** September 3, 2026
* **Mop-Up Round:** Currently Active/Upcoming (Check portal for specific deadlines)

## How to Register for Mop-Up Round
1. Visit the official CEE Kerala portal.
2. Access the **'Integrated Five Year LLB 2026 - Candidate Portal'**.
3. Log in using your application number and password.
4. Review the college-wise and category-wise vacant seats.
5. Submit your preferred options in order of priority.
6. Pay the registration fee if applicable and print the confirmation.

## Critical Instructions
* **Finality:** Allotments in the mop-up round are generally treated as final.
* **Previous Admissions:** If a new seat is allotted, previous admissions are typically cancelled.
* **Verification:** Regularly monitor your registered email and mobile number for official updates.

website_content.markdown_content:
## KEA KSRP/KSISF/IRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026

The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has officially released the admit cards for candidates appearing in the written examination for the recruitment of **Special Reserve Police Constable (KSRP), Karnataka State Industrial Security Force (KSISF), and Indian Reserve Battalion (IRB)**.

### **Recruitment Snapshot**
* **Conducting Body:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Department:** Karnataka State Police Department
* **Total Vacancies:** 2,314
* **Posts:** KSRP, KSISF, and IRB Constables
* **Exam Date:** September 20, 2026

### **Important Dates**
* **Notification Release:** July 10, 2026
* **Application Window:** July 13, 2026 – August 10, 2026
* **Hall Ticket Release:** September 15, 2026
* **Written Exam Date:** September 20, 2026

### **Steps to Download Hall Ticket**
1. Visit the official KEA portal.
2. Locate the link **"KSRP/KSISF/IRB Constable Hall Ticket 2026"**.
3. Enter your **Registration Number** and required credentials.
4. Enter the security captcha and click **Submit**.
5. Download and save the PDF. It is recommended to take 2–3 clear printouts.

### **Exam Day Guidelines**
* **Mandatory Documents:** Printed Hall Ticket and a valid original photo ID (photocopies are not accepted).
* **Reporting:** Reach the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on your individual admit card.
* **Verification:** Double-check your name, photograph, and category on the hall ticket immediately after downloading.

website_content.title: UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: UPESSC is recruiting 12,405 Assistant Teachers for Urban and Sambaddh Primary posts across Uttar Pradesh. Applications are open from September 16, 2026, for qualified candidates with a degree, BTC, and TET.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Uttar Pradesh Shiksha Seva Chayan Aayog (UPESSC)**, Prayagraj, has announced a massive recruitment drive for Assistant Teachers under the Basic and Secondary Education Departments.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Total Vacancies:** 12,405
* **Assistant Teacher (Primary, Urban):** 11,508 posts (Basic Education Dept)
* **Assistant Teacher (Sambaddh Primary):** 897 posts (Secondary Education Dept)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * Graduate degree from a recognized university.
    * Training qualification: B.T.C. / D.El.Ed. / B.El.Ed. or equivalent.
    * Must have qualified the **Teacher Eligibility Test (TET)** conducted by State or Central Government.
* **Age Limit (as of 01.07.2026):**
    * **Urban Posts:** 21–40 years.
    * **Sambaddh Primary:** Minimum 21 years.
    * *Age relaxations apply for SC/ST/OBC (5 years), PwBD (15 years), and Shiksha Mitras (up to 60 years).*

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Last Date for Fee Payment:** 15.10.2026
* **Correction Window:** Until 19.10.2026
* **Written Exam Date:** 03 & 04 December 2026

## Salary & Application Fee
* **Salary:** Pay Level-6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400)
* **Application Fee:**
    * General/OBC/EWS: ₹1,000
    * SC/ST: ₹500
    * PwBD: ₹300

## Selection Process & Exam Pattern
Selection is based on a **Merit List** derived from a written examination:
* **Total Marks:** 360 marks
* **Questions:** 120 Objective Type (MCQs)
* **Duration:** 2 Hours
* **Marking:** +3 for correct answer; -1 for wrong answer (Negative Marking applies).
* **Language:** Bilingual (Hindi & English).

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS)** has officially released the **Phase 2 (Competent Authority Quota)** seat allotment list for the MBBS course for the academic session 2026-27.

* **Allotment Release Date:** September 15, 2026
* **Phase 2 Reporting Deadline:** September 19, 2026 (by 4:00 PM)
* **Management Quota Reporting Deadline:** September 19, 2026 (by 6:00 PM)

## Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Reporting:** Candidates must report to the allotted college, complete document verification, and pay the required fees strictly before the deadline.
* **Sliding Candidates:** Those sliding from Phase 1 must be formally relieved and collect original documents from their previous college before reporting to the new one.
* **Eligibility Warning:** Failure to join after the Phase 2 allotment will result in ineligibility for any subsequent counseling rounds.

## How to Check Result
1. Visit the official KNRUHS portal.
2. Navigate to the "Phase 2 MBBS Seat Allotment 2026-27" link.
3. Open the college-wise PDF list.
4. Search by **Hall Ticket Number, NEET Roll Number, or Rank**.

website_content.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Shiksha Seva Chayan Ayog (UPESSC) is recruiting 2,607 Pravakta (PGT/Lecturer) posts across 26 subjects. Eligible candidates must apply online by October 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The UP Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has announced direct recruitment for **2,607 Pravakta (PGT/Lecturer)** positions in government-aided secondary schools across Uttar Pradesh under Advertisement No. 06/2026.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 18 September 2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 17 October 2026
* **Application Correction Last Date:** 21 October 2026
* **Written Examination:** 15 and 16 December 2026

## Vacancy Details
A total of **2,607 vacancies** are available across 26 subjects:
* **Boys' Schools:** 2,329 posts
* **Girls' Schools:** 278 posts
* **Top Subjects:** Hindi (374), English (285), Sanskrit (264), and Geography (248).

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** 
    * **General Subjects:** Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject AND a B.Ed degree from an NCTE-recognized programme.
    * **Physical Education:** Graduate degree AND M.P.Ed.
    * **Painting Arts:** High School + Diploma in Fine Arts AND B.Ed.
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 62 years (as of 1 July 2026).
* **Nationality:** Must be a citizen of India.

## Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Level:** Level-8
* **Pay Scale:** ₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100

## Selection Process
The final merit list is based on a total of **400 marks**:
1. **Written Examination (360 Marks):** 120 objective questions (30 GK + 90 Subject-specific). Marking: +3 for correct, -1 for wrong.
2. **Interview (40 Marks):** Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview.

## Application Fee
* **General / OBC / EWS:** ₹1,500
* **SC / ST:** ₹750
* **PwD:** ₹500

* **Experience:** Freshers are eligible; candidates with 1-3 years of experience in similar field-based roles are preferred.

* Kerala

Interested candidates should send their updated resume to **[email protected]** with the subject line **'Application for Customer Service Officer (CSO)'**.

## Overview
The University of Petroleum and Energy Studies (UPES), Dehradun, has activated the registration process for **B.Tech Admissions for the 2027-28 academic session**. Aspiring engineers can now apply through multiple entrance pathways.

## Admission Pathways

* **UPESEAT** (UPES Engineering Aptitude Test)
* **JEE Main**
* **CUET UG**
* **Class 12 Board Merit**
* **SAT**

## Application Details
* **Application Mode:** Online
* **Application Fee:** ₹1,750 (specifically for the UPESEAT route)
* **Course:** B.Tech (Multiple Specializations available)

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. Visit the official UPES admissions portal.
2. Click on **'Apply Now'** and register as a new applicant.
3. Complete the personal, academic, and contact information sections.
4. Select your preferred **B.Tech programme** and the **admission pathway**.
5. Upload necessary documents and pay the application fee online.
6. Review and submit the form; download the confirmation page for future use.

## Important Instructions
* Ensure all academic and personal details match official government records.
* Review specific eligibility criteria for different B.Tech specializations as they may vary.
* Keep monitoring the official portal for announcements regarding exam dates, admit cards, and results.

website_content.summary: BSA Gorakhpur invites offline applications from eligible female candidates for 132 contract-based teaching and non-teaching posts in KGBV schools. The application deadline is September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Office of the District Basic Education Officer (BSA), Gorakhpur, is hiring for various contract-based (**Samvida**) positions for the 2026-27 academic session. These roles are specifically for Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas (KGBV) and upgraded KGBVs.

**⚠️ Important:** Only **Female Candidates** are eligible to apply.

## Vacancy Details (Total: 132 Posts)

### Teaching Posts
* **Principal:** 4 Posts
* **PGT (Hindi, English, Maths, Bio, Chem, Phys, CS):** Multiple Posts
* **Full-Time Teachers (Classes 6-8):** Multiple Posts
* **Part-Time Teachers (Computer, Art, Craft, Music):** Multiple Posts

### Non-Teaching Posts
* **Accountant / Office Superintendent / Clerk**
* **Lab Assistant**
* **Head Cook / Assistant Cook**
* **Peon / Chowkidar**

## Eligibility & Qualification
* **Principal/PGT:** Post Graduate with B.Ed.
* **Full-Time Teacher:** Graduate with B.Ed.
* **Accountant:** Graduate in Commerce with Computer knowledge.
* **Clerk:** Intermediate pass with typing proficiency (Hindi 25 wpm / English 30 wpm).
* **Support Staff (Cook/Peon/Chowkidar):** Class 8th Pass.

## Age Limit (as of 01-04-2026)
* **General Posts:** 25 to 45 Years
* **Principal:** 30 to 45 Years

## Salary (Monthly Honorarium)
* **Principal:** ₹30,000
* **PGT:** ₹22,000
* **Full-Time Teacher:** ₹25,410
* **Clerk/Accountant:** ₹11,000 - ₹12,705
* **Support Staff:** ₹5,978 - ₹7,970

## Selection Process
* **Merit-Based:** Principal, PGT, Teachers, Accountant, and Lab Assistant (based on academic marks).
* **Typing Test:** Office Superintendent/Clerk.
* **Interview:** Cook, Peon, and Chowkidar.

## How to Apply
1. Download the application form from the official district website.
2. Fill the form clearly (no overwriting) and attach self-attested documents.
3. Enclose **three self-addressed envelopes** with ₹58 postage stamps each.
4. Send via **Registered Post/Speed Post** to: *Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Sitapur Aankh Ka Aspatal Campus, Park Road, Gorakhpur – 273001*.

website_content.title: KNRUHS Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing (2 YDC) Admission 2026-27
website_content.summary: KNRUHS has announced admissions for the Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing) 2-year degree course for the 2026-27 academic session. Applications are open from September 16 to September 24, 2026, under the Competent Authority Quota.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Admission Overview
Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS), Warangal, is inviting applications for the **Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing) 2 Years Degree Course (2 YDC)** for the Academic Year 2026-27. This admission process covers seats under the **Competent Authority Quota** in both Government and Private Nursing colleges across Telangana.

## Key Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15-09-2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 16-09-2026 (09:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 24-09-2026 (05:00 PM)

## Course Details
* **Course:** Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing)
* **Duration:** 2 Years
* **Academic Year:** 2026-27
* **Quota:** Competent Authority (Convener) Quota

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Registration:** Visit the portal and register using a valid mobile number and email ID (OTP verification required).
2. **Form Filling:** Complete the registration form with accurate candidate details.
3. **Payment:** Confirm caste category and pay the non-refundable registration fee through the payment gateway.
4. **Login:** Use your Roll Number and Registration Number to access the application form.
5. **Uploads:** Upload a passport-size photo and signature (both must be in JPG/JPEG format and under 100 KB).
6. **Documentation:** Upload all required certificates and print the final application for reference.

## Important Guidelines
* **Anti-Drug Policy:** Candidates must tick the Anti-Drug undertaking and submit a signed declaration from both the student and parent/guardian at the time of admission.
* **Zero Tolerance:** Ragging is strictly prohibited and can lead to immediate cancellation of the seat.
* **Updates:** No individual notifications will be sent; candidates must monitor the official website regularly.
* **Accuracy:** Providing false information may lead to criminal action.

website_content.title: KBCNMU Temporary Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: KBCNMU has announced 138 vacancies for Temporary Assistant Professors across various university schools and departments. The online application window is open from September 12 to September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University (KBCNMU), Jalgaon, is inviting applications for the post of **Temporary Assistant Professor (Contract)** for the academic year 2026-27. These positions are self-supporting and based on a contract.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 138 posts across 54 subject codes.
* **Nature of Job:** Purely temporary and contract basis.
* **Posting Locations:** University Schools/Departments (Jalgaon), Science and Commerce College (Molgi), and Tribal Academy (Nandurbar).

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 11.09.2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 12.09.2026
* **Online Application Deadline:** 28.09.2026
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline:** 05.10.2026 (up to 5:00 PM)

## Eligibility Criteria
Eligibility varies based on the subject group:

**1. UGC/State Government Rules (General Subjects):**
* Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject.
* Must have cleared **NET/SET** or hold a **Ph.D.** degree as per UGC regulations.

**2. AICTE Rules (Computer Science/IT & Engineering):**
* **CS/IT:** B.E./B.Tech/B.S. & M.E./M.Tech/M.S. or B.E./B.Tech & MCA with first class in any one degree.
* **Engineering/Tech:** B.E./B.Tech/B.S. & M.E./M.Tech/M.S. with first class in any one degree.
* **Management:** Master's degree in Business Administration/PGDM/CA/ICWA/M.Com with first class and 2 years of professional experience.

## Selection Process
* **Short-listing:** Based on Maharashtra Government Resolution dated 08 March 2019 (Table 3A).
* **Final Selection:** Through a personal interview.

## Application Fee
* **Open Category:** Rs. 750/-
* **Reserved Category:** Rs. 375/-

website_content.title: AIIMS B.Sc. Nursing & Allied Health Care Open Round Counselling 2026
website_content.summary: AIIMS New Delhi has announced the final Open Round of seat allocation for B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing and Allied & Health Care Courses for the August-2026 session. Registration and choice filling must be completed by September 16, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIIMS B.Sc. Nursing & Allied Health Care Open Round 2026

AIIMS New Delhi has opened the **final round (Open Round)** for seat allocation for the August-2026 session. This is the last opportunity for eligible candidates to secure a seat.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Vacancies:** 239 vacant seats for B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing across 19 participating AIIMS institutes.
* **Courses Covered:** B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing and B.Sc. Allied & Health Care Courses.
* **Security Deposit:** A mandatory deposit of **Rs 25,000** is required for eligibility.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration & Choice Filling:** September 11 to September 16, 2026 (until 5:00 PM)
* **Seat Surrender Deadline:** September 15, 2026 (for existing seat holders)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 19, 2026
* **Reporting/Joining Period:** September 24 to September 28, 2026

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Eligibility Requirement:** Candidates must complete **both** the registration/choice filling and the payment of the security deposit to be considered.
* **Payment Warning:** The security deposit must be paid from the **candidate's, parent's, or relative's bank account**. Payments from cyber cafés or shared accounts are strictly prohibited as refunds are processed to the original source account.
* **Penalty Clause:** Candidates who are allotted a seat but fail to report within the stipulated dates will face a **penalty of Rs 25,000** in addition to the forfeiture of their security deposit.

### 🛠️ How to Register
1. Log in to the official portal using entrance exam credentials.
2. Click on the **'Open Round of Seat Allocation'** link.
3. Verify details and select preferred AIIMS institutes in order of priority.
4. Submit choices and pay the security deposit via the online payment link.

website_content.title: GADVASU Group C Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: GADVASU Ludhiana is inviting online applications for 45 Group C positions including Steno Typist, Clerk, and Storekeeper. The application window is open from September 16 to October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GADVASU Group C Recruitment 2026

Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (GADVASU), Ludhiana, has released Advertisement No. 03/2026 for the recruitment of **45 Group C posts**. 

### Vacancy Details
* **Clerk:** 20 Posts
* **Steno Typist:** 15 Posts
* **Storekeeper:** 10 Posts
* **Total:** 45 Vacancies

### Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualifications:**
* **Storekeeper:** Bachelor's degree with Economics / B.Com / B.B.A.
* **Clerk & Steno-Typist:** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.

**Mandatory Requirements (All Posts):**
* **Computer Proficiency:** 120-hour certified course in PC use/IT or 'O' level certificate from DOEACC.
* **Punjabi Language:** Must have passed Matriculation in Punjabi from PSEB or a recognized board.

### Selection Process
All candidates must first pass the **Qualifying Punjabi Language Test (Exam-I)**. Following this, the process differs by post:

* **Storekeeper:** Main Examination (Exam-II) focusing on General Knowledge and Core Subjects (Commercial Math, GST, Store Keeping, etc.).
* **Clerk:** Main Examination (Exam-II) followed by a **Qualifying Typing Proficiency Test** in both Punjabi (Raavi font) and English.
* **Steno-Typist:** Main Examination (Exam-II) and a **Shorthand Proficiency Test** (English & Punjabi), where shorthand marks contribute to the final merit.

### Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 8 October 2026 (4:00 PM)
* **Hard Copy Deadline (In-service only):** 21 October 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## Bihar Vidhan Parishad Final Result 2026

The **Bihar Vidhan Parishad (BVP)**, also known as the Bihar Legislative Council Secretariat (BLCS), has officially announced the **Final Result 2026** for various administrative positions. 

### 📌 Recruitment Overview
* **Advertisement Number:** 02/2025

* **Posts Covered:** 
    * Personal Assistant (PA)
    * Data Entry Operator (DEO)
    * Lower Division Clerk (LDC)

* **Exam Date (DEO):** 10 May 2026
* **Exam Date (PA/Steno):** 02 May 2026
* **Final Result Declared:** 14 September 2026

### 🔍 How to Check Your Result
1. Navigate to the official website of the Bihar Legislative Council.
2. Go to the **"Recruitment / Result"** section on the homepage.
3. Click the specific final result link for your applied post.
4. Log in using your **Enrollment Number/Registration Number** and **Date of Birth**.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Document Verification:** Qualifying the final result is the first step; candidates should prepare for subsequent stages like Document Verification.
* **Verification:** Ensure you download and print a copy of the result for future official use.
* **Support:** For any discrepancies, contact the official Bihar Legislative Council helpdesk directly.

website_content.title: MAT September 2026 CBT Admit Card Release
website_content.summary: AIMA will release the MAT September 2026 Computer Based Test (CBT) admit cards on September 17, 2026. Registered candidates can download their hall tickets to appear for the exam on September 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MAT September 2026 CBT Admit Card Details

The **All India Management Association (AIMA)** is set to release the hall tickets for the Management Aptitude Test (MAT) September 2026 session. Candidates who registered for the Computer Based Test (CBT) can access their admit cards starting from **5:00 PM on September 17, 2026**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **CBT Registration Closing Date:** September 14, 2026
* **PBT Admit Card Release:** September 10, 2026
* **PBT Exam Date:** September 13, 2026
* **CBT Admit Card Release:** September 17, 2026 (Expected)
* **CBT Exam Date:** September 20, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official website **mat.aima.in**.
2. Click on the login link for registered candidates.
3. Enter your **registered email ID/application number** and **password**.
4. Locate the "MAT CBT Admit Card" link on your dashboard.
5. Download and verify all details carefully.
6. **Print two clear copies** on A4-size paper for the exam day.

### ⚠️ Essential Instructions
* **Mandatory Document:** Entry to the exam hall is strictly prohibited without the admit card.
* **Center Allotment:** Test center changes are not permitted once the admit card is issued.
* **Discrepancies:** Contact AIMA immediately if any errors are found in the admit card.
* **Reporting:** Reach the test center well before the reporting time mentioned on the hall ticket.
