website_content.title: APPSC Welfare Officers Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: APPSC announces recruitment for 90 posts of Assistant Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, and Hostel Welfare Officers. Online applications are open from 9 October to 29 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The **Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)** has issued brief notifications (No. 25/2026 & 26/2026) for direct recruitment to various welfare officer positions across the state's Social, Tribal, and Backward Classes Welfare departments.

## Vacancy Details
A total of **90 provisional vacancies** are available:
* **Assistant Social Welfare Officer:** 11 Posts
* **Assistant Tribal Welfare Officer:** 06 Posts
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** 73 Posts (Distributed across Social, Tribal, and BC Welfare services)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Assistant Social/Tribal Welfare Officer:** Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university or equivalent.
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** Educational qualifications will be specified in the Detailed Notification (due by 9 October 2026).
* **Crucial Date:** The date of the Detailed Notification will be the cutoff date for age and qualification eligibility.

## Salary Structure
* **Assistant Welfare Officers:** ₹48,440 – 1,37,220
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** ₹37,640 – 1,15,500

## Selection Process
Selection will be based on a **single-level online Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT)**. There will be no screening test regardless of the number of applications.

**Exam Scheme:**
* **Assistant Welfare Officers:** 3 Papers (General Studies & Mental Ability + 2 Subject Papers), Total 450 Marks.
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** 2 Papers (General Studies & Mental Ability + Education), Total 300 Marks.
* **Negative Marking:** 1/3rd mark deduction for each wrong answer.

## Important Dates
* **Detailed Notification:** On or before 9 October 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 9 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 29 October 2026 (11:59 PM)

The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released notifications for direct recruitment to 255 provisional vacancies across six diverse roles. Selection will be based on a single-level Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 13 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 02 November 2026 (11:59 PM)

| Post Name | Vacancies | Pay Scale (Rs.) |

| Assistant Statistical Officer | 196 | 37,640 - 1,15,500 |
| Analyst Grade-II | 18 | 48,440 - 1,37,220 |

### ✍️ Selection Process

The Telangana Council of Higher Education (TGCHE) is conducting the **Round 3 (Phase 3) Counselling** for law admissions. This is a critical opportunity for candidates who qualified the TS LAWCET 2026 to secure a seat in prestigious law colleges.

* **Course Options:** 3-Year LLB and 5-Year Integrated LLB
* **Registration Mode:** Online via the official portal
* **Eligibility:** Candidates who have qualified for TS LAWCET 2026

1. Visit the official counselling portal.
2. Log in using your **TS LAWCET 2026 Hall Ticket Number** and credentials.

4. Upload clear, scanned copies of required certificates.

6. Submit the form and download the confirmation page.

website_content.title: APPSC Group-I Services Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: APPSC has released a notification for 163 provisional vacancies in Group-I Services, including prestigious roles like Deputy Collector and DSP. The online application window opens on October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Group-I Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) is inviting applications for various **Group-I Services** positions. This is a premier opportunity for graduates to enter administrative leadership roles in the state government.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 163 (Provisional)
* **Application Mode:** Online Only
* **Selection Process:** Screening Test $\rightarrow$ Mains (Written) $\rightarrow$ Interview

### 💼 Post-wise Vacancies & Salary
| Post Name | Vacancies | Pay Scale (Rs.) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Deputy Collector | 11 | 61,960 - 1,51,370 |
| DSP (Civil) | 36 | 61,960 - 1,51,370 |
| Divisional Development Officer | 35 | 65,360 - 1,54,980 |
| Asst. Commissioner of State Tax | 14 | 61,960 - 1,51,370 |
| District Educational Officer | 14 | 61,960 - 1,51,370 |
| Asst. Audit Officer | 14 | 54,060 - 1,40,540 |
| Deputy Registrar | 15 | 57,100 - 1,47,760 |
| Other Group-I Posts | 20 | Varies |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **General Posts:** A Bachelor's Degree from any recognized university in India.
* **DSP (Communications):** B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication, or Radio Engineering.
* **Physical Standards:** Candidates for DSP roles must meet physical requirements mentioned in the detailed notification.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Brief Notification Released:** 15/09/2026
* **Detailed Notification:** On or before 06/10/2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 06/10/2026
* **Application Deadline:** 27/10/2026 (11:59 PM)

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Screening Test:** OMR-based objective papers (General Studies & General Aptitude). 1/3rd negative marking applies.
2. **Mains Exam:** Descriptive papers including Qualifying English/Telugu and five core subject papers.
3. **Interview:** Final stage carrying 75 marks.

website_content.title: Mysore City Corporation (MCC) UGD Helper Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Mysuru Mahanagara Palike is recruiting 116 UGD Helpers through a special internal process. Applications must be submitted offline by October 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Mysuru Mahanagara Palike (MCC) has announced a **special, one-time recruitment** for 116 UGD Helper (Under Ground Drainage Helper) positions. Please note that this is **not an open recruitment** and is restricted to existing personnel.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 116
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 27,000 – Rs. 46,675
* **Application Mode:** Offline (In-person submission)
* **Selection Basis:** Purely on merit based on length of continuous service

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Employment Status:** Must be currently working in MCC on daily-wage, contract, outsourcing, or equal-pay-for-equal-work terms.
* **Experience:** Minimum **2 years of continuous service** performing UGD Helper or equivalent duties.
* **Language:** Must be conversant in **Kannada**.
* **Exclusions:** Candidates engaged through STP (Sewage Treatment Plant) or Wet Well contracts are not eligible.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 55 years.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 09 October 2026, 5:30 PM

## Documents Required
* Prescribed application form with passport-size photo
* Proof of Date of Birth
* Certified proof of current engagement and service length at MCC
* Certified ESI and PF documents
* Relevant Caste/Income/Rural/Disability certificates (if applicable)

## How to Apply
1. Collect the free application form from the **MCC Central Office, Sayyaji Rao Road, Mysuru-570004**.
2. Fill in the details accurately and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
3. Submit the completed form **by hand** at the MCC Central Office on or before the deadline.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
TNTEU has announced the availability of result galleys for the **B.Sc.B.Ed and B.A.B.Ed Degree Examinations** for the July 2026 session. This notification is directed toward the Principals of all affiliated Colleges of Education.

website_content.title: Deoghar Home Guard (Grih Rakshak) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: JGRV Deoghar has announced 772 vacancies for Rural and Urban Home Guard posts. Eligible candidates from Deoghar district must apply online by October 26, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Overview
Jharkhand Griha Raksha Vahini (JGRV), Deoghar has released Advertisement No. 01/2026 for the enrolment of **Home Guards (Grih Rakshak)**. This is a voluntary enrolment opportunity for residents of Deoghar to serve the nation.

## 📊 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **772**
* **Rural Home Guard:** 635 Posts (Block-wise distribution)
* **Urban Home Guard:** 137 Posts (Technical & Non-Technical)
* **Women's Reservation:** 50% of posts are earmarked for women.

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
### 1. Educational Qualification
* **Rural Home Guard:** Minimum 7th class pass.
* **Urban Home Guard:** Minimum Matric (10th) pass.

### 2. Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 19 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 40 Years

### 3. Residence
* Candidates must be permanent/ordinary residents of the respective Deoghar block or urban area.

### 4. Physical Standards
| Parameter | Male (Gen/OBC/BC) | Male (ST/SC) | Female (All) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Height** | 162 cm | 157 cm | 148 cm |
| **Chest** | 79 cm | 76 cm | N/A |

## 🛠️ Selection Process
1. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** Race, High Jump, Long Jump, and Shot Put.
2. **Hindi Writing Ability Test:** Qualifying test (30% minimum marks).
3. **Technical Skill Test:** Only for Urban Technical candidates.
4. **Final Phase:** Merit List $\rightarrow$ Document Verification $\rightarrow$ Medical $\rightarrow$ Police Verification.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 11 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 26 October 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
* **Exam Dates:** To be announced via newspapers/website.

## 💰 Application Fee & Allowance
* **Fee:** Rs. 100/- (Online payment)
* **Allowance:** This is a **voluntary enrolment**, not a salaried job. Duty allowance is paid only for days actually deployed on duty.

website_content.summary: Surat Municipal Corporation has released the provisional answer keys and OMR download instructions for Supervisor, Junior Pharmacist, Assistant Auditor, and Technical Officer posts. Candidates must submit objections by September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SMC Provisional Answer Key 2026

The Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) Recruitment Department has released the official notice regarding the provisional answer keys for the written examinations held on **06/09/2026**. This update is critical for candidates who appeared for the following positions:

* **Supervisor (Computer)**
* **Junior Pharmacist**
* **Assistant Auditor**
* **Technical Officer**

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notice Release Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Answer Key Objection Window:** 11 September to 15 September 2026
* **Last Date to Download OMR Sheet:** 17 September 2026

### 📥 How to Download Your OMR Sheet
Candidates must download their OMR sheets before the deadline to avoid missing out:
1. Visit the **RECRUITMENT** section on the official SMC website.
2. Click on the **"ANSWER KEY(S)"** link.
3. Enter your **Application Number** (Format: AAAA/BBBBBB/CCC/DDDDDD), **Seat Number**, and **Date of Birth**.
4. Save the PDF for your records.

### ⚠️ Objection Process (Query Reporting)
If you disagree with the provisional answer key, you may raise an objection under these conditions:
* **Format:** Use the prescribed "Query Reporting Form for Provisional Answer Key".
* **Evidence:** Attach a certified/self-attested color scanned copy of valid documentary evidence.
* **Submission:** Send via e-mail to the official recruitment email address.
* **Deadline:** Objections must be submitted between **11/09/2026 and 15/09/2026**. Objections after this window will not be considered.

## CGSSB FWLN26 Examination 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026

The District Health Society, under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu, has announced a massive recruitment drive for **Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurses**. These positions are available across institutions under the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Medical and Rural Health Services, Medical Education & Research, and the Greater Chennai Corporation.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 4,724
* **Post Name:** Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurse
* **Nature of Job:** Purely Temporary / Contract Basis
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Physical Submission)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must possess a **GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery)** or **B.Sc. Nursing** degree from an Indian Nursing Council-recognised institution.
* **Professional Registration:** Valid registration with the **Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council** is mandatory.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum age is **50 years**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25-09-2026 (until 5:00 PM)

### 📍 Job Locations
Vacancies are available across districts of Tamil Nadu. 
**Note:** This recruitment is NOT applicable to **Tiruppur** and **Chengalpattu** districts due to the Model Code of Conduct.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Download the application form and district-wise vacancy details from the official NHM-TN website.
2. Complete the form and attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents.
3. Submit the physical application to the **Office of the District Health Officer/District Health Society** of the concerned district by the deadline.

website_content.markdown_content:
## AVNL Provisional Answer Key 2026

Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (AVNL), a Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, has officially released the **Provisional Answer Key** for the Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted on **10 September 2026**.

### Recruitment Overview
* **Advertisement No:** AVNL/CO/HR/2026/06
* **Total Vacancies:** 1213

    * Executive/Manager: 208 Posts

* **Provisional Answer Key Release:** 12 September 2026
* **Objection Window Opens:** 12 September 2026 (5:40 PM)
* **Objection Window Closes:** 14 September 2026 (11:55 PM)

### Steps to Download Answer Key & Raise Objections
1. Visit the official AVNL Answer Key/Objection Portal.
2. Log in using your **Registration Number/Roll Number** and Password/Date of Birth.
3. Compare your submitted response sheet with the Provisional Answer Key.
4. To challenge a question, select the specific item, provide the correct answer, and **upload supporting evidence**.

* **Fee:** A prescribed fee per question may be required for raising objections; please verify on the portal.
* **Finality:** The merit list will be prepared based on the **Final Answer Key**, not the provisional one.

website_content.title: Ladakh Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: LPSSRB is inviting applications for 331 Constable (Level-02) posts across Executive, Armed, Border, and Women Battalions. The recruitment is open to 10th pass candidates residing in the UT of Ladakh.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 👮 Ladakh Police Constable Recruitment 2026

The Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh, via the **Ladakh Police Subordinate Service Recruitment Board (LPSSRB)**, has announced direct recruitment for the post of **Constable (Level-02)**. 

### 📊 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **331**
* **Executive, Armed/IRP, SDRF:** 141 Posts
* **Border Battalion:** 168 Posts (District-wise)
* **Women Battalion:** 22 Posts (District-wise)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Passed 10th Class/Matriculation from a recognized board. 
  * *Special Case:* Serving SPOs with 3+ years of service are eligible with an 8th Pass qualification.
* **Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026):** 18 to 28 years.
  * **Relaxations:** SC/ST/ALC (5 years); Serving SPOs/VHGs (Up to 37 years).
* **Domicile:** Must possess a valid Domicile Certificate of the UT of Ladakh.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Physical Standard Test (PST):** Qualifying
2. **Physical Endurance Test (PET):** Qualifying
3. **Document Scrutiny:** Qualifying
4. **Incentive Marks:** Up to 5% for NCC/Computer/Driving License
5. **Written Examination:** 100 Marks (Objective Type)

### 📖 Written Exam Pattern
* **General Knowledge:** 60 Marks
* **Reasoning:** 15 Marks
* **Arithmetic Abilities:** 15 Marks
* **General Science:** 10 Marks
* **Duration:** 80 Minutes | **Negative Marking:** None

### 💰 Application Fee
* **UR/EWS:** ₹600
* **SC/ST/ALC:** ₹500

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 24 August 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 29 August 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 15 September 2026
* **PST/PET Commencement:** 22 September 2026 onwards

## NPCIL Kakrapar Recruitment 2026 Result

The Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL), Kakrapar Site, has officially declared the results for advertisement **SITE/HRM/01/2025**. The post-wise merit lists and cut-off marks for selected and waitlisted candidates are now available.

* **ST/SA (Category-I):** Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Chemical, Chemistry, and Physics.
* **ST/TN (Category-II):** Fitter, Electrician, Electronics, Instrumentation, Welder, Machinist, AC Mechanic, Diesel Mechanic, and Plant Operator.

website_content.summary: MPESB invites applications for 73 Naib Tehsildar posts through a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination. This recruitment is exclusively for eligible serving employees of the MP Revenue Department.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Recruitment Overview
**MPESB** has announced the **Naib Tehsildar Departmental Limited Competitive Examination 2026**. Please note that this is a **Limited Departmental Exam** and is NOT open to the general public.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 01 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 17 September to 06 October 2026
* **Probable Exam Date:** Starting from 14 November 2026

### 🔢 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **73**
* **Clerical Service Cadre:** 46 Posts
* **Patwari/Revenue Inspector Cadre:** 27 Posts
*(Includes Direct Recruitment and Backlog vacancies)*

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Departmental Status:** Must be a regular/officiating employee for at least **5 years** in the Revenue Mandal, Commissioner Land Records, Principal Revenue Commissioner, Divisional Commissioner, or Collector establishments.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Arts, Science, Commerce, or Agriculture from a recognized university.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **55 years** as of 01 January 2026.

### 💰 Salary & Fees
* **Pay Scale:** Level-9 (₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800)
* **Application Fee:** ₹2,000 (plus portal charges)

### ✍️ Selection Process
Selection is based on two objective-type papers (100 marks each):
* **Paper I:** General Reasoning, GK, Hindi, English, Maths, Science, and Computer Knowledge.
* **Paper II:** Govt Service Rules, Revenue Terminology, Land Revenue Code 1959, Revenue Book Circular, and Land Records Rules.
* **Qualifying Marks:** 55% for General; 40% for SC/ST.

website_content.title: SCVTUP UP ITI 2nd Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: The State Council for Vocational Training, Uttar Pradesh (SCVTUP) has released the 2nd round seat allotment results for ITI admissions 2026. Candidates must complete their physical reporting and fee payment by September 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP ITI Admission 2026 - 2nd Round Seat Allotment

The **State Council for Vocational Training, Uttar Pradesh (SCVTUP)** has announced the 2nd Allotment Result for admissions into Government and Private Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across the state for the 2026 session.

### 📌 Key Admission Details
* **Admission Mode:** Purely Merit-Based (No written exam).
* **Eligibility Basis:** Marks obtained in Class 8th or Class 10th.
* **Allocation Process:** Seat allotment is conducted in multiple rounds. Candidates not allotted a seat in the first round are automatically considered for subsequent rounds.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **2nd Allotment Result Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Reporting & Fee Payment Deadline:** 17 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Allotment Result
1. Visit the official admission portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Round 2 seat allotment result'** section.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password**.
4. View your allotted institute and trade/branch.
5. Download and print the **Seat Allotment Letter** for the physical reporting process.

### ⚠️ Crucial Instructions
* **Login Credentials:** Note that Round 2 requires an Application Number and Password (unlike Round 1 which used DOB).
* **Freeze vs Float:** If the option is available, 'Floating' allows you to seek a better seat in the next round, while 'Freezing' confirms your current seat.
* **Deadline:** Failure to report to the allotted institute by **17 September 2026** will result in the forfeiture of the seat.

The **Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC)** has officially released the hall tickets for the Nursing Officer (Group C) recruitment process. Candidates who applied for the **5,989 vacancies** can now access their admission letters online.

* **Verification:** Carefully check your name, photograph, exam shift, and centre address upon downloading.

website_content.markdown_content:
## WBUAFS B.F.Sc. (Hons.) Admission 2026-2027

The West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences (WBUAFS) has released the official notification for the **Counselling cum Admission** process for the 4-year Bachelor of Fishery Science [B.F.Sc. (Hons.)] degree program.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Counselling & Physical Reporting:** 15-09-2026
* **Reporting Time:** 10:45 A.M. to 11:45 A.M.
* **Commencement of Classes:** 16-09-2026

### 🎓 Course Overview
* **Course:** Bachelor of Fishery Science [B.F.Sc. (Hons.)]
* **Duration:** 4 Years
* **Academic Session:** 2026-2027

### 📜 Reservation & Eligibility Rules
* **OBC Candidates:** Must provide a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026. Without this, candidates will be treated as General/UR.
* **EWS Certificates:** Must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 as per West Bengal Government guidelines.
* **Domicile Proof:** Domicile certificates issued by elected representatives (MLA, MP, Councilor, etc.) are **NOT acceptable**. Use Proforma b or e-District certificates.
* **PwD:** Seats are filled on a horizontal basis within respective categories.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Merit-Based:** Admissions are strictly based on the Provisional Merit List.
* **Documents:** Original documents are mandatory for verification during reporting.
* **Anti-Ragging:** Selected candidates must submit an online Anti-Ragging affidavit via www.antiragging.in or www.amanmovement.org at the time of registration.
* **Provisional Nature:** All admissions are provisional and subject to verification of documents and eligibility.

website_content.summary: ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) invites online applications for 22 specialized posts across various technical and support roles. The application window is open from 15 September to 5 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚀 ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026

The **ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC)**, located in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu, has released a recruitment notification (Advt No. IPRC/RMT/2026/01) for various technical and support positions. 

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 05 October 2026

### 🛠️ Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Posts | Qualification |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Technical Assistant** (Auto/Mech/EC) | 5 | First Class Diploma in relevant branch |
| **Technician 'B'** (Turner/Fitter/Welder/etc) | 13 | 10th Std + ITI (NCVT/NAC) |
| **Cook 'A'** | 1 | 10th Std + 5 Years Experience |
| **Fireman 'A'** | 3 | 10th Std + Physical Fitness |

### 💰 Pay Scale
* **Technical Assistant:** Level 7 (Rs. 44,900 – Rs. 1,42,400)
* **Technician ‘B’:** Level 3 (Rs. 21,700 – Rs. 69,100)
* **Cook ‘A’ & Fireman ‘A’:** Level 2 (Rs. 19,900 – Rs. 63,200)

### 🎓 Eligibility Highlights
* **Technical Assistant:** Must possess a **First Class Diploma** in the specified engineering discipline.
* **Technician 'B':** Must have passed **10th/SSC** and hold an **ITI certificate** with NTC/NAC from NCVT.
* **Cook 'A':** Requires a certificate of experience from a well-established hotel/canteen (individual certificates not accepted).
* **Fireman 'A':** Requires 10th pass and a **Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate** to be uploaded during application.

### 📝 Selection Process
* **Cook 'A':** Selection involves a **Skill Test** based on experience certificates.
* **Fireman 'A':** Candidates must meet prescribed **Physical Fitness Standards**.
* For other posts, please refer to the detailed advertisement on the official portal.

website_content.title: HAL Design Trainee & Management Trainee Interview Call Letter 2026
website_content.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has released the interview call letters for the Design Trainee (DT) and Management Trainee (MT) 2026 recruitment. Shortlisted candidates can now download their letters for the personal interviews scheduled in Bengaluru.
website_content.markdown_content:
## HAL DT & MT Interview Call Letter 2026

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), a Maharatna CPSE, has officially issued the **Interview Call Letters** for candidates who cleared the CBT written exam for the posts of **Design Trainee (DT)** and **Management Trainee (MT)**.

### 📌 Quick Overview
* **Organization:** Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)
* **Advertisement No:** HAL/CHRC-TM/RECT-02/2026
* **Total Vacancies:** 120 (60 DT + 60 MT)
* **Current Stage:** Interview Call Letter Download
* **Interview Venue:** Bengaluru

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Interview Call Letter Release:** 12 September 2026
* **Personal Interview Dates:** 21 to 25 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download Call Letter
1. Visit the official login portal at **cbexams.com**.
2. Navigate to the link for **Interview Call Letter - DT/MT 2026**.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Download the call letter and take at least two clear printouts.

### 📂 Documents Required for Interview
* **Printed Call Letter:** Mandatory copy of the interview letter.
* **Identity Proof:** Valid government-issued photo ID.
* **Educational Records:** Original and photocopies of all mark sheets and degree certificates.
* **Category Certificate:** Valid SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates (if applicable).
* **PwBD Certificate:** From a competent authority (if claiming reservation).

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Single Application:** Candidates who applied for both DT and MT posts face rejection.
* **Posting Locations:** Selected trainees may be posted in Bengaluru, Tumakuru, Hyderabad, Nasik, Koraput, Barrackpore, Lucknow, Kanpur, or Korwa.
* **Caution:** HAL does not take payments for employment; beware of fraudsters.

Tests core subject knowledge at the degree/post-graduate level for 13 disciplines, including:

website_content.markdown_content:
## MDU UG Result 2026 Overview
Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak has officially released the results for specific undergraduate programs on **11 September 2026**. This update pertains to students enrolled in 4-year degree courses for their 2nd and 4th semesters/years.

### 🎓 Results Declared For
* **Bachelor of Science (Genetics)** - 4 Year (Sem/Year 02 & 04)
* **Bachelor in Public Health Sciences** - 4 Year (Sem/Year 02 & 04)

### 📝 Requirements to Check Result
To access the result portal, students must have the following details ready:
* **Registration Number** (Complete)
* **Roll Number**

### 🛠️ Step-by-Step Guide to Check Result
1. Visit the official MDU result portal.
2. Select your respective course from the available list.
3. Enter your **Registration Number** and **Roll Number** accurately.
4. Click on the submit button to view your marksheet.
5. Download or print the result for future reference.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* The online result is **provisional** and subject to corrections.
* The **Detailed Marks Card (DMC)** issued by the university will be considered the final official record.
* In case of any discrepancies in marks, students are advised to contact the **MDU Examination Branch** directly.

website_content.title: DSSSB MTS Answer Key 2026 (Post Code 803/25)
website_content.summary: DSSSB has released the provisional answer key for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) recruitment for 714 vacancies. Candidates who appeared for the computer-based examination can now verify their responses and raise objections.
website_content.markdown_content:
## DSSSB MTS Answer Key 2026

The **Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB)** has officially released the provisional answer key for the **Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS)** position under **Post Code 803/25** (Advertisement No. 07/25).

### 📌 Key Recruitment Details
* **Organization:** DSSSB
* **Post Name:** Multi Tasking Staff (MTS)
* **Total Vacancies:** 714
* **Exam Period:** 25 July 2026 to 01 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 11 September 2026

### 🛠 How to Download Your Answer Key
1. Visit the official DSSSB candidate portal.
2. Enter your **Application Number/Roll Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
3. Submit the credentials to log in.
4. Download the recorded response sheet and compare it with the official provisional key.

### ⚠️ Objection Process
If you find any discrepancies in the answer key, you can challenge them:
* Log in to the candidate portal and select the specific question.
* **Upload supporting documents** or proof for your claim.
* Submit the objection form before the window closes.
* **Note:** Only the final answer key issued after the review process will be used for result preparation.

2. Go to the **Semester Results** section and select **April/May, 2026**.
3. Locate the link for **"B.Com (Accounting and Finance)(FYUP) 2nd Semester Examination (September 11, 2026) - May, 2026"**.
4. Enter your **Roll Number** or required identification details.

website_content.title: BLW Varanasi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27
website_content.summary: Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW) invites online applications from eligible Indian sportspersons for 25 vacancies across various sports disciplines. The application window closes on October 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🏆 BLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27

Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW), Varanasi, under Indian Railways, is recruiting talented sportspersons for **25 positions** under the Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) for the year 2026-27.

### 📋 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **25**
* **Basketball (Men):** 6 Posts
* **Volleyball (Men):** 7 Posts
* **Wrestling (Men):** 4 Posts
* **Handball (Men):** 8 Posts

**Pay Level Distribution:**
* Pay Level-5: 2 Posts
* Pay Level-2: 8 Posts
* Pay Level-1: 15 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualification:**
* **Pay Level 5:** Graduation/Degree from a recognized university.
* **Pay Level 2:** 12th Pass (+2 stage) or equivalent.
* **Pay Level 1:** 10th Pass / ITI or equivalent.

**Sports Qualification:**
Candidates must meet specific achievement norms (Category A, B, or C) based on the Pay Level they are applying for. Achievements must be from events held on or after **01.04.2024**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12.09.2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 12.10.2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 01.01.2027

### 🔞 Age Limit (as of 01.01.2027)
* **Minimum Age:** 18 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 25 Years
* *Note: No age relaxation is provided for any community.*

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General Category:** ₹400
* **SC/ST/Ex-SM/PwBD/Minorities/EBC:** ₹250
* **Note:** Fees are **refundable** for candidates who actually appear in the trials.

### ⚙️ Selection Process
Selection is based on a composite score of 100 marks:
1. **Sports Trials:** 40 Marks (Minimum 25 required to be 'FIT')
2. **Sports Achievements:** 50 Marks
3. **Educational Qualification:** 10 Marks

**Final Step:** Medical Examination and a mandatory 5-year Service Bond.
